name: Team Fetterman
subject: John would make a *terrible* Republican 🐘🚫
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
John’s a Democrat, and that’s not gonna change.
#
Hey Derek, Team Fetterman here.
**This morning on The View, John set the record straight. He’s a Democrat, and that’s not gonna change.**
[**Can you pitch in $5 to help John keep fighting for PA in the Senate?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20250127?refcode=em20250127-9837&refcode2=9837_434096_V1ej9I&akid=9837%2E434096%2EV1ej9I)
As a United States Senator, engaging the president is part of the job. But truth be told, we all know **John would make a *terrible* Republican.** 🐘🚫
➡️ He’ll _always_ stand with union workers in PA + across the country.
➡️ He’ll _never_ turn his back on the LGBTQ+ community.
➡️ He’ll _always_ support women’s right to make their own health care decisions.
But if we’re going to keep this seat 🔵, we’re going to need your help as we navigate this new era in Washington.
[**Will you pitch in $5 before Friday’s end-of-month deadline and help us reach our $30,000 January goal?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20250127?refcode=em20250127-9837&refcode2=9837_434096_V1ej9I&akid=9837%2E434096%2EV1ej9I)

name: Alex DeGrasse
subject: President Trump is making America respected again
body:
We need to have his back

| | | | [](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/9TSq/?__vbtrk=MjcyMTY0OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjcyMTY0OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
---
Fellow patriot, In a historic and decisive act of leadership, **President Trump just** **forced the Colombian President to accept Colombian deportees** after he announced he would refuse them.
**_President Trump is ensuring that those who break our laws and threaten our sovereignty are sent back_**** __where they belong__**** _._**
**_**__[This is what America First leadership looks like – unapologetic, bold, and effective](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/9TSq/?__vbtrk=MjcyMTY0OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjcyMTY0OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)__**** _._**_**
[SUPPORT AMERICA FIRST](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/9TSq/?__vbtrk=MjcyMTY0OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjcyMTY0OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
But here’s the reality: without a strong GOP majority in the House, President Trump’s agenda is at risk of being **stopped cold**.
If you think a Democrat majority in Congress wouldn’t have **blocked** President Trump from taking that action... You’re dead wrong.
The Democrats are desperate to **stall** , **sabotage** , and **obstruct** President Trump and his administration's actions.
They’re funded by liberal billionaires and backed by radical leftist special interest groups that will **stop at nothing to keep illegal alien criminals inside US borders**.
**__[We cannot let that happen](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/9TSq/?__vbtrk=MjcyMTY0OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjcyMTY0OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)__**** _._**
This fight isn’t about one man or one party, our fight is about the future of our nation. A GOP House majority is the firewall we need to advance the America First agenda and keep winning for the American people.
**__[But we can’t do it without you](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/9TSq/?__vbtrk=MjcyMTY0OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjcyMTY0OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)__**** _._**
Will you stand with us today to help our team secure the resources that we need to defend our majority in the House?
[STAND WITH US RIGHT NOW](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/9TSq/?__vbtrk=MjcyMTY0OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjcyMTY0OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
Every dollar you give will help us push back against the Left, protect President Trump’s progress, hold onto a Republican-controlled House, and expand our majority in 2026.

Time is short, and the stakes couldn’t be higher. President Trump is doing his part – now it’s up to us to do ours.
_Let's win this fight,_
**Alex DeGrasse**
Executive Director

subject: Remembering why we are in this fight.

Hi team,
It’s been a week since Donald Trump was inaugurated as our 47th President. In that time, his administration has pardoned violent insurrectionists who attacked our Capitol and police officers on January 6th, and has threatened our allies with damaging tariffs that will drive up costs for working families.
That’s why we thought it would be a good time to remind ourselves of the four freedoms that have guided Michael’s career as we approach the end of the month (and prepare for the next four years).
Michael believes every American has the right to four essential freedoms:
The Freedom to Rise : By building an economy that works for everyone, not just the people at the top, and pulls children out of poverty.
The Freedom to Learn: By prioritizing and investing in our schools, educators, and students, not politicizing them.
The Freedom from Violence: By passing meaningful gun safety laws, fighting the opioid epidemic, and regulating the extremism we see on social media.
The Freedom to Govern Ourselves : By reforming our electoral system so our voices, not dark money, have the most power — and keeping the government out of our doctor's office and our bedrooms.
These are the values Michael fights for every day in the Senate, and they will guide our work moving forward.
We know we have some tough fights in front of us to protect and advance these freedoms this year, and we are going to need all the support we can get. My Dear Friend, My name is Jeff Younger, and I’m the father to two wonderful boys. That’s my son James in the photo above.I’m writing to you because I’ve spent the last eight years fighting tooth and nail to keep school-appointed counselors, and out-of-control judges from transitioning my son James against my will and against all reason.You may have heard about my case from Charlie Kirk, Nick Freitas, or on Fox News.I am James’s father, but because I refused to accept that my 5 YEAR OLD boy should be surgically and chemically castrated......I’ve watched the school system, and the courts systematically strip me of all parental rights and privileges.Just recently, an LA Court ruled that my ex-wife is free to proceed with castrating my son James. That’s why I’m writing to you today. **[I need your help.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=7459654ce51645f5b80261aba2ad281c&_e=jzM5BkZPMP_ltkw_kFTIAEx-7WREPqQcdYrBK06CCE9P3rtIcccFxRL9-Fqhx7F-KWJxq8tlqma9KSymF2MQKpmy8Onrdp_zhKK1qTadB_7c89LrHi4fZAEKfSZlxwkHJkQsZd8PSHEhUl00y38qKEiqDkf79KSl6xFPVPaJBvRJZiL4LrDQt0k_iTh-Z5TkBjDIaNycIpNN_cLuDN-BkCg2r3uDfCcpr2-qmf1srP_KwX9pTToyWGx5YwfRBraKVRSqLOBhhp61pFpFv9lIcVlphz1uK-nV9Dkbl_AYbKz2rLX3YHtqqufWx3N2WgmGmZ_7aTtjMLPdpHiXrdZIS9Zhi7UljmxmjNhrNhc77oC11flHzSQGJVLrbuyn1Wki)** I’m up against radical trans-activist judges, the 6 BILLION dollar trans lobby, and coastal elites forcing their LGBTQ+ agenda down our throats. They’re trying to bury me in paperwork... They’re trying to bankrupt me in legal fees... They’re trying to break my spirit... I want to keep fighting, but I can’t do it alone. If you’re with me in the fight to **Save James** , **[would you consider making a generous $25 contribution to my Legal Defense Fund today?](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=7459654ce51645f5b80261aba2ad281c&_e=jzM5BkZPMP_ltkw_kFTIAEx-7WREPqQcdYrBK06CCE9P3rtIcccFxRL9-Fqhx7F-KWJxq8tlqma9KSymF2MQKpmy8Onrdp_zhKK1qTadB_7c89LrHi4fZAEKfSZlxwkHJkQsZd8PSHEhUl00y38qKEiqDkf79KSl6xFPVPaJBvRJZiL4LrDQt0k_iTh-Z5TkBjDIaNycIpNN_cLuDN-BkCg2r3uDfCcpr2-qmf1srP9mkafr1kPKgSZop_kLlujApJw4WCQx42_dDLgCtxBpKsyz0jwSQmpj8DqyeUahkbbU9OEJhG3z5mGhBB9L-46TE8lkevBNXcPskQ1TthH17csiSoCZDKTdSpNiqBTI-jrUCuLQ-DboqDKcqgt6jIW-)** But I’m getting ahead of myself...Let me start at the beginning. When James was just two years old, my ex-wife began saying our boy James was actually a girl.I told her she was wrong, and I kept dropping my son off at school in boy’s clothes because **he is a boy**. (I can’t believe I have to say that.) I later found out that the school counselors were changing him into girl’s clothes once he got to school WITHOUT MY KNOWLEDGE to inflame this delusion.Then during the custody battle, the judge BANNED me from seeing my son.The court-mandated supervisor would ONLY let me see James if I put him in girl’s clothes. I have never affirmed the lie that my son is a girl, nor will I ever affirm it.So I was forced to stop visiting him.It broke my heart.**Do you see what we’re up against?** I can confirm that these trans-activist judges are presiding over kangaroo courts where common sense goes right out the window.They need to be stopped...They need to be held accountable...And **James** needs to be **saved** from their butchery.**[THAT’S why I need your help.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=7459654ce51645f5b80261aba2ad281c&_e=jzM5BkZPMP_ltkw_kFTIAEx-7WREPqQcdYrBK06CCE9P3rtIcccFxRL9-Fqhx7F-KWJxq8tlqma9KSymF2MQKpmy8Onrdp_zhKK1qTadB_7c89LrHi4fZAEKfSZlxwkHJkQsZd8PSHEhUl00y38qKEiqDkf79KSl6xFPVPaJBvRJZiL4LrDQt0k_iTh-Z5TkBjDIaNycIpNN_cLuDN-BkCg2r3uDfCcpr2-qmf1srP9C7RoJk8qVCUf9iPQeANYiQJKFBIpplZERnIpoziuRQB5MmsrcbgIeA3Acjel1tzncaLGKzmTxIPsYr-jw1tVVz_JwP44zq0VdVi_CfQgqJQQ0xFPvWF7HeqhJYKBSctcjrFvNMuosWEAIgGEZKPG1)** I am under a gag order currently to NEVER speak about transgender issues publicly.Obviously, I’m not abiding by that order because it’s blatantly unconstitutional.But that’s not even the point.If I were just some activist, maybe I would worry about the threat of jail time. But I’m not just some activist.I’m a Dad.I’m fighting to save my son.And I will never give up on **James**.I’ve been in court three times a week for the past eight years. At this point, I have more trial experience than most lawyers. I authored the bill in Texas, South Carolina, and Tennessee that outlawed sex change surgeries for minors.I then spent every dollar I had to make sure cowardly politicians passed those bills.But these Radicals are relentless and they don’t play fair. I got the law passed in my home state of Texas, but then my ex-wife just took James to California: a “trans sanctuary” state.And there was nothing I could do to stop it.And that’s the scary part:**If this can happen in Texas, it can happen anywhere.** Then in California, the radical judge railroaded me and gave my ex-wife free reign to proceed with the castration.I can’t even appeal the case because he sealed all the court records...I’ll have to sue the LA County Court to unseal the records just to BEGIN the appeal process...On top of that, the other side is trying to make ME pay THEIR legal fees...**Do you see what we’re up against?** But if Conservatives won’t put up a fight, how will we ever win? That’s where Patriots Legal Defense Fund (PLDF) comes in. They heard about my case and immediately offered to stand by my side. **[Will you stand with us?](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=7459654ce51645f5b80261aba2ad281c&_e=jzM5BkZPMP_ltkw_kFTIAEx-7WREPqQcdYrBK06CCE9P3rtIcccFxRL9-Fqhx7F-KWJxq8tlqma9KSymF2MQKpmy8Onrdp_zhKK1qTadB_7c89LrHi4fZAEKfSZlxwkHJkQsZd8PSHEhUl00y38qKEiqDkf79KSl6xFPVPaJBvRJZiL4LrDQt0k_iTh-Z5TkBjDIaNycIpNN_cLuDN-BkCg2r3uDfCcpr2-qmf1srP8YarIDnNBZsBclP3jTj4kBrZACm6z015619r4Q1Gx45a8gnJcB6Yax6kH_QIeVKXAxFokE1Q1bdlegihf3QWmcCxZXlUfoAPhIxBWKkB3i2SLYh86ZuEiAVV_39zfvOIgJJ6NlvDZHB-VBJmL7-3pE)**

name: Nani w/ ParentsTogetherAction
subject: Paid leave helps everyone (petition)
body:
Paid time off to care for ourselves and our families should not only be for the privileged few – Congress needs to pass paid leave NOW. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us8.campaign-archive.com/?e=7e921d898f&i=*|ITERATION_UNIQUE_ID|*&u=1c4af7e0c2cf6603f994addd7&id=441dc13c46)
---
| | Hi Peter, I’m Sarah, a mom of a 10-month-old baby and a 3-year-old toddler. I work with Nani at ParentsTogether. Like a lot of moms, I'm raising my young children, who ALWAYS need me, and caring for my own aging parents at the same time. It’s SO important, but I’ve never been more tired in my life! 😴 It seems I have to take time off constantly — my toddler is constantly catching some virus or cold at preschool - not to mention when my babysitter’s kids get sick! It’s a never ending cycle that becomes SO frustrating when I’m trying to stay present at work. I’m always struggling to work hard and also be a good mom and daughter – and it feels IMPOSSIBLE to do both. And of course, the default burden of childcare usually falls on me. 😤 So many of us use up all our sick days caring for family members and don't have time off left when we get sick ourselves! It’s just not fair that taking time off can cost us pay or even our job – we’re the only wealthy country that doesn’t have a national leave policy!
---
|
#### **Can you sign my petition for paid family leave for everyone in this country?**
---
| | [Sign the petition](https://parents-together.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1c4af7e0c2cf6603f994addd7&id=3e24f19565&e=7e921d898f&i=5e0505fff7 "Sign the petition")
---
| Democrats have been fighting for this, while Republicans put big corporations first and are stonewalling every step of the way. Luckily, Senator Kirsten Gillibrand and Representative Rosa DeLauro have introduced the FAMILY Act, new signature legislation to create a permanent, national paid family and medical leave program. This law would ensure that EVERY worker in the U.S., no matter the size or type of employment, has access to paid leave for every serious life transition. Taking time off from work to care for ourselves and our families should not only be a privilege for those who are already financially stable – it is a critical need for the wellbeing of our kids, our parents, and ourselves! [Will you sign my petition to demand that Congress finally pass paid leave?](https://parents-together.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1c4af7e0c2cf6603f994addd7&id=d5f57e81b6&e=7e921d898f&i=5e0505fff7)
---
| Thanks so much, **Nani**

clean_body: Paid time off to care for ourselves and our families should not only be for the privileged few – Congress needs to pass paid leave NOW. | | | =|ITERATIONUNIQUEID|&u=1c4af7e0c2cf6603f994addd7&id=441dc13c46 | | Hi Peter, I’m Sarah, a mom of a 10-month-old baby and a 3-year-old toddler. I work with Nani at ParentsTogether. Like a lot of moms, I'm raising my young children, who ALWAYS need me, and caring for my own aging parents at the same time. It’s SO important, but I’ve never been more tired in my life! 😴 It seems I have to take time off constantly — my toddler is constantly catching some virus or cold at preschool - not to mention when my babysitter’s kids get sick! It’s a never ending cycle that becomes SO frustrating when I’m trying to stay present at work. I’m always struggling to work hard and also be a good mom and daughter – and it feels IMPOSSIBLE to do both. And of course, the default burden of childcare usually falls on me. 😤 So many of us use up all our sick days caring for family members and don't have time off left when we get sick ourselves! It’s just not fair that taking time off can cost us pay or even our job – we’re the only wealthy country that doesn’t have a national leave policy! | Can you sign my petition for paid family leave for everyone in this country? | | "Sign the petition" | Democrats have been fighting for this, while Republicans put big corporations first and are stonewalling every step of the way. Luckily, Senator Kirsten Gillibrand and Representative Rosa DeLauro have introduced the FAMILY Act, new signature legislation to create a permanent, national paid family and medical leave program. This law would ensure that EVERY worker in the U.S., no matter the size or type of employment, has access to paid leave for every serious life transition. Taking time off from work to care for ourselves and our families should not only be a privilege for those who are already financially stable – it is a critical need for the wellbeing of our kids, our parents, and ourselves! | Thanks so much, Nani | | | | | | | | | ---|--- | | | ---|--- | | | ---|--- | | | ---|--- | | mailto:advocacy@parents-together.org | mailto:advocacy@parents-together.org ---|--- | Regular actions and updates to support families and help them thrive. Peter,

_Public safety and economy, public safety and education, and public safety and mental health are all “which comes first, the chicken or the egg” propositions._

I believe in a set of legislative initiatives that approach economic, educational, and mental health issues in novel and holistic ways. These initiatives empower individuals while shrinking the size and scope of an administrative state that has become overly burdensome and unnecessarily large.

_**I reject the notion that crime is either acceptable or a necessary part of the community’s life.**_

| [ **REJECT THE NOTION** ](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=41505c816bda413887a84ed8e5e9353b&_e=AZsN1dQAE3gvShjnFf6nTpshZ38f620ga-QR-BhA55f248ie5XL70Cx54Mx_nVKvQcfSFxSk7yZT2OZNWPR8WVOi1fMgJ-KUQ7zbYOgnDquF6yb-ySeLXYO6rK3X04mpPvLVGJFacUtxfAmpGcozBeiTf433WY-ukyuBwPybhYrs8hv4vj76NpUOrcZs_pn13PrCb5Y92E6J8Yzg5YQZyIMNcVOZy9394Gbn6QNNdvs46xDQ2V36klfA_ctH9yyBHdnUyjOT1wxBYfMJwFsBrH8PnGMQn5U1yqK7VOy949pGHfKGa96OOnbEb8pK1ktZkLIRK-kj6giwI_ldKaoHnA%3D%3D)
---

Our police are tasked with the most difficult of society’s assignments, and their pay is not equal to the skills necessary to protect both the victim and the victimizer. Our Constitution demands that the rights of the minority are protected – _and who among us is more a minority than those who suffer from addiction, mental health, and the scourge of poverty disorders?_

**As your Senator, I will fight for the necessary funding and training so that our police become the pride of our community.**

[**Join my fight to restore our communities and to send Tina Smith packing in 2026. Together, we can save America one notion at a time.**](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=41505c816bda413887a84ed8e5e9353b&_e=AZsN1dQAE3gvShjnFf6nTpshZ38f620ga-QR-BhA55f248ie5XL70Cx54Mx_nVKvQcfSFxSk7yZT2OZNWPR8WVOi1fMgJ-KUQ7zbYOgnDquF6yb-ySeLXYO6rK3X04mpPvLVGJFacUtxfAmpGcozBeiTf433WY-ukyuBwPybhYrs8hv4vj76NpUOrcZs_pn1bIpfS6Vp_-ImvKUV2j_yN3-CK7eB0dJo9ZJBprJI29_H6gxEf1EDXBE7d73mQn4S_rvQCYzGLlUfJUBJP27iZq6CR70VWQDXJO6mTHa78LxoXs9oThHEYD_oR-2RZjjfF9uIUCoWMrvpS3308Dqyvw%3D%3D)

[ **JOIN MY FIGHT** ](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=41505c816bda413887a84ed8e5e9353b&_e=AZsN1dQAE3gvShjnFf6nTpshZ38f620ga-QR-BhA55f248ie5XL70Cx54Mx_nVKvQcfSFxSk7yZT2OZNWPR8WVOi1fMgJ-KUQ7zbYOgnDquF6yb-ySeLXYO6rK3X04mpPvLVGJFacUtxfAmpGcozBeiTf433WY-ukyuBwPybhYrs8hv4vj76NpUOrcZs_pn1j-GEih5Pmm8aTXRM9w5uiLM88tWgn9YUvvBValno7tdzBB3vcZCT88k4MBv3HUHpSYjRRiuzKvEc8BOvT57ecp5idmlTXJ84TMEK8cP6nBPaL31_p-MdPVyPTOGO-u9zeXvaw3UGTz6NEK7LwupGTA%3D%3D)

Meet Royce White:

**Born and raised in the Twin Cities, Royce White was the son of a single mother and started playing sports at the age of 5 years old. Living in various neighborhoods growing up, much of his family remained in the Rondo community, where he spent much of his time and received schooling. White excelled at basketball and recieved a scholarship to play basketball at the University of Minnesota, and later transferred to Iowa State. He would go on to make Dean's List while receiving All Big-12 first-team honors and many other basketball awards.

_After being selected 16th overall by The Houston Rockets in the NBA draft, White began to voice concerns about the NBA’s collective bargaining agreement (CBA), specifically regarding mental health policy, which at the time did not exist. Eventually, his concerns became a public dispute between White and the NBA. This resulted in White demanding that the NBA, as a representative of the global corporate community, take up the responsibility of spearheading the mental health conversation – not just posturing through press statements, but through policy._

Royce then went on to win two championships in Canada before moving over to play Big 3 Basketball. White appeared at a game in a t-shirt that read “Free The Uyghurs.” After a game-winning basket, White did a post-game interview on CBS, where he called for 2 Million Uyghurs to be freed and released from concentration camps. As the season went on, White would touch on taboo topics such as Gain of Function Research, The Federal Reserve, Julian Assange, Edward Snowden, Larry Hoover, Jeff Fort, Muammar Gaddafi, The Great Reset, Ivermectin, Me Too, etc.

Now, Royce White is running for Senate in Minnesota to take down the Radical Left. Republicans have not seen recent success in Minnesota, but Royce's campaign is different: a grassroots movement that's sick of the Radical Agenda pushed by Far Left Democrats Tina Smith and Ilhan Omar. Royce needs your help to pull off a fourth quarter comeback victory and FLIP Minnesota Red for Republicans.

** [**PASS ROYCE AN ASSIST**](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=41505c816bda413887a84ed8e5e9353b&_e=AZsN1dQAE3gvShjnFf6nTpshZ38f620ga-QR-BhA55f248ie5XL70Cx54Mx_nVKvQcfSFxSk7yZT2OZNWPR8WVOi1fMgJ-KUQ7zbYOgnDquF6yb-ySeLXYO6rK3X04mpPvLVGJFacUtxfAmpGcozBeiTf433WY-ukyuBwPybhYrs8hv4vj76NpUOrcZs_pn1borzWceiePWZGn4MvH7UuY7WKbjbebGqPjWOH_mrOVESEF3OV-8eFr6NoUmjp7dJ-qXVArHi3hFr9vmZhvMNKp0vA7Ufop-kvmvpHIZMchSL-0GJQPF051ja4Hhi3gXqy2YvtR1inOD5BVoraSrLow%3D%3D)

name: David Horowitz
subject: Who is the enemy within?
body:
I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn’t tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever.| |
---
| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my “comrades” made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan – then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I’ve dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn’t tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That’s why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** – and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I’m asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=1722f26c2fa34c47aff37cd930dd7346&_e=VcG0JL1EaiFlIefdyaasqVkXiG8iPClrr3KtQdKJOZ0NQ_sS9TDxeDX6b7LLXSkzHTrr7_JavupoJCh9Ua4063s4-DrZ1_9rb4B_Af8gRxzJQS-Wg-TkbOOkxrmshNXArujR_v1K__d77_sYS9jmEGhhAQoUi10VhyMPazVlvuuTiV5Xky19kEbcHuoUo9I_nihYI4n07Ur0kurMAXpIWKbmOQCQ9NSiLKV0OCCvGb3DQEaRjCAAJ_sh8MLT99Y7mxElpAe9wV9haZJ51DR6rBWfJusgqIxgBEv_paycv1OI4R1f7rw5F7TihHyE4nsCtSqP25vnmKr0JzOIe4DvNLGeJ9x6DAN8xhKHBj0NFODEB8N_QIO4CPySzL71sBhmbmb-yU0GK7lCuuGspWM5uIrjhExlg7Fx1WvezWsIymw%3D)** When you think of “the enemy within” you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn’t be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we’ve seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making – but most of the American people have no clue what we’re up against. **That’s why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...** ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state – and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as “white supremacists” and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... “A Great Book” – Dinesh D’Souza “ _The Enemy Within_ is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life.” – Mark Levin “David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation.” Laura Ingraham I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because... I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. I was the enemy within — and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat them. We’ve reached the point in our history that will decide our future – and we either win these political battles or lose everything that makes us prosperous and free. **[That’s why I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within when you donate $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and give us the ammunition we need to expose the Left’s evil agenda to every American patriot.](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=1722f26c2fa34c47aff37cd930dd7346&_e=VcG0JL1EaiFlIefdyaasqVkXiG8iPClrr3KtQdKJOZ0NQ_sS9TDxeDX6b7LLXSkzHTrr7_JavupoJCh9Ua4063s4-DrZ1_9rb4B_Af8gRxzJQS-Wg-TkbOOkxrmshNXArujR_v1K__d77_sYS9jmEGhhAQoUi10VhyMPazVlvuuTiV5Xky19kEbcHuoUo9I_nihYI4n07Ur0kurMAXpIWKbmOQCQ9NSiLKV0OCCvGb3DQEaRjCAAJ_sh8MLT99Y7QDKz776syelqfh86HqmzdSpDGF_0F6BfQGg9daVrbFbLncPLCMptrUuncy2Q5DhG0NrGguajvYktZuHlVzCtO5MOpaqUd3gprhtMqumtf92Hx32aq4Rq8oq8U81E3-CI2k9h_GheNfyGhgg6qD4_A9fB0byA882LgZvUWI497j0%3D)** The Left is at war with America. They don’t simply disagree with us about how to make our country better – they want to destroy it to make way for their Marxist dystopia. Or in Obama’s own words “radically transform” America. **And they don’t care how much they have to lie, cheat or steal to achieve it.** So it’s up to patriots like you and me to expose the truth about the Left to our fellow Americans while we still can.

name: Andrew Yang
subject: Taking Risks
body:
I would see these groups of men, many of whom have had their marriages or relationships destroyed due to their becoming addicted to these trading apps | |
---
| | |
---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=3586bf1c57&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
|
---
| Hello, I hope all is great on your end.

I recently read Nate Silver’s latest book, “On the Edge: The Art of Risking Everything.“ The book is about people who take risks for a living: gamblers, investors, entrepreneurs. He contrasts these risk-takers with those who work in academia, media and government, typically more steady and stable environments. One of the points that Nate makes is that most people take too little risk in their career, and that most would benefit from being a bit more edgy.

I have agreed with that perspective for years. I left a high-paying corporate job to co-found a dot-com startup in 2000 that totally flopped. So that risk didn’t work out. But I was 25 years old and recovered over the next number of years. I eventually became the CEO of an education company when I was 30 that was acquired 4 years later.

My risk profile only went up at that point; if you’re 34 and have a nest egg, why not do what you thought was right and take big swings? Plus, at that point I was still unmarried and didn’t have a lot of obligations. I started an entrepreneurship organization and, after concluding that massive changes were needed for the economy to work for most people, ran for President. At each stage, I thought I could leave it all out there and still be fine. Entrepreneurs are optimistic by nature.

And things have worked out! Still married.

One thing I’ve grown to realize though is that I’m wired to be unusually accepting of certain risks; a thought that plagued me when I was young was the risk of looking in the mirror and wondering why I didn’t do more or put myself out there. I’ve tended to be motivated by things other than money. That might not be the priority for a lot of other people in different circumstances. Plus, now that I have a family I have a more nuanced perspective.
---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=61462f9bfb&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
| This week on the podcast I interview Gunjan Banerji, a Wall Street Journal reporter who spent months visiting with people who have developed a gambling problem on cryptocurrencies or options trading. “I would see these groups of men, many of whom have had their marriages or relationships destroyed due to their becoming addicted to these trading apps and lost their savings. Mind you, I’m talking about investing apps, not gambling apps. Investing has this sense that, ‘Oh, this isn’t addictive like gambling,’ but for many it is, and options trading has similar dynamics to sports betting.”

Gunjan details how she became an options trader for a week for her reporting. “It affected my mood. I became fixated on what was happening to my positions. At one point, I had a trade pay off and it seemed to other people I was high I was so elated. Of course, I had lost on other trades.” Gunjan interviewed dozens of men – it’s almost always men – and believes that this problem is going to get a lot worse. “There is now a very thin line between gambling and investing, and it’s getting thinner all of the time. More and more people are falling prey to it.”

I agree – I think we should regulate sports betting more rigorously. And I believe people should be wary of chasing short-term highs by aggressively investing money that they might need for another purpose. It’s always hard to know when to take it off the table.

Do I still think that people should take on a bit more risk in their own lives? Generally, sure. Life is short and we should go for the gusto. We are more resilient than we think. But I’m much more into risks taken with one’s time than with one’s money. I’m more like, “Ask that person if they want to hang out with you!” or “Try something new!” rather than betting the rent. After all, life is off-screen, not on it.

For my conversation with Gunjan Banerji, click [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=c64594bf83&e=0f227c2ae3). For Nate’s book, click [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=73d0fe618f&e=0f227c2ae3). To see what Forward is doing in your state, click [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=917aa843db&e=0f227c2ae3) – we are up to big things.
---
| **
Andrew Yang**
Co-Chair, Forward Party

name: Pete Sepp
subject: 10 Ways to Reform the IRS
body:
The IRS has a long history of mismanagement, inefficiency, overreach, and creating unnecessary burdens for taxpayers.

| | | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zor07mfqjhvq6esbjfiqsk0bs1ih2iiv9n20r0to_rp22sh2s8i6epj0s1im2o76clh2bs)
Friend,

President-elect Donald Trump and a Republican-controlled Congress will undoubtedly try to move quickly on preventing the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act (TCJA) expiration and addressing our nation’s dire financial outlook.

However, IRS reform also needs to be a priority.

The IRS has a long history of mismanagement, inefficiency, overreach, and creating unnecessary burdens for taxpayers.

**The National Taxpayers Union (NTU) has a long history too – of reining in the IRS and holding them accountable to American taxpayers.**

I am Pete Sepp, President of the National Taxpayers Union. NTU is the “Voice of America’s Taxpayers.” We fight to ensure that all Americans are able to pursue their dreams without the heavy hand of the government holding them back.

Right now, our research has identified 10 critical reforms for the IRS. But before I share them with you, I must ask for your urgent support. Click below to help us fight against IRS inefficiency:
[Donate](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2znaukjokms09up99j092u2ukpod8r4bd7vb1p620_rp22sh2s8i6epj0s1im2o76clh2bs)
**Here are 10 IRS reforms and policies that must be at the top of the new administration’s agenda:**

**1.** Produce a regular report to Congress on where tax code administration is overly complex and can be simplified.

**2.** Provide Congress with direct access to IRS technical staff for legislative and rulemaking purposes.

**3.** Create a detailed punch list and implementation plan for technology modernization.

**4.** Make the IRS Independent Office of Appeals truly independent and accessible to taxpayers.

**5.** Permit the National Taxpayer Advocate, an office NTU lobbied for to stand up for taxpayers, to hire her own attorney rather than use IRS lawyers.

[Help NTU keep the IRS from abusing taxpayers. Click here to donate today >>>](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zf6j0puorb8bj9spds3j8rib5uo33bmguhfg0jn0_rp22sh2s8i6epj0s1im2o76clh2bs)
**6.** Allow Congress to decide the future of the Direct File program. The IRS far exceeded its authority to stand up this program when there are far bigger modernization priorities.

**7.** Halt counterproductive, aggressive litigation strategies against certain taxpayers utilizing lawful tax savings provisions. This is clogging the courts and delaying settlements, needlessly costing the government and taxpayers.

**8.** Rescind the proposed supervisory signature regulation that lets the IRS heap penalties on taxpayers without accountability, and follow the “no signature, no penalty” intent of current law.

**9.** Rescind unworkable cryptocurrency regulations, including one slated to take effect in 2025.

**10.** Publish a dashboard of regular IRS performance metrics and data to inform decision-making.

These reforms could shift the IRS from being one of the most unliked government agencies by improving its transparency, modernization, and customer service.

Join NTU in our fight for change in the IRS by donating $10, $35, or even $100 today.

We look forward to the incoming Trump Administration, its Treasury Secretary, and its choice of IRS Commissioner working to defend the rights of taxpayers. But we can't just hope for the best. We must work from the outside to make change happen on the inside.

## ICE Raids Conducted Across Texas
U.S. immigration officials [conducted “enhanced targeted operations”](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDGPtCAQQH8NdpgZFMGC4mvs9muvNCijkoBsdG5d__1lr7_6Je8l7-sxPnxMcV__-0yO30sZFSgtAaWyY_Ax3WNbBTdB6LEih6ax0DVW99XmAAyinwnNNJlOA-EcVEDCBfplnnwV3UcGqCyistrWPWKn29kqPRkwSosWKEQuR80bMb39uaS7vOio55Kr5Dbm5ymaf0INQg3XddW330r5UKGGna5TqCF_J47Sr7TPtyxPOjzHskv2x0pMQcac43r4nU8J2CJAo7HeOKfqcOF5xZTi2RnRwpp9TL9l_nPFy6mfAAAA__8CamEl) in North Texas, Austin, San Antonio, and the Rio Grande Valley on Sunday as part of a nationwide initiative to deport illegal immigrants following President Trump’s inauguration last week. The operations [sparked protests in multiple jurisdictions](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOhCAURb8GOww8RaGg2MZutt3SPATHlyAYYceZv9_MZtvt7z05OV-3-YYUKd0_cQ-2Ptc8gwDFheSgZ48UX3PfeOuEN7IJVo6dFkOnlWk269zqenSo0YgwdtooH3ozoEMnexjWhuwbJiRoKUEr3RopB9UvGpQbxQiK9SJ4qvls6xZqeGJZ4ys_wtkueW-i3Wo9Cus-GEwMpuu62v1VMGGqOVF-jxhMKVyFwRTzgpHBhGelJQYGEy2Bn0i-cPwulRIvmPjflx9nrqHUwkEIpaUy7bEdzWn9cVGMVIaR9eK-I8Vfl_pvnIeFnwAAAP__mHxn0A). Demonstrators waved Mexican flags, chanted slogans, and carried signs reading, “Immigrants make America great” and “No one is illegal on stolen land.” Gov. Greg Abbott stated that Texas Department of Public Safety troopers were assisting federal law enforcement officials in “targeting and removing illegal immigrants,” adding that the operations are “expected to expand in the coming days.” Across the country, U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement [arrested 956 illegal immigrants](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kbHOozAQBp_GdBvBGoNdUFxD9197ZbRmF2Kdwci2QvL2p6S_ej6N9Gn-_Nx_KMRwbL9pl6m-1nTHFg20HaC9M4X4vvcNT75l1zUydaO27aCtcc1jWjSOxot3tkcezCjWj9wPTD2t3vHahOkjazu0XYfW2JvrusH0i0Xjx3ZEo_pWONSUb_UhVV5U1vhOT8m3Je1NnB61nkXpXwpnhfN1Xbe_chTzoQpnyjUsURTOh1xF4RzTQlHh_DUpnLf0hC3LBuR9qhVYzpjeBb4c-CxQc0qn5ALllCVQBNrkqAWolFAqPEqALHt6CoQYZaMIYd_DlukzKnQAHTUdISmccdTAznqtFwJtaIAeeQGHzGBZjDi7upV1kyc-rxBjKMOo-nbbKcTv3_rfAM8J_wUAAP__qu-KGg) and requested custody of 554 more being detained.
## Texas A&M to Limit New Undergrad Enrollment
Texas A&M University announced a [pause in undergraduate enrollment growth](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00DGPhCAQBeBfgx0GBlQsKK6x22uvNLgMSg5lg-O6--8vbn_dJJP35eX93Mabiylu87db0dIr5BEENFxIDmb0Lqb3qCtvJ-F7WaGVnTKiVabpq8VCKyaFbZBGB616YYJUWhvUSqGGYKpoL0xIMFKCaUzdS9k2-m6gmTrRQcO0QB8pl5oWJHy5PaR3fmKp73mtkl2IHjtTXwwGBsN5nvXvRK_ryWC4bAaDkNetGQwfgLuVH1t8YtkjvfkZU-IPd-zIj81jmYvzhyPkuJWc0oob8bnkkxYGQ1Wsf1yJuLcd02JeXUyfKvTvNk8LfwEAAP__90NlaQ) on its main campus for the next 5-7 years to address challenges arising from a 30% increase in the student body over the last decade. The College Station campus will limit enrollment of new undergraduate students to [15,000 a year](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2S4yAQhJ8GZeMCZCwICJwo20su2NA1FiOZKn50gFbW21_J-YYz3fV1V39_Pb7QB5-WPxjJtvecH5JLBVyA1A-HPhyPa-fskzsjOrJi6DW_9VqZ7mXVbDTns0FlzMzR9VxyN6ve8OnZ64k6b08YF1ILIbXSFyPETV0nLdVz4INU7MrJ-ZbLpb2o0RvrHI78Q-Uy5dgF-2ptray_MzkyOe77fok1nRqTIyXYKpNjzIkOJscJC1E5Px8QIERoGVbcKsGWHJWloNuwEVAqOYRIqcFS8t5eMOcC6rQPcBCWCjnBlEOghaA2bP68Ma6fRCxwv4v33-9_pSvWrbsPwdfbwK58iejDp3z7dc0fK_8HAAD__8DHeTE), expand the school’s public transit system, provide more space for pedestrian traffic, and add more student housing. The university will also spend $3 million a year over the next five years on hiring more faculty. [Two studies conducted last year,](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFuwyAURb8Gb1jwDDYeGLp4S9eOFoFHjAp2BCTEf18le_d7j47Oz2W9mBDDfvs2CXV9-WMFBpIyTkGtzoR4rqJz-srczDvUfBoUGwcl527TRnB0wnl0Xkx2dFfG1ehHO8xcWomsC_oNYxwU56Ck6mfORymsAnmd2ASSCIYu1CP3dcOKL1N8PI8n5t4eqYt6q_VeyPBFYCGwtNb6Ldw2zOhceOJ7RGDZsRUCy-dOTaLW3Cnu-Ygx4V5p2H02peaHrY-M1Bv7iPWkyeRf2jCWjcAyDUqAILB0Wbt7CzGGMk5EsFsyIX5k6r91nhr-AgAA__8XAmhp) which examined student experience and the university’s capacity to increase enrollment, informed the decisions. ## Jerry Jones: New Cowboys Head Coach a "Risk"
Dallas Cowboys owner Jerry Jones [introduced the team’s new head coach](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LHO4yAQBOCnwR3RsjYxLiiuocu1V1oYLzE5DBagJH77k6__u5FG-jSaP4_5YUMM6fnb7qTb1-cZASUHwVHNqw3xnIdu1Qusk-hIi7FXcO-VnLpNk3IEYEFNg3fOSVRWLogCrPfU974L-sJAoBIClVS3SYi7HJxCuYwwomQD0BpaLre2UaOvrT6e-U3l5vLeRb21dlTW_2JoGJp0Hrm2q2JoLpmhAXHlkaGpRy6tMjQvKuXkr5yo8pV8sKnxnLjLnyWflS8l2MSr23JrlDYKOxVeQv3L0HRFr8cnxBjqfWQDPHcb4v8t7cdz3hr_BQAA__9mymaN), Brian Schottenheimer, during a press event on Monday, acknowledging that hiring the longtime offensive coordinator with no head coaching experience is “as big a risk as you can take.” Fans and critics of the world’s most valuable sports franchise have [not been particularly impressed](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLHOpCAYAJ8GOwx8gGBBcY3dXnul-QR2IUExQNb17S_7938_mUzm32N9YMrpeP3FPdj-eZYVGCjKOAWzekz5XuXg7cb8zIdguRaGTcKoeYiWKQ5KeiHnDQOflTRKiZkz7acNtcMh2a-McTCcg1FmnDmflHQG1KaZBkUkCz71UsceQw8fbM98l3eooyv7kG3s_WxE_CGwEFiu6xr3u-GBRy9HKl-IwNLOUnsjsGDtyeVAYPGYMzbqyrWVu9EY0FNX0EXaXCy9hyOGtIdKgTFlhNDjGc-hWn9eKefUJk0ke-2Y8k9I__XM28L_AAAA__9DyWXo) with the unorthodox hire, and Jones' remarks on Monday did nothing to quiet the criticism. | A ncient Egyptian royals were often buried with objects they believed were needed for a harmonious transition to the afterlife. Items such as jewelry and games were common inclusions in their tombs, as were everyday staples such as clothing and food. And while we might expect any ancient food to decompose past the point of recognition, archaeologists have actually uncovered 3,000-year-old pots of honey that were, remarkably, intact — [and still edible](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sqss38&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com).

## The bear that inspired Winnie-the-Pooh preferred condensed milk.
Winnie-the-Pooh is often seen in books or cartoons with a paw in a jar of honey. But the real-life bear that Pooh was based on preferred a different sweet snack: [condensed milk and, sometimes, corn syrup](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sqss38&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com). The inspiration for the _Winnie-the-Pooh_ children’s book was a Canadian black bear cub who was adopted by a soldier named Harry Colebourn during World War I. Colebourn named the bear after his hometown of Winnipeg — “Winnie” for short — and trained the bear with rewards of condensed milk and corn syrup. He eventually donated the bear to the London Zoo, where she became a popular attraction. Local author A.A. Milne’s son, Christopher Robin Milne, often visited the zoo and became smitten with Winnie, spending time with her and doling out one of her favorite snacks: condensed milk.

name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 1/28/2025
body:
DEA operation in Adams Co. focusing on Tren de Aragua drug traffickers ends in arrests of nearly 50 illegals
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi everyone,
Here is a summary of today's top stories:
**🏛️ Colorado Legislative Session Updates...** Rep. Stephanie Luck's bipartisan House Bill 25-1069, which seeks to create an online forum for legislative transparency, gained [unanimous committee approval](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and moves to the Appropriations Committee. Meanwhile, in today's legislator spotlight, [Rep. Dan Woog](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) draws on his collegiate hockey background to push for pragmatic solutions, including affordable housing and public safety reforms in his district spanning Weld and Boulder counties.
**🏔️ Here in Colorado...** Federal agents raided a makeshift nightclub operated by the Venezuelan Tren de Aragua gang, seizing drugs, weapons, and cash, and detaining [50 illegal immigrants](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** President Trump used [tariff threats](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to pressure Colombia into accepting deportation flights, securing a diplomatic win as part of his broader immigration enforcement strategy. Also, the Senate prepares for a contentious hearing on Trump’s [controversial FBI nominee](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), Kash Patel.
🗣️ **Commentary Spotlight...** A guest column by C. J. Garbo highlights the dangers of excessive taxation and the need for [transparent budgeting practices](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to rebuild trust in government. Another commentary by Jimmy Sengenberger criticizes Colorado Secretary of State Jena Griswold for alleged [campaign finance violations](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) during her unofficial gubernatorial campaign launch.
This is the Mountain Minute for Tuesday, January 28, 2025.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[DEA operation in Adams Co. focusing on Tren de Aragua drug traffickers ends in arrests of nearly 50 illegals](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [FOX NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Federal agents took nearly 50 illegal immigrants into custody early Sunday during an operation targeting the Venezuelan gang Tren de Aragua (TdA)’s networks in Colorado.
The Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) Rocky Mountain Field Division said its agents, as well as partners at the Denver offices for Homeland Security Investigations (HSI), U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE), and the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives (ATF) conducted an early morning operation targeting drug trafficking and TdA members in Adams County, Colorado.
The early morning raid targeted what federal authorities deemed a “makeshift nightclub” in Adams County that was “invite-only.” The DEA said “dozens connected to the Tren de Aragua (TdA) gang were there.”

|

**[Rep. Luck’s bill to increase transparency in legislation gains broad committee support](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Rep. Stephanie Luck's House Bill 25-1069, which creates an online forum for lawmakers to share drafts and bill titles with the public before the legislative session begins, received unanimous committee approval.
* The bill, co-sponsored by Democrat Eliza Hamrick, garnered praise from both parties, the League of Women Voters, and transparency advocates for empowering citizens and fostering legislative accountability.
* An amendment delays the bill's startup until 2028 to eliminate financial impact concerns, while seven other states have already implemented similar measures.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[‘Top shelf’ lawmaker Rep. Dan Woog finds inspiration at capitol from his collegiate hockey past](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Rep. Dan Woog, a former collegiate hockey player, attributes his resilience and perseverance in politics to lessons learned on the ice, such as teamwork and overcoming setbacks.
* Representing Boulder and Weld Counties, Woog focuses on bridging ideological divides through active listening, advocating for affordable housing, and supporting public safety initiatives like expanding juvenile detention capacity.
* Woog co-sponsored bills to address unnecessary fees on consumers, including delivery fees and the bag fee, and encourages citizen involvement in shaping legislation to reflect grassroots priorities.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Sengenberger: Wannabe guv Jena Griswold stumbles into announcing](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_Secretary of State Jena Griswold wants Colorado voters to make her governor. While the state’s top campaign finance cop hasn’t thrown a swanky launch party yet, she’s already announced her run — allegedly by breaking the very rules she’s supposed to enforce._
_As The Denver Gazette reported, the Public Trust Institute filed a complaint on Jan. 14, alleging Griswold “expended funds on a gubernatorial campaign and had a website dedicated to a gubernatorial run but has not registered a committee or filed a candidate affidavit for governor.”_
_The domain — jenaforgovernor.com — was purchased on Aug. 8. A placeholder webpage went live the next day, copyrighted by “Jena for Governor,” declaring “Launching Soon” and asking visitors to submit their email addresses “to be the first to get updates.”_
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Garbo: When taxation becomes extortion, we should expose the abuse of power in Colorado’s budget crisis](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_Taxation, at its core, is meant to serve a noble purpose. Governments levy taxes to fund essential services, protect citizens, and ensure the infrastructure of a functioning society._
_However, there is a fine line between taxation and extortion — a line that is crossed when the power to tax is abused, funds are squandered, and citizens are burdened with excessive financial demands for the benefit of a select few._
_When those in power exploit taxation to enrich themselves, preserve their influence or mask fiscal irresponsibility, taxation ceases to be a tool for the public good and devolves into an instrument of oppression. This dangerous shift is not new, nor is it without profound moral and spiritual implications._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

**[Letter asks Gov. Polis to lead repeal of three laws he signed which created state immigration sanctuary](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY BRIAN PORTER****| STATE | JANUARY 25** _Whether Gov. Jared Polis means what he says is the subject of a recent joint letter from three Republican members of the U.S. House to the governor._ __

**[Garfield County commissioners ‘demand a pause’ in wolf reintroduction program](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY LINDY BROWNING****| STATE | JANUARY 24** _Tom Jankovsky, Mike Samson and Perry Will are setting the standard._ _The Garfield County commissioners are doing what some say commissioners in every county should do for their constituencies who voted against the 2020 ballot initiative to reintroduce wolves to Western Colorado._ __

Not only did he immediately rescind Biden-era COVID policies, he went on to withdraw America from the WHO, prohibit gain of function research, remove Dr. Fauci’s security detail, and end the requirement for immigrants to get the COVID vaccine as a condition of citizenship. These demonstrative moves signal that the next four years will involve **historic wins for medical liberty**. Meanwhile, in the **Texas House of Representatives** , the 89th session has had a **lackluster start** in that regard. House rules were rushed through last Thursday, leaving the potential for anyone attending a committee hearing or visiting the House gallery to be subject to a mask mandate. This blatant and **tone deaf disregard** for medical liberty will not be soon forgotten; those who voted to keep this rule intact should be called out for their **failure to protect** Texans’ rights!

| Peter, It’s been just over a week since he was inaugurated, and Trump is already fulfilling his campaign promise to crack down on the border crisis. This is THE issue more than any other that drove record numbers of voters to elect him – including here in New Jersey, where Kamala Harris eked by on the smallest margin of any Democratic Presidential candidate in decades. After Trump’s big win, we saw 2025 Democratic gubernatorial candidates falling over themselves to assure us that they DO want to secure the border and they are ALL about law and order. But 7 days into Trump’s Presidency, the shiny new branding is fading as they just can’t resist lambasting their favorite punching bag. As they do, they show us their true colors once again.

Within hours of his inauguration on January 20, President Trump signed an executive order titled, "Ending Radical and Wasteful Government DEI Programs and Referencing." President Trump stated in his order, "The Biden Administration forced illegal and immoral discrimination programs, going by the name 'diversity, equity, and inclusion' (DEI), into virtually all aspects of the Federal Government, in areas ranging from airline safety to the military."
Conservatives recognize that these Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) programs are nothing more than thinly veiled attempts to drive our country into poverty and chaos by forcing employers to hire unqualified workers. These initiatives have also become a breeding ground for the "re-education" of conservatives, pushing a liberal agenda onto businesses and their employees.
President Trump promised to halt this slide into mediocrity by terminating these programs within the government and removing the obligation for companies to comply with Biden's demands. Shortly after his inauguration, we witnessed companies, banks, and government agencies begin to dismantle these destructive programs.
However, one company, Costco, has stubbornly refused to end these harmful and illegal programs, despite court rulings declaring them violations of the law. Costco clings to its liberal ideology, resisting change.
Recently, [19 state Attorneys General sent a letter to Costco](https://substack.com/redirect/3568b9e8-3650-4e37-bb59-2a8e7cdc27fa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), warning that DEI policies which discriminate based on race are illegal. They demanded that Costco alter their policy within 30 days and provide an explanation for not abandoning these programs.
Conspicuously absent from the list of these conservative Attorneys General is Mississippi Attorney General Lynn Fitch. AG Fitch has once again abandoned the conservative principles she claims to represent. The people of Mississippi deserve to understand why their Attorney General is not upholding the conservative values on which she was elected. We have a right to know whether she supports these discriminatory and illegal practices endorsed by Joe Biden or the conservative principles championed by Donald Trump.
Could her continued involvement and even leadership role in the National Association of Attorneys General [(NAAG)](https://substack.com/redirect/d5bb65b4-9b2b-437f-8c4c-ad04ede5d87d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), an organization criticized for its leftward shift, indicate that her ideology aligns more with Joe Biden and Kamala Harris than with the conservative people of Mississippi and President Trump?
The people of Mississippi need to demand clarity: will Attorney General Lynn Fitch defend conservative principles and uphold the law, or does her liberal ideology take precedence?

_**A message from our sponsor...**_

| | | Peter, Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its [**National Referendum on the Administrative State**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=bf83fb31317f49bc80a641b8fb3ef7de&_e=wzHjCxierTn8_n7yGHQ6D-D_jFInSqAkNhjm2myNxN4Ihw3IwdtL41i0tzCEkPhcHzFOxU6CEriKom373YiP6KaOwMP75U88j2CMWY6N2hr2kZl9BveUbRpP8x3jAzA8H2cd4tN02lLqBf7udoL9JO7Ynk31cwlQx8YmFiY4eaIiq3373MU_u6VE44PnfpkiRQRlinoNCgF1feNw5-XBiLOdJNxLd57OuF7McLjFjCBwraq9XS4FDeDjmNq5GBu7mNyTgxnkba5ZxMpK1Y3g_bDaNEUbnK7L6jxVIRsXHVZwv3ntqkVC5_w2rxh_c9D8yzFTjObOGEdrHp0s7klJSIFVEKbjubD0JJuVcKSzWbnjEy5eV_v4ebiF1BXPqmflmP_BBVQf86QD6XQ4b7wLhlWtPpwRQAgfZ-FsWpLriyE%3D).

Responding will only take a few minutes. Your input as an informed patriot is needed right away...because **our country is facing a constitutional crisis**.

It's a crisis that involves a fundamental political question: **who rules whom?**

The Constitution established a limited government in which the **people** ruled through their elected officials. Under this form of government, America became the freest and most prosperous nation in history.

Today, however, our constitutional system is one that increasingly exists in name only. **The Constitution of "We the People" is being replaced by an elite, out-of-touch, and unaccountable administrative state that rules without the consent of American citizens.** This means we live in an era of growing bureaucratic despotism, manifested in an administrative state that bypasses the Constitution, rejects the separation of powers, and replaces the rule of law with regulations.

**But we can 't just TALK about the problem. We also have to TAKE ACTION--to DO SOMETHING about it, while there's still time to save our country. **

That is why I'm writing to you today.

Hillsdale College is committed to returning to the Constitution of "We the People"--before it's too late.

To do that, I need your input. What are your opinions on this topic--knowing that we can propose SOLUTIONS that will restore liberty?

**Please let me know your thoughts today by answering the National Referendum on the Administrative State using this secure link:**

**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/administrative-state-survey](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=bf83fb31317f49bc80a641b8fb3ef7de&_e=wzHjCxierTn8_n7yGHQ6D-D_jFInSqAkNhjm2myNxN4Ihw3IwdtL41i0tzCEkPhcHzFOxU6CEriKom373YiP6KaOwMP75U88j2CMWY6N2hr2kZl9BveUbRpP8x3jAzA8H2cd4tN02lLqBf7udoL9JO7Ynk31cwlQx8YmFiY4eaIiq3373MU_u6VE44PnfpkiRQRlinoNCgF1feNw5-XBiLOdJNxLd57OuF7McLjFjCBwraq9XS4FDeDjmNq5GBu7mNyTgxnkba5ZxMpK1Y3g_dU84FondbDPlAkS_8l3Suk5BZmhrT89w8TNQl_L2YmGHrt-4rGJKCD5LlLFvJUdxmhQt5Sk6ChnCmMBtJ_xIBnqxK1OljDwYvMeRRQeuIgpSv5JBZYyWslEhWpzObGfKYELh9O6k_1pLIg1q06O1pI%3D)**

When you send in your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

The rise of the administrative state is a grave threat to our country.

To counter this threat, Hillsdale sponsors several educational outreach efforts--including _Imprimis_ , free online courses, programs on our Washington, D.C., campus, and a growing network of classical K-12 schools and homeschoolers--to teach citizens about the meaning of the Constitution and the importance of our founding principles of liberty.

Your gift of at least $15--or even $25, $35, $50, $100, or more if you're especially motivated to TAKE ACTION--will help us to expand these educational initiatives that are reaching and teaching millions.

Your support of these efforts is essential because Hillsdale refuses to take ONE PENNY of government funding.

So please complete your **National Referendum on the Administrative State** and consider giving your most generous tax-deductible contribution.

Thank you for being on the side of the Constitution and liberty!

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

**P.S.** I look forward to receiving your opinions about what's happening in our nation. And I hope that you can support our work.

So please complete the **National Referendum on the Administrative State** using this secure link:

**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/administrative-state-survey](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=bf83fb31317f49bc80a641b8fb3ef7de&_e=wzHjCxierTn8_n7yGHQ6D-D_jFInSqAkNhjm2myNxN4Ihw3IwdtL41i0tzCEkPhcHzFOxU6CEriKom373YiP6KaOwMP75U88j2CMWY6N2hr2kZl9BveUbRpP8x3jAzA8H2cd4tN02lLqBf7udoL9JO7Ynk31cwlQx8YmFiY4eaIiq3373MU_u6VE44PnfpkiRQRlinoNCgF1feNw5-XBiLOdJNxLd57OuF7McLjFjCBwraq9XS4FDeDjmNq5GBu7mNyTgxnkba5ZxMpK1Y3g_dp5vjoS0D5mw2xaut3DHWhlJ9Wakf_0zvBiv1uMpCVwG1vUTovRhbfuQrcJV6zNBHkPxFmqigMUgD3H007hh9MG89ttxAk7nEqiQeXI89z-WpaPnagUFf2rwlTP4Nkg70aiTYHYNt6q1d8cGbwXZiw%3D)**

As soon as you respond, we will begin your FREE lifetime subscription to _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's digest of liberty that you will receive via email ten times a year. If you'd like, you can also sign up to receive the publication through postal mail.

Educating millions about the Constitution to counter the threat from the administrative state is a monumental task. That's why when you complete your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Thank you for your time and attention--and for your commitment to liberty.

## China AI Rival Rocks U.S. Tech Stocks
U.S. tech stocks faced a historic $1 trillion selloff Monday after Chinese artificial intelligence startup [DeepSeek unveiled an AI model](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00DGvpCAUBeBfg901cHFkLCi2sXvbbmkYuOjdh2iAjJl_v3H7153kJF9Ozp-v5ctx4rz-djvZFo8FJT5AKsDnEhynzzJ0wUYiJN2RVUY_pRme0nSbjYaGaVReox4ewXiNavSSIo5-kmoaO7a3JhU-1aA1yj4SOjKP16RI-XGSYpAUuB2l_3twbhvF9DneVHp_7F2yW2tnFfqXwFngfF1X7_PL36XA-aYFzlLd2Qic85sDO4gupQpKnlQ85Qac4Sy0u_JNDVpxgfMKroLfOLsKgeisRN_QCq8rlQprOl4uQSO_QaWU4Iix39qeumLDeXFKXEcjBrnujtP_qe2n694W_wUAAP__cQ9wzA) developed for just $6 million in two months—without using Nvidia's premium chips. The news sent Nvidia shares plunging 17% in early trading, resulting in a market cap loss of nearly $600 billion—[the largest single-day loss](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00LvOnDAQhuGrMd0gezgXLtLQbdqUyOABJmtsZHsXcfcR6f9uikevRt-f1_Qy7Nhvv81BOq9hQokNSAXYT9awu6e6sHolQqoK0qqretnVveyKXa_LsHbSkrJN0-OCnVFqUNRiM8i2afuC9VOTCntVVxXKciU01DXzoEgt7SBFLclyDrH8G9jnnVZ3hy_FcglH4fSe85lE9UvgKHC8rqv08-LpukN8P0Tg6OlKAsf5k9hTes4jeLoh0hlifsCXLRtIO9kExh0hZWilhJmd4-CBPRwmvinDYk6YedsoZQiewJobXEjpIR9IsHPKId4Cx1ZhVfdK4FhEbc_rSaW2E7XcDsPu__f5pzW_Gv8FAAD__6gQd-c) in U.S. market history. Other tech giants, including Microsoft, Meta, and Tesla, also fell sharply. China's DeepSeek quickly surged to the top of Apple's App Store, surpassing OpenAI's ChatGPT. However, on Monday, the company reported experiencing "[large-scale malicious attacks](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kL1uwzAMhJ_G3hxQlGzJg4Yu2dK1o0FJVMJW_oEtJMjbF-7e8e6Aw4fv6zbdSIos90-a2de8TgjYd6A6dFMiKe_JtMlnZmTdsldWO7DGgW0fXjkAowGI9Jhz5lFHRtOPqCMFp0Mr_nwDhU4ZrREumZHY9mFUrOIwQmOAk9R1v3yvstQH5_Jen7xf4jq3xT9q3Y5GfzR4bfBK28Kv45zOsFeJhRu8JubtYP7pSLqzzRKFSidL5VLkzkvkLrBRhiKlkHUPFpIdTJ95zCG5bAbT7j5tLylFjsE2Bu4zSfmDqP9JeXr8DQAA__90F2Nf)" on its services, which led to temporary limitations on new user registrations. The market reaction came just days after President Trump announced a $500 billion [AI initiative called Stargate](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOqzAQRb_GdEbjMbFJ4eI1dHntlmjAQ-KNwch2gvL3K7bf7kpXOkc6X7fxRiGG7f6fVnZ1SSMCXiQoif3oKcTP2DXeLczIumGnrO7Bdj3Y5uFmmBRfYbZgjVGdQUOkUSlPk_dG6ya4kwYKe9VpjdAujMT2Ml0Vq9lcQXTAPtSU2-8UtvrgJX7Sm3M7p7WJ7lHrXoT-J3AQOBzH0c5T2fgo5y9wOKfAoebXustSKd-psqQg084bBVnSUifanjJlmiPL9VWeAocmO78fIcZQjBUd3FcK8VdZ_0rwdvgTAAD__9URXuI), raising questions about the massive investments being funneled into U.S. artificial intelligence development compared to the low cost of developing DeepSeek.
## Trump Takes On Military Policy
President Donald Trump is expected to sign new executive orders to [reinstate troops dismissed](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFuhDAQRL_GdEb2wrFQuEhDd2lTIp-93G1kMDI-CH8fOX26V4zejObrPt0tB16fn3Yhk-c4gYKbVFpCP3nL4ZraypuZCKipyGhseoVtr7B6mUGBszO0YB_W461Bj-jsY-gIHWhPFZtiUxp63TYNqHomsIS3x6BJu25QolXkOcdUf0de84vmcMWDUu3iUgXzynnbRfMhYBQwnudZv3ebo7dXCQgY9xzTJWBc6dwFjFsMnNkVLMUCRqULo4Axp_eySfoh9858kIzJU5KeWC4cONt0SRcP9vKwzvFKu8wpxq24EIcOAQaliqhKxm8nh8B7h6JVz8Vy-Buc_zvwMPAbAAD__05gce4) for refusing the COVID-19 vaccine and to remove military diversity and equity (DEI) programs, among other changes to the military. Newly sworn-in Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth arrived at the Pentagon for his first day and told reporters that [additional actions addressing](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFuwyAQQL_G3rCOwxh7YOiSLV07WjQc8bU4REBC_fdVund_ek96H-f17Djy7frudrI1pBUBtQApcF6943isY-9tIEJSPVlp1AxmnMH0m6XFjMtkpuA0aDc5mjEo0mZGD1o537N92UDiLEelEIZA6Mjoz0WSvEwLdCOQ55ry8JX4VjcK8UhPysMl7X20W6330qm3Dk8dnlprw41aaUTfL6DDU82P_S52jlxdPgT90OVR-UkiZU-5iI2uheomAudShXeHQECpEfps_b1xjFwm041w3R3Hv2r978LT4m8AAAD__zvLX_0) the admission of transgender troops and the development of a U.S. version of the Israeli “Iron Dome” are also anticipated. This latest wave of executive orders is part of Trump’s effort to reinstate previous military policies, eliminate Biden-era guidelines, and focus on [prioritizing readiness](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLHO4yAQhJ8Gd1iw4EAKimvc5dorLQzrZE8YLIzj89ufkv7vZjTS6NP35zE9PCXKz99-RdeWMoGAgQvJwU7RU7om3UW3IAKqDp00ygqjrTDdy0Xwiw1Bq6BFNMsy2FmAMlYOxmrpVUfu8yYkWKmVAtEvCB7NMN8lynC7C6YFRmql9n8L5fbCJV3ljbUPZe2Se7W27Uz9YjAyGM_z7PMcMp77Z2cw5jnwcjQGYzka30qiRmHnPsdvCReDsdVj3Tj-w3A0eiMvNWLlrfq8PzF_8kqJmq8Xj0i8huylvWsjuuridlJKtN8M0-K5ekpfsPaTqLeD_wEAAP__iCZs1A) and lethality.
## Holocaust Survivors Gather at Auschwitz
Survivors of the Auschwitz concentration camp gathered with world leaders and European royalty in Poland on Monday to commemorate [the 80th anniversary](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOszAQhJ8GOqL12timcPE36fK3V6LFrMPeORAZJ1Hu6U9cf92MRhp9-j4u44Uky3r9TzcONW0jAvYdqA79OJPk92jaOSRmZN1yUE57cMaDa5fge681Ka_JKlRoeYKkvI7aQoqRUyvheAOFXhmtEU6Jkdj106BYRTtAY4BnqVs5fW6y1oVTfm9PLqe43docllrve6P_NXhu8Ez3lV_7MR2lVImZj_TY4_KS-t1NUr54pUfnoS4dras8uexU3t00DwAmJtezdcOgB8M2OTMrMxlyBtsS5vtLcpbdusbA9UaSfyHqX1KeAX8CAAD__w47Yl4) of the camp’s liberation. Fifty-six Holocaust survivors attended the [International Holocaust Remembrance Day](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0z7GOhCAUheGngW4MXFCwoNjGbrbd0iBcxrtBMUrGzDz9xu2nO8lJvuT_uY93T5nWx7df0NVURhDQ3oS8gR2jp_waNY8uIQIqjk4aZYXRVhg-uz54hGQxmNTpFDWY1PUQbYspxSgVJ3dpQoKVWikQTULwaNqplyhD1wumBUaqZW9-C611xpRf5Yl7E8rCs5tr3Q6mvhgMDIbzPJtpCtfHYFjxPBgMfq8UMl4zgNiU2t5qexe-u7idlDMdnWFaPBZP-V-tnyqfDv4CAAD__9z9VCw) event, warning the world of the dangers of intolerance and antisemitism on the site where the Nazis murdered 1.1 million people between 1941 and 1945. Eva Umlauf, a pediatrician from Munich, was just two years old when she received the tattoo [A-26,959](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00DHvpCAUBPBPox0GHipYUFxjt9deaRCe67sgbIDV7H76i9f_u0l-yWQyfx7Lw1Kg-PxtDzR1SwtwGBgXDPTiLYXP0rfebIiAskUjlNRc9ZqrdjdCrAo4B-fdOgkY1pHjgKMalUQ_TLIlc7dxAVr0UgLvNgSLalgngcKNE296jp5qyt3fRLHuuIVPOjF3Lh1tMHutr9LIXw3MDczXdXVxdRGvcnsD8x1vSDn4Bmb7Lm6_qH5ZeeeTzpQL05x90ObCov0S82jrzpw9XizQitlWSpFlF63QWgnZZuNfF4VAZVRNz5-HpfB_TP3pnNPAvwAAAP__91xnrQ). She attended the ceremony with her family, believing it was her moral responsibility. “ _They have to know that it’s true_ ,” she said. Approximately 220,000 Holocaust survivors—25,000 fewer than last year—live in about 90 countries, signaling that this is [the last generation of survivors](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00DFvwyAUBOBfAxvW44GDMzB08ZauHS0CzzEVDhEQu_73lbt3O-mk76T7uk03F1N8Pj7dSrbNeULAXoAUOEzBxXRMmgc7EyEpTlYaNYDRAxi-2IAwyNn36grK46X3vQaHDvwddCA0PNpTA4mD1EohdDOhI9Pfr5Kkv1yBaaAQWy7dd47PttCcjrxR6XxeebJLa6_K1AfDkeG473vnfmKuZ8twPG2GI8gzG4bjklP27l2bKLTSei_u6UkEd4j6Llvccqki1uIoiXflxYbXHlOK9WKYhsfqYvrbbf_9sFn8DQAA___QWl7r), according to the Conference on Jewish Material Claims Against Germany.

"Dirtbags like this will continue to be removed from our streets," she commented.
This raid is part of a broader effort across the U.S., where ICE has made 1,179 arrests in a single day and issued 853 detainers requesting that local authorities hand over illegal immigrants in custody for federal processing. I grew up moving from place to place, often not knowing where we would sleep or if my brother and I would eat dinner that night. I worked hard to put myself through college and medical school before serving as the Director of the Department of Health. Unlike most of our leaders, I don’t believe the answer to fixing our state is giving politicians more power — **the answer is giving hardworking families more freedom.** Our families deserve better than political games and self-serving politicians that stand in the way of making real change for Ohioans. That’s because the problems we face don’t care if you’re a Democrat or a Republican. They just need fixing. And that’s exactly how I plan to serve as Governor. I’ll fight to lower costs, make our communities safer and more business friendly, and give power back to the people...not politicians. But I can’t do this alone. This race is going to be tough, and I will need all the help I can get. = | = "" | = "" | = "" | = "" Sincerely, Dr. Amy Acton = = = OHDC 340 E. Kathy Salvi, pictured in 2022 at a downtown Chicago press conference. (Pat Nabong/Sun-Times)
By Illinois Review

Illinois Republican State Sen. Dan McConchie, 26th Dist., announced on Monday that he would be resigning from the legislature on February 2nd to lead the nonprofit organization, Accessibility Policy Institute – but it’s his recommendation to replace him that’s causing concern amongst Republican circles.

According to GOP State Rep. Martin McLaughlin, 52nd Dist. – McConchie is recommending that IL GOP chair Kathy Salvi’ son, Joseph, replace him as the next state senator.

McConchie served a brief term as the Senate Minority Leader, but resigned from his position after Republicans were humiliated in the 2022 general election.

During the pandemic, McConchie supported the expansion of COVID-19 vaccinations for vulnerable populations and he sponsored legislation to protect health care providers from being held responsible for COVID-19 related deaths and injuries.

name: Douglas Carswell
subject: Advancing School Choice in Mississippi
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/advancingschoolchoice?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
| Dear Friend, I am super excited that the Mississippi House of Representatives is proposing a bill that would significantly advance School Choice in Mississippi. I wanted to update you on what this might mean.

In 2024, MCPP spearheaded efforts to reform school funding so that every public school student has a personalized education budget. Having achieved this, we want to ensure each student can take their personal budget to a public school of their choice.

This public to public School Choice is now on the legislative agenda. We also expect to see a proposal for public to private School Choice, through a limited Education Savings Account.

As we are advancing the case for School Choice, we are starting to see a concerted push back from anti School Choice activists. I thought it would be helpful to once again share with you the case for change so that you can help us to counter any misinformation.
**The Case for School Choice**
What do you think it costs to send a child to public school in Hinds County every year? $5,000 per year? Or maybe $10,000? $15,000?

Actually, according to data from the Mississippi Department of Education, when you divide the number of students attending school by the total expenditure, in 2023-24 Hinds County spent $16,589 per student.

That is more than twice the average private school fees in our state. Indeed, $16,589 is not far off what it would cost to send your child to one of the state’s top private schools.

Now ask yourself if each child in Hinds County is getting a top education for that $16,589? Of course not. A large chunk of the kids can’t read or do basic math. One in three of them regularly skip school.

Why not give families in Hinds County the right to take a portion of that $16,589 and allocate it to a school of their choice?

It’s not just Hinds County. The same kind of questions could be asked in Madison ($17,037 spent for every public school pupil per year) or Rankin ($15,198 per pupil per year), or from Canton ($18,683) or De Soto ($13,820).

Even if you take the Department of Education’s own more conservative figure for per pupil spending (which includes all the ‘no-show’ students), Mississippi still spends an average of $14,676 per student.
**Status quo is not great**
Despite all that money, 4 in 10 fourth graders in Mississippi public schools cannot read properly. Eight in 10 eighth grade kids in Mississippi were not proficient in math in 2022. One in 4 kids routinely skips school.

Nor has $14,676 per student spending translated into better teacher pay. Notwithstanding the recent pay increase for Mississippi teachers, our teachers still earn significantly less than they did in 2010, when you adjust for inflation.

If you happen to be one of the fortunate families happy with the public education options available, great. No need to change and no one is proposing any changes that will affect you. But why not allow those families unhappy with the way things are the ability to take their tax dollars to a school that best meets their needs?

Suggesting this provokes outrage not from parents, but from various vested interests who like things the way they are. They like a system that puts the $14,676 they get for your child into their administration budget, rather than the classroom.

We should not be surprised that many school superintendents support a system that means they make more than the Governor. That does not make their arguments against School Choice right.
**What the anti School Choice lobby say**
School Choice will not impoverish public schools. The legislation that is being proposed would allow families control over the state portion of funding, not locally raised revenues or federal dollars.

In Hinds County, for example, that would mean families being able to allocate no more than $6,700 of the $16,589 overall per pupil funding. (Rather than depleting Hinds county public schools’ budget, actually it would make Hinds County better off in terms of per pupil spend.)

Giving families control over $6,700 of the state funds will not mean a flood of kids coming into your well run school district. Why not? Because the legislation proposed specifically gives school boards the final say on capacity, and allows individual schools strong safeguards enabling them to say “no” to would be transferees with disciplinary issues.

What anti School Choice campaigners really fear is not the “wrong” kids coming to your school. What they fear is that you start wondering what the heck they’ve been doing with the $14,676 they get for your child or grandchild every year.
**Mississippi is surrounded by School Choice States**
All of the arguments we are now hearing against School Choice in Mississippi have been heard in each of the surrounding states that have since adopted School Choice.

Alabama’s new Educations Savings Account program, which has just opened for applications, has been wildly oversubscribed. The program provides $7,000 funding per student attending a participating private school, while those enrolled in home education programs are eligible for $2,000 per student.

Arkansas allows all K-12 students access to an Education Savings Account from 2025, into which the state government pays the state portion of per pupil funding ($6,600 per year). Families will be able to use this $6,600 money they are given to pay for their child education, including private school tuition. Arkansas also allows public to public school transfers, allowing districts to define capacity.

Louisiana’s GATOR program starts in 2025-26 and establishes an Education Savings Account for those on low incomes, with the details are still being finalized as the law only recently passed. Louisiana already has public to public School Choice.

Texas and Tennessee, too, are at this very moment debating legislation that would create a universal Education Savings Account for families in those states, too.

None of the scare stories we now hear in Mississippi materialised in any of these neighboring states. Instead, early evidence suggests School Choice has started to improve education outcomes.

**__Three cheers for Speaker Jason White and those bold conservative leaders in the legislature pushing for School Choice in our state!__**

Here is also a one page summary showing the progress other surrounding states have made on School Choice compared to us...

clean_body: As Trump returns to power, CNN is running scared from its journalistic mission. Peter, Something is very wrong at CNN. Last week, the network announced it was cutting 6% of its staff. Now, after a public clash with Donald Trump, longtime anchor Jim Acosta has announced he’s leaving the network. Peter, at a time when Donald Trump’s norm-breaking, authoritarian presidency demands bold, fact-based journalism, CNN is cutting resources and making troubling choices that signal they’re not up to the task. = What’s happening at CNN? Acosta’s departure—and the events that led to it—reveal a network retreating from its journalistic responsibility to rise to the moment. Here’s what we mean: Jim Acosta was banned from the pressroom during Trump’s previous administration for asking tough questions. Recently, he was pushed to a midnight time slot in a clear attempt to appease Trump. Rather than accept this demotion, Acosta chose to leave CNN altogether. Jake Tapper and Anderson Cooper , two of the network’s most vocal critics of Trump, were reportedly directed by their boss to not express outrage during their inauguration coverage and to cover Trump with an “open mind.” Tapper’s coverage was noticeably tepid on Inauguration Day, backing these reports. During the campaign, CNN treated Trump with kid gloves while admitting they were holding Kamala Harris to a higher standard. Many critics, including COURIER, called out the network for the biased coverage. Why this matters CNN’s demise leaves an already desolate news media landscape without yet another important source for trustworthy, factual news. The network is now in serious danger of becoming yet another purveyor of toothless infotainment, “both sides” coverage, and reporting that bows to Trump instead of staying true to journalism’s pro-democracy mission. That’s where COURIER comes in We don’t answer to billionaires, Donald Trump, ratings, or clicks. Our work is grounded in ethics and a belief that facts and truth are essential to democracy. = = While legacy media bends, COURIER is standing firm.
