subject: Saving the Easter Bunny
body:
| [View in Web Browser](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8kE1v4jAQhn-NcyMajxM7OfgAyxppt0JVUSv16MQGjGJi7HyI_voKSrnOPDPvo1f70Ln9VRKxIohHZxJBJGxJEC-fs4_jyf_fLCjf_ltc-NaXty3-eaATPuFzq8PLateX692cBP8aTxvxNtEnPlyDfcKP0Nx67brbVKwzI9neQJFZSQWroKK8xuwoQVBTW8awgVpozXVZN01rCsrqRjMOmZMIWALFinLkBeYF8KYuCwABFBjVpIB7Tq69ja7VNA2zjrHvfd72PuvkcRhCuospgmqOfX4e286O6ees7T1B9VAmqCaC6rCvPtLfyJQhTN1LY-ulDeb9VQSTRWnC7LrOJS5IAYffN9kk8TsAAP__UdltpQ)
| | Brave Books is spearheading a massive "Prepare the Way" revival campaign to shift the focus of Easter from bunnies and chocolate...
---
| |
---
| | Fellow Believer, It may seem a little early to be talking about Easter, but it's really only about 12 weeks away. And in that short amount of time, my friends at Brave Books are spearheading a massive "Prepare the Way" campaign to shift the focus of Easter from bunnies and chocolate... ...to Jesus. And this revival mission needs you! My friend, if you've seen me talking about Brave Books on Fox News, you know their mission is to counter the ungodly lies being pushed by the Left in schools, libraries, and Hollywood... ...by creating high-quality, wholesome, and Godly books and entertainment that instill conservative values and Gospel lessons in our children. And their "Prepare the Way" revival campaign is their biggest effort yet to point parents and children to the empty tomb and God’s redeeming love. Here’s exactly what their strategy is... First... Brave Books knows that families need an easy and impactful way to counter the Left's secularization of Easter and instead, captivate children with its true meaning. So, they created _Saving the Easter Bunny_ , a brand-new children's book that's destined to be a classic. In it, Ronnie the Rabbit learns the hard way what sin is and that our Lord Jesus Christ loves us so much that he took the punishment for that sin. Jesus is represented by a powerful lion named Lord Joshua and the book beautifully portrays his resurrection and God's never-ending redeeming love for us. It's incredible. And let me tell you, parents are hungry for content like this because everywhere they turn godlessness is being pushed by schools, left-wing publishers like Scholastic, and Hollywood. When Brave Books first introduced a God-centered Christmas game called "_Mouse in the House_ ," to counter the secular elf game that has become so popular -- it sold out in THREE HOURS! That's why step one of Brave Books' 12-week "Prepare the Way" revival, is ramping up the printing and distribution of _Saving the Easter Bunny_ big-time. **[And today I'm hoping you'll help them kick it into high gear before orders start pouring in by rushing back your best "Prepare the Way" gift.](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j01v4yAQhn8NvmENAwb74EOzjiPtRw9JVWlPETakoWtiF38p--srIisXJJ55NO-82g-du9xLonYE8erMSBAJfyGIX39XH-ZP_-tAmXz9Sb_kq8_iFH9s6oJP-dbq4ffu1GfVaR2V_D9_HtRxYU99ug_2KW-hqfXadZGqKjElvxgQiS2Z4jnkTBaYXEvJtEQmlSkk49DkeWM0gFLQAsttrhJXImAGDHMmUQpMBcimyASAAgacaSLgkZNqb4NrNRunVYfQ9z5te5905XWahvFxWE2wHm07B5vqmzX9FA2CdRP0YmnT9_9GgjUWUjADhhrNNBVZATQHdaFZA9jaRmjJMe7i9Tz589jPobWEV7vqQI_7d4IyYm-Nmz3h1f7PRiYb4n8NbAOt9oN2HzfCq62iOJ_e9rvzcf9-Pr29HGl8klCaYXVd50apiICPR9fYbCnxOwAA__9XNozY)** No family should go without this wonderful book because of overwhelming demand. Second... Recognizing that families who want to raise their children with wholesome Christian values often feel alone in their mission... Brave Books is launching a 17-city traveling church tour that starts in Ponta Vedra Beach, Florida and ends in Laurel, Mississippi. I'll be leading the tour in every city as we prepare our hearts and our families for Easter through prayer, worship, music, and just some good old-fashioned conversation about raising Godly children in our godless culture. Our church tour aims to ignite a spirit of revival in thousands of families this Easter season and I can't wait to see what God makes of that! But getting our worship teams, musicians, and all the rest to 17 different cities for thousands of families to enjoy won't be easy and it won't be inexpensive. But I know we can do it. Brave Books is a small Christian company founded by a doctor named Trent Talbot. After having his first child, he saw how the Left was using books and entertainment to turn the hearts and minds of America's children away from God. And so he decided to take action and with the help of believers just like you, look at what they've already done:
---
>>> They've countered the Left's radical and ungodly "Drag Queen Story Hours" and filled children's hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God with their highly-publicized "See You at the Library" campaign. Armed with Brave Books' "See You at the Library" kits, thousands of parents, grandparents, children, and concerned citizens have gathered at over 360 libraries in 49 states to take back our libraries. >>> Created an historic TV show called "Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk" to fight the ungodly lessons coming out of Hollywood. It's our modern day "Mr. Rogers' Neighborhood" funded by everyday Americans who want to return American culture to God. "Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk" uses humor and storytelling to reinforce the traditional biblical values that have made America great. >>> And now you are crucial to the success and failure of our "Prepare the Way" revival campaign which features the printing and distribution of _Saving the Easter Bunny_ and a 17-city church tour.
---
Just look at what parents have already said about S _aving the Easter Bunny_ :
---
"It's not easy to explain the true meaning of Easter to adults never mind to children, but Brave Books does it beautifully."
---
— Lisa A.
---
"My kids love the amazing illustrations and so do I!"
---
– Bob A.
---
My three granddaughters barely sit still but when I'm reading this book and Lord Joshua dies, you can hear a pin drop. That's quickly replaced by squeals of joy after the resurrection. Thank you for bringing the joy of Easter to their little hearts."
---
– Laurin
---
And listen to this... **[**Your "Prepare the Way" gift of $35, $50, $100 or more, not only helps fund this revival campaign that makes Jesus the reason for the Easter season once more...**](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j01v4yAQhn8NvmENAwb74EOzjiPtRw9JVWlPETakoWtiF38p--srIisXJJ55NO-82g-du9xLonYE8erMSBAJfyGIX39XH-ZP_-tAmXz9Sb_kq8_iFH9s6oJP-dbq4ffu1GfVaR2V_D9_HtRxYU99ug_2KW-hqfXadZGqKjElvxgQiS2Z4jnkTBaYXEvJtEQmlSkk49DkeWM0gFLQAsttrhJXImAGDHMmUQpMBcimyASAAgacaSLgkZNqb4NrNRunVYfQ9z5te5905XWahvFxWE2wHm07B5vqmzX9FA2CdRP0YmnT9_9GgjUWUjADhhrNNBVZATQHdaFZA9jaRmjJMe7i9Tz589jPobWEV7vqQI_7d4IyYm-Nmz3h1f7PRiYb4n8NbAOt9oN2HzfCq62iOJ_e9rvzcf9-Pr29HGl8klCaYXVd50apiICPR9fYbCnxOwAA__9XNozY)** Your gift helps Brave Books complete a groundbreaking comprehensive homeschool curriculum that gives parents an alternative to woke government schools. AND your gift helps Brave Books begin work on an historic Gospel book series that will bring the Bible to life for a generation of children and parents in desperate need of God's truth. But nothing Brave Books accomplishes is possible without you. And if you need one more reason to help, when you **[contribute $100 or more to the "Prepare the Way" revival](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j01v4yAQhn8NvmENAwb74EOzjiPtRw9JVWlPETakoWtiF38p--srIisXJJ55NO-82g-du9xLonYE8erMSBAJfyGIX39XH-ZP_-tAmXz9Sb_kq8_iFH9s6oJP-dbq4ffu1GfVaR2V_D9_HtRxYU99ug_2KW-hqfXadZGqKjElvxgQiS2Z4jnkTBaYXEvJtEQmlSkk49DkeWM0gFLQAsttrhJXImAGDHMmUQpMBcimyASAAgacaSLgkZNqb4NrNRunVYfQ9z5te5905XWahvFxWE2wHm07B5vqmzX9FA2CdRP0YmnT9_9GgjUWUjADhhrNNBVZATQHdaFZA9jaRmjJMe7i9Tz589jPobWEV7vqQI_7d4IyYm-Nmz3h1f7PRiYb4n8NbAOt9oN2HzfCq62iOJ_e9rvzcf9-Pr29HGl8klCaYXVd50apiICPR9fYbCnxOwAA__9XNozY)** , Brave Books will send you _Saving the Easter Bunny_ absolutely free as a thank you. You can keep _Saving the Easter Bunny_ for your family, gift it to someone you love, or you can donate it to your favorite charity in the hopes of reaching a family who doesn't have a Christian role model in their life. **[**What's most important is that you rush back your best "Prepare the Way" gift of $35, $50, $100, or more right away.**](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j01v4yAQhn8NvmENAwb74EOzjiPtRw9JVWlPETakoWtiF38p--srIisXJJ55NO-82g-du9xLonYE8erMSBAJfyGIX39XH-ZP_-tAmXz9Sb_kq8_iFH9s6oJP-dbq4ffu1GfVaR2V_D9_HtRxYU99ug_2KW-hqfXadZGqKjElvxgQiS2Z4jnkTBaYXEvJtEQmlSkk49DkeWM0gFLQAsttrhJXImAGDHMmUQpMBcimyASAAgacaSLgkZNqb4NrNRunVYfQ9z5te5905XWahvFxWE2wHm07B5vqmzX9FA2CdRP0YmnT9_9GgjUWUjADhhrNNBVZATQHdaFZA9jaRmjJMe7i9Tz589jPobWEV7vqQI_7d4IyYm-Nmz3h1f7PRiYb4n8NbAOt9oN2HzfCq62iOJ_e9rvzcf9-Pr29HGl8klCaYXVd50apiICPR9fYbCnxOwAA__9XNozY)** Thank you for bringing the true meaning of Easter to families all across America.
---
May God bless you this coming Easter season,

And in that short amount of time, my friends at Brave Books are spearheading a massive "Prepare the Way" campaign to shift the focus of Easter from bunnies and chocolate... ...to Jesus. And this revival mission needs you! My friend, if you've seen me talking about Brave Books on Fox News, you know their mission is to counter the ungodly lies being pushed by the Left in schools, libraries, and Hollywood... ...by creating high-quality, wholesome, and Godly books and entertainment that instill conservative values and Gospel lessons in our children. And their "Prepare the Way" revival campaign is their biggest effort yet to point parents and children to the empty tomb and God’s redeeming love. Here’s exactly what their strategy is... First... Brave Books knows that families need an easy and impactful way to counter the Left's secularization of Easter and instead, captivate children with its true meaning. So, they created Saving the Easter Bunny , a brand-new children's book that's destined to be a classic. In it, Ronnie the Rabbit learns the hard way what sin is and that our Lord Jesus Christ loves us so much that he took the punishment for that sin. Jesus is represented by a powerful lion named Lord Joshua and the book beautifully portrays his resurrection and God's never-ending redeeming love for us. It's incredible. And let me tell you, parents are hungry for content like this because everywhere they turn godlessness is being pushed by schools, left-wing publishers like Scholastic, and Hollywood. When Brave Books first introduced a God-centered Christmas game called "Mouse in the House ," to counter the secular elf game that has become so popular -- it sold out in THREE HOURS! That's why step one of Brave Books' 12-week "Prepare the Way" revival, is ramping up the printing and distribution of Saving the Easter Bunny big-time. No family should go without this wonderful book because of overwhelming demand. Second... Recognizing that families who want to raise their children with wholesome Christian values often feel alone in their mission... Brave Books is launching a 17-city traveling church tour that starts in Ponta Vedra Beach, Florida and ends in Laurel, Mississippi. I'll be leading the tour in every city as we prepare our hearts and our families for Easter through prayer, worship, music, and just some good old-fashioned conversation about raising Godly children in our godless culture. Our church tour aims to ignite a spirit of revival in thousands of families this Easter season and I can't wait to see what God makes of that! But getting our worship teams, musicians, and all the rest to 17 different cities for thousands of families to enjoy won't be easy and it won't be inexpensive. But I know we can do it. Brave Books is a small Christian company founded by a doctor named Trent Talbot. After having his first child, he saw how the Left was using books and entertainment to turn the hearts and minds of America's children away from God. And so he decided to take action and with the help of believers just like you, look at what they've already done: >> They've countered the Left's radical and ungodly "Drag Queen Story Hours" and filled children's hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God with their highly-publicized "See You at the Library" campaign. Armed with Brave Books' "See You at the Library" kits, thousands of parents, grandparents, children, and concerned citizens have gathered at over 360 libraries in 49 states to take back our libraries. >>> Created an historic TV show called "Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk" to fight the ungodly lessons coming out of Hollywood. It's our modern day "Mr. Rogers' Neighborhood" funded by everyday Americans who want to return American culture to God. "Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk" uses humor and storytelling to reinforce the traditional biblical values that have made America great. >>> And now you are crucial to the success and failure of our "Prepare the Way" revival campaign which features the printing and distribution of Saving the Easter Bunny and a 17-city church tour. Just look at what parents have already said about S aving the Easter Bunny : "It's not easy to explain the true meaning of Easter to adults never mind to children, but Brave Books does it beautifully." — Lisa A. "My kids love the amazing illustrations and so do I!" – Bob A. My three granddaughters barely sit still but when I'm reading this book and Lord Joshua dies, you can hear a pin drop. That's quickly replaced by squeals of joy after the resurrection. Thank you for bringing the joy of Easter to their little hearts." – Laurin And listen to this... Your gift helps Brave Books complete a groundbreaking comprehensive homeschool curriculum that gives parents an alternative to woke government schools. AND your gift helps Brave Books begin work on an historic Gospel book series that will bring the Bible to life for a generation of children and parents in desperate need of God's truth. But nothing Brave Books accomplishes is possible without you. And if you need one more reason to help, when you , Brave Books will send you Saving the Easter Bunny absolutely free as a thank you. You can keep Saving the Easter Bunny for your family, gift it to someone you love, or you can donate it to your favorite charity in the hopes of reaching a family who doesn't have a Christian role model in their life. My Dear Friend, My name is Jeff Younger, and I’m the father to two wonderful boys. That’s my son James in the photo above.I’m writing to you because I’ve spent the last eight years fighting tooth and nail to keep school-appointed counselors, and out-of-control judges from transitioning my son James against my will and against all reason.You may have heard about my case from Charlie Kirk, Nick Freitas, or on Fox News.I am James’s father, but because I refused to accept that my 5 YEAR OLD boy should be surgically and chemically castrated......I’ve watched the school system, and the courts systematically strip me of all parental rights and privileges.Just recently, an LA Court ruled that my ex-wife is free to proceed with castrating my son James. That’s why I’m writing to you today. **[I need your help.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=155f02695df64c719bf9423227284664&_e=IlHY9d0GmsKC0fb4UMLAApge1ElASEIojH95NuUWrqLDPDnFTl2lPM5OtZAFt1NhOsCjm6-4eFAF2JHQLzJFl0SjgzVZ2CXmFI0MMZtHa8sfsDffZJ56_SLTL-5DODjUS0KDQPCLhnrpI5oE26KYUpMJ6HL9xsWhahnDbS93AiDjfGEHAPa4Dosplbe2vcXyyOzyfqgLYvl1WbzJjHDLOMwvWfyDMJxJFlDm-EjSvJtH09zQK7zTsjjr7-afhChzso9P0fFjVjiTXJRQyZH3MDYUJ58VBruJN3HujWnw_OYk-PjykLafOANFVu7c29WiTtPstIVh8l1VuTxMxeNhB5TKjC2ZqmHszYOPRVnKtyGdVPhsi-UW0mey6t06nOKA)** I’m up against radical trans-activist judges, the 6 BILLION dollar trans lobby, and coastal elites forcing their LGBTQ+ agenda down our throats. They’re trying to bury me in paperwork... They’re trying to bankrupt me in legal fees... They’re trying to break my spirit... I want to keep fighting, but I can’t do it alone. If you’re with me in the fight to **Save James** , **[would you consider making a generous $25 contribution to my Legal Defense Fund today?](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=155f02695df64c719bf9423227284664&_e=IlHY9d0GmsKC0fb4UMLAApge1ElASEIojH95NuUWrqLDPDnFTl2lPM5OtZAFt1NhOsCjm6-4eFAF2JHQLzJFl0SjgzVZ2CXmFI0MMZtHa8sfsDffZJ56_SLTL-5DODjUS0KDQPCLhnrpI5oE26KYUpMJ6HL9xsWhahnDbS93AiDjfGEHAPa4Dosplbe2vcXyyOzyfqgLYvl1WbzJjHDLOMwvWfyDMJxJFlDm-EjSvJs8msAWl1LeKHTJV1pc-Rd6cZdHqvmapu6IeWed5yDSSywNC7Ns2u-_0xBCypRUzbbNSfHOSa2fzuDmUFG7Ky1XywjZRm-R4l7O3BdrjpwRLAcW4VhzVEIIjtC2JTmbnLzFXCRiYu-HTltmRcSV9uSD)** But I’m getting ahead of myself...Let me start at the beginning. When James was just two years old, my ex-wife began saying our boy James was actually a girl.I told her she was wrong, and I kept dropping my son off at school in boy’s clothes because **he is a boy**. (I can’t believe I have to say that.) I later found out that the school counselors were changing him into girl’s clothes once he got to school WITHOUT MY KNOWLEDGE to inflame this delusion.Then during the custody battle, the judge BANNED me from seeing my son.The court-mandated supervisor would ONLY let me see James if I put him in girl’s clothes. I have never affirmed the lie that my son is a girl, nor will I ever affirm it.So I was forced to stop visiting him.It broke my heart.**Do you see what we’re up against?** I can confirm that these trans-activist judges are presiding over kangaroo courts where common sense goes right out the window.They need to be stopped...They need to be held accountable...And **James** needs to be **saved** from their butchery.**[THAT’S why I need your help.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=155f02695df64c719bf9423227284664&_e=IlHY9d0GmsKC0fb4UMLAApge1ElASEIojH95NuUWrqLDPDnFTl2lPM5OtZAFt1NhOsCjm6-4eFAF2JHQLzJFl0SjgzVZ2CXmFI0MMZtHa8sfsDffZJ56_SLTL-5DODjUS0KDQPCLhnrpI5oE26KYUpMJ6HL9xsWhahnDbS93AiDjfGEHAPa4Dosplbe2vcXyyOzyfqgLYvl1WbzJjHDLOMwvWfyDMJxJFlDm-EjSvJsa9B4gZF9DwkqROYrqcQVLIaSUbghyGZwarCmq2jSdPPOu2QZeRS3Yqbf-oiCWpI5-5uNcnGHw9AJOf8E-DvOsiD4-71WLQv_kQm9ZVgP-pQVAXIRyXuDoSLC1NfpZ6RT-JxhIPDfFH7YYn741xmv1)** I am under a gag order currently to NEVER speak about transgender issues publicly.Obviously, I’m not abiding by that order because it’s blatantly unconstitutional.But that’s not even the point.If I were just some activist, maybe I would worry about the threat of jail time. But I’m not just some activist.I’m a Dad.I’m fighting to save my son.And I will never give up on **James**.I’ve been in court three times a week for the past eight years. At this point, I have more trial experience than most lawyers. I authored the bill in Texas, South Carolina, and Tennessee that outlawed sex change surgeries for minors.I then spent every dollar I had to make sure cowardly politicians passed those bills.But these Radicals are relentless and they don’t play fair. I got the law passed in my home state of Texas, but then my ex-wife just took James to California: a “trans sanctuary” state.And there was nothing I could do to stop it.And that’s the scary part:**If this can happen in Texas, it can happen anywhere.** Then in California, the radical judge railroaded me and gave my ex-wife free reign to proceed with the castration.I can’t even appeal the case because he sealed all the court records...I’ll have to sue the LA County Court to unseal the records just to BEGIN the appeal process...On top of that, the other side is trying to make ME pay THEIR legal fees...**Do you see what we’re up against?** But if Conservatives won’t put up a fight, how will we ever win? That’s where Patriots Legal Defense Fund (PLDF) comes in. They heard about my case and immediately offered to stand by my side. **[Will you stand with us?](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=155f02695df64c719bf9423227284664&_e=IlHY9d0GmsKC0fb4UMLAApge1ElASEIojH95NuUWrqLDPDnFTl2lPM5OtZAFt1NhOsCjm6-4eFAF2JHQLzJFl0SjgzVZ2CXmFI0MMZtHa8sfsDffZJ56_SLTL-5DODjUS0KDQPCLhnrpI5oE26KYUpMJ6HL9xsWhahnDbS93AiDjfGEHAPa4Dosplbe2vcXyyOzyfqgLYvl1WbzJjHDLOMwvWfyDMJxJFlDm-EjSvJstDCt3vT-fKVsh0xSe-hjrIUiV8ej48oZl4iSNMc0PBbiD2lx3D7Awd-G1TFnFSj7ffPo7_YYwzRvEhAfeMp5H0UcobE_lG7MDHgvHvk8sIp3y5ixXeFKCxuDw0gbdm6rV308tbPZCTpQfUCsOXXV2)**

clean_body: Nothing is more important than protecting our rights and values from Trump’s attacks — and Tina will continue to be a powerful voice for our priorities in the Senate. | Folks — Donald Trump signed dozens of executive orders during his first days in the Oval Office. One of them halts funding from the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law to fix roads, build bridges, and repair crumbling infrastructure nationwide. I’m sounding the alarm bells — because the president should not be putting ongoing projects at risk. Imagine a half-finished bridge, left to wither away when the federal government fails to pay its share of funding to complete the project. Or imagine projects to replace lead pipes in schools canceled because Trump cut off resources for this bill. Donald Trump was elected to make a positive difference for the American people — but instead, he’s putting jobs and safe infrastructure at risk. I’m leading the charge to fight back against Trump on this executive order (among many other troubling orders). Between us, let me just say - the days of business as usual are OVER!
It's a new day for Republicans here in Massachusetts.

| | | Brave Books is spearheading a massive "Prepare the Way" revival campaign to shift the focus of Easter from bunnies and chocolate...
---
| |
---
| | Dear Fellow Believer, It may seem a little early to be talking about Easter, but it's really only about 12 weeks away.And in that short amount of time, my friends at Brave Books are spearheading a massive "Prepare the Way" campaign to shift the focus of Easter from bunnies and chocolate......to Jesus.And this revival mission needs you! My friend, if you've seen me talking about Brave Books on Fox News, you know their mission is to counter the ungodly lies being pushed by the Left in schools, libraries, and Hollywood......by creating high-quality, wholesome, and Godly books and entertainment that instill conservative values and Gospel lessons in our children. And their "Prepare the Way" revival campaign is their biggest effort yet to point parents and children to the empty tomb and God’s redeeming love.Here’s exactly what their strategy is...First... Brave Books knows that families need an easy and impactful way to counter the Left's secularization of Easter and instead, captivate children with its true meaning. So, they created _Saving the Easter Bunny_ , a brand-new children's book that's destined to be a classic.In it, Ronnie the Rabbit learns the hard way what sin is and that our Lord Jesus Christ loves us so much that he took the punishment for that sin.Jesus is represented by a powerful lion named Lord Joshua and the book beautifully portrays his resurrection and God's never-ending redeeming love for us. It's incredible.And let me tell you, parents are hungry for content like this because everywhere they turn godlessness is being pushed by schools, left-wing publishers like Scholastic, and Hollywood. When Brave Books first introduced a God-centered Christmas game called "_Mouse in the House_ ," to counter the secular elf game that has become so popular -- it sold out in THREE HOURS!That's why step one of Brave Books' 12-week "Prepare the Way" revival, is ramping up the printing and distribution of _Saving the Easter Bunny_ big-time. **[And today I'm hoping you'll help them kick it into high gear before orders start pouring in by rushing back your best "Prepare the Way" gift.](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=7f33b99312f2457cbebfaa8994cdac31&_e=eplRUJ2nmCU0X_-elY7YWS1AJPZpNCCXrUZJI-qgLrdXQtapUA7O4Amvhi1EqLJH-Ct8WfUlil22i9RK25xHQgJ9wD6VTaeJNFuNHOzY3Keq07M-jjiSfglyOaYxHUj8Of96sJE8NgpnzNMfY7eo0jZTeWmK3qCUzhghzNgwpHrjs4QkWUIy3mgNEb4GKTjKaGrY1pGtYE6V7ZwXg-shPCDyf0MguPHtUDb9DMOiVzraCoCduCRV7F8yLVQnqrnyDAmrFZRruDq1SzRd11m5SQ5caElV5_xEPsWCDQK17-s3QFgIRqKDAnpazrDlESm2FZiDf7lCfqBHcviYlLlM4MHuhpbOWQHH4GycUzaCgUDOqKH7q2XQG9Mav7sN2Wc0)** No family should go without this wonderful book because of overwhelming demand. Second... Recognizing that families who want to raise their children with wholesome Christian values often feel alone in their mission...Brave Books is launching a 17-city traveling church tour that starts in Ponta Vedra Beach, Florida and ends in Laurel, Mississippi. I'll be leading the tour in every city as we prepare our hearts and our families for Easter through prayer, worship, music, and just some good old-fashioned conversation about raising Godly children in our godless culture.Our church tour aims to ignite a spirit of revival in thousands of families this Easter season and I can't wait to see what God makes of that! But getting our worship teams, musicians, and all the rest to 17 different cities for thousands of families to enjoy won't be easy and it won't be inexpensive.But I know we can do it.Brave Books is a small Christian company founded by a doctor named Trent Talbot. After having his first child, he saw how the Left was using books and entertainment to turn the hearts and minds of America's children away from God. And so he decided to take action and with the help of believers just like you, look at what they've already done:
---
>>> They've countered the Left's radical and ungodly "Drag Queen Story Hours" and filled children's hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God with their highly-publicized "See You at the Library" campaign. Armed with Brave Books' "See You at the Library" kits, thousands of parents, grandparents, children, and concerned citizens have gathered at over 360 libraries in 49 states to take back our libraries.>>> Created an historic TV show called "Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk" to fight the ungodly lessons coming out of Hollywood. It's our modern day "Mr. Rogers' Neighborhood" funded by everyday Americans who want to return American culture to God. "Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk" uses humor and storytelling to reinforce the traditional biblical values that have made America great.>>> And now you are crucial to the success and failure of our "Prepare the Way" revival campaign which features the printing and distribution of _Saving the Easter Bunny_ and a 17-city church tour.
---
Just look at what parents have already said about S _aving the Easter Bunny_ :
---
"It's not easy to explain the true meaning of Easter to adults never mind to children, but Brave Books does it beautifully."
---
— Lisa A.
---
"My kids love the amazing illustrations and so do I!"
---
– Bob A.
---
"My three granddaughters barely sit still but when I'm reading this book and Lord Joshua dies, you can hear a pin drop. That's quickly replaced by squeals of joy after the resurrection. Thank you for bringing the joy of Easter to their little hearts."
---
– Laurin

But nothing Brave Books accomplishes is possible without you. And if you need one more reason to help, when you **[contribute $100 or more to the "Prepare the Way" revival](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=7f33b99312f2457cbebfaa8994cdac31&_e=eplRUJ2nmCU0X_-elY7YWS1AJPZpNCCXrUZJI-qgLrdXQtapUA7O4Amvhi1EqLJH-Ct8WfUlil22i9RK25xHQgJ9wD6VTaeJNFuNHOzY3Keq07M-jjiSfglyOaYxHUj8Of96sJE8NgpnzNMfY7eo0jZTeWmK3qCUzhghzNgwpHrjs4QkWUIy3mgNEb4GKTjKaGrY1pGtYE6V7ZwXg-shPCDyf0MguPHtUDb9DMOiVzr3POopYI_T-4A6NsD5w25hErZaeqPL4avrBvTvp01aH0wxysxvwlg-slFu4S_hkg3QNL49GLKIVC0DdIOszWLR9vimdbvHn32BJeXd_iNPsmInU679MwT8brvw5Tov2jdlhcBNwpWzY7g7JhB_VEEt)** , Brave Books will send you _Saving the Easter Bunny_ absolutely free as a thank you. You can keep _Saving the Easter Bunny_ for your family, gift it to someone you love, or you can donate it to your favorite charity in the hopes of reaching a family who doesn't have a Christian role model in their life. **[**What's most important is that you rush back your best "Prepare the Way" gift of $35, $50, $100, or more right away.**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=7f33b99312f2457cbebfaa8994cdac31&_e=eplRUJ2nmCU0X_-elY7YWS1AJPZpNCCXrUZJI-qgLrdXQtapUA7O4Amvhi1EqLJH-Ct8WfUlil22i9RK25xHQgJ9wD6VTaeJNFuNHOzY3Keq07M-jjiSfglyOaYxHUj8Of96sJE8NgpnzNMfY7eo0jZTeWmK3qCUzhghzNgwpHrjs4QkWUIy3mgNEb4GKTjKaGrY1pGtYE6V7ZwXg-shPCDyf0MguPHtUDb9DMOiVzrmloP_WN-0ordPj3_uJ4HZrIsG6HZQZntR9BbRlB3VMZYvbCPpNPiK-026pE2YQX9hjqgwAr1LL_s0jltrvHkok9Og3qxXNHN21hSlNZScN3zcDA6kzmjSs9mMZDOwHQuMQiR4hkjYbo2vVY8Nyauo)** Thank you for bringing the true meaning of Easter to families all across America.

Trump is Making America Great Again: Our Look at the First Executive Orders

Since the Oath of Office, President Trump has been engaged in a shock and awe campaign, signing dozens of executive orders and
keeping promises to the American people. Our border is being secured as illegal alien criminals are being rounded up for
deportation. A declared national energy emergency has fast-tracked our path toward our nation's energy dominance – and Jan 6
prisoners, after nearly four years of suffering, have been pardoned.

There's so much more. That's why this week, we'll share a list of many exciting actions already set in motion with the President's
signature.

Healing After Abortion

Studies show that abortion can leave traumatic wounds, physical and emotional. We also know that one in four women have had at
least one abortion. These women should not be left to suffer in silence; there is hope, and there is help.

Our guest on the Moms for America Podcast is Karin Barbito, special projects manager for the organization Support After Abortion.
She breaks through the stigma and stereotypes and explains how women can find support and healing after abortion. Like, share and
subscribe.

We think we can replicate our success again this mid-term election cycle, but only if we start planning now
#
Friend, it’s been almost two years since we launched The Long Run, and in that time we’ve built a proven track record.
From Arizona, to North Carolina, to here in Wisconsin – in races for both House and Senate – we were able to provide crucial resources to candidates who won some very close races thanks to supporters like you.
**We think we can replicate that success again this mid-term election cycle,[but only if we start planning to invest in key battleground districts right now.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-jan25.IJ0kth&refcode=em250128-1-180&t=1&akid=5470%2E196590%2EHJdg_E)
We’ll give you a quick inside look: We know we’ll need to defend Senate seats in Georgia, Michigan, and New Hampshire, and work to flip toss-up seats in Maine and North Carolina.

| | Peter,

Yesterday was Holocaust Remembrance Day, and it came at a dangerous and pivotal moment for America.

As a Jew who has spent my career working in politics in Pennsylvania and internationally, I know the power of words and gestures.

And as a student of history, I was horrified to watch the world's wealthiest man give multiple Nazi salutes while celebrating Trump's victory at his inauguration. While propagandists like Elon Musk (and Joseph Goebbels) think they can use trickery to make us disbelieve what is right in front of our eyes, it's our moral imperative to call out these lies when we see them. **Especially when no one else is.**

That's why I'm writing to warn you that Elon Musk is a deadly serious threat. As the largest political donor in the 2024 cycle, his money was critical to electing Trump. Emboldened, he is now openly giving Nazi salutes and even took the time to speak at a political event for AFD -- a far-right German political party chock-full of Nazi sympathizers who want to rewrite history in **_FAVOR_** of the Nazi party and the murder of millions.

At the event, he told the German audience to "move on" from guilt about the Nazi genocide, essentially telling them to "forget" just days before Holocaust Remembrance Day.

Let me be clear: as long as I have breath in my lungs, I will never forget and will do everything in my power to keep Nazis and fascists out of power in Pennsylvania and across America.

We know the history. What begins as words and speeches descend into pogroms, Kristallnacht, gas chambers, and mass graves. These aren't abstract concepts—they're violent historical events that targeted Jews and other minorities. We won’t “move on” or “forget” no matter what the Elon Musk’s of the world tell us.

body:
This may be one of the most disgusting things to come out of his mouth.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=1474%2E791427%2EQpbdjk)

Friend, we’ve heard some appalling things from Donald Trump over the years, but this may be one of the most disgusting things to ever come out of his mouth.
Speaking over the weekend, Trump told reporters that he wants to expel Palestinians from their homes in Gaza to the neighboring nations of Jordan and Egypt. His quote: “You’re talking about a million and a half people, and we just clean out that whole thing.”
Let’s be clear: **Trump is talking about ethnic cleansing.**
There are already over two million Palestinian refugees in Jordan alone, most of whom have fled the violence of settler expansion and Israeli occupation over the course of decades. This move would only create a new generation of millions of refugees who would lose their homes, their communities, and their entire livelihoods.
But far-right leaders in Israel have made it known that their plan is to forcibly expel Palestinians and open up Gaza to more Israeli settlements, eventually annexing the entire Gaza strip for Israel. Trump has even suggested that they should build beach-side resorts on top of the rubble of Gaza’s communities.
It proves the complete inhumanity of Trump’s politics, and the consequences of an American foreign policy that has consistently failed to uphold human rights and international law in Palestine.
It’s now the responsibility of anyone who believes in dignity and freedom for Palestinians; anyone who believes in the need for international law; anyone who opposes hatred and violence, to make their voice heard.
[**Add your name to our petition telling Congress to hold the line on Gaza. Our leaders shouldn’t sit back while Donald Trump helps Benjamin Netanyahu carry out a plan of ethnic cleansing.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-jan25-gaza?source=em250128-1-gm&akid=1474%2E791427%2EQpbdjk)**
**[SIGN ON NOW](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-jan25-gaza?source=em250128-1-gm&akid=1474%2E791427%2EQpbdjk)**
Donald Trump’s proposals would be a disaster for human rights and the promise of peace in Palestine. We must oppose it with everything we have.
In solidarity,
Ilhan Omar

# **Trump’s Immigration Crackdown Is an Attack on Our Values**
---
|
---
| | | | Hello friend, Donald Trump’s inhumane immigration policies have reached a new level of cruelty. This weekend, 956 people were arrested in a nationwide crackdown—the largest ICE raid since Trump returned to power. Families were ripped apart. Communities were terrorized. All in the name of a barbaric agenda that targets our neighbors, people seeking refuge, and those who believe in the promise of the American Dream. Federal agents, emboldened by Trump’s expanded detention powers, descended on cities like Chicago, Newark, and Miami. Stories of heartbreak poured in—like a man in Miami whose wife was taken during the raids despite being in the process of gaining citizenship. In Newark, a military veteran was detained without a warrant. In Chicago, Mayor Brandon Johnson spoke out against these raids, reminding residents to know their rights and condemning the fear that ICE has brought to our communities. **_This is not who we are._** America is a nation built by immigrants. We are a country that has always stood as a beacon of hope for those seeking a better life. Yet Trump’s administration continues to weaponize immigration enforcement, turning away those in need and sending them back to dangerous situations simply because they look different or come from a different place. This is not just an attack on immigrants—it’s an attack on American values of compassion, opportunity, and fairness. Trump promised mass deportations, and he’s delivering—at the cost of our humanity. Since taking office, he’s enacted 21 executive actions to overhaul immigration, turning cruelty into policy. His border czar, Tom Homan, even bragged about the arrests and warned that these crackdowns will only increase. We cannot stand idly by as families are torn apart and lives are destroyed. Our country deserves better. We are better. But standing up to Trump’s hateful agenda takes resources. We need your support to fight back and demand a humane immigration system that reflects our nation’s values. [**_Will you join us in this fight? Chip in today to support the fight for justice and protect the American Dream for all._**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2w8ion-ugsctc-kyd76rh5/)[**_Together, we can hold Trump accountable and ensure America remains a place of hope and opportunity—not fear and cruelty._**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2w8ion-ugsctd-kyd76rh6/)

Yet Trump’s administration continues to weaponize immigration enforcement, turning away those in need and sending them back to dangerous situations simply because they look different or come from a different place. This is not just an attack on immigrants—it’s an attack on American values of compassion, opportunity, and fairness. Trump promised mass deportations, and he’s delivering—at the cost of our humanity. Since taking office, he’s enacted 21 executive actions to overhaul immigration, turning cruelty into policy. His border czar, Tom Homan, even bragged about the arrests and warned that these crackdowns will only increase. We cannot stand idly by as families are torn apart and lives are destroyed. Our country deserves better. We are better. But standing up to Trump’s hateful agenda takes resources. _"What we learned in November is clear: A majority of people are not satisfied with the direction President Joe Biden has taken the country. If we want to convince voters of our vision, Democrats must do more than show up. Hey there —
We’re just over a week into Donald Trump’s second administration, and I’ll be the first to admit that this wasn’t the outcome I’d hoped for.
Many folks are asking questions like, _“What happened?”_ and “Where do we go from here?” but we can’t answer those questions without taking a good, hard look at how we got here.
The reality is that a majority of voters weren’t satisfied with the last four years and felt that their very real concerns over the prices of gas, groceries, and the things we depend on every single day weren’t being heard by the Democratic party.
Folks right here in IL-13 have shared those same concerns with me. Consolidating industries such as grocery chains, steelmaking and pharmacies is directly responsible for creating less competition in our communities, driving up costs for people and profit for big corporations.
I’m not here to make an enemy of Republicans or to shame those who voted for the current administration. I represent over 150,000 people who cast their ballots for Donald Trump, and I promise to fight just as hard for them as I do for everyone in this district. I don’t believe in finger-pointing. I don’t believe in grandstanding. **I believe in solving problems.**
[**So, if you’re with me and ready to move forward to deliver real solutions, please pitch in before the end of January to help us meet our grassroots fundraising goals.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/101115945/524971832/955618864?refcode=AU_NJB_FR_GEN_EOM_AC120_20250128_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjQwNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNjc5ZjNhMi05ZGRkLWVmMTEtODhmOC0wMDIyNDgyYTk1NzkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=M-c85ElwPr_-t9uXdt6NmNgGLEr9VcQbT2VS794pmEI=)

If we want to convince voters of our vision, Democrats must do more than show up. We must listen, engage and reconnect with the concerns of working people, such as those I represent in Illinois’ 13th District.” | = Hey there — We’re just over a week into Donald Trump’s second administration, and I’ll be the first to admit that this wasn’t the outcome I’d hoped for. Many folks are asking questions like, “What happened?” and “Where do we go from here?” but we can’t answer those questions without taking a good, hard look at how we got here. The reality is that a majority of voters weren’t satisfied with the last four years and felt that their very real concerns over the prices of gas, groceries, and the things we depend on every single day weren’t being heard by the Democratic party. Folks right here in IL-13 have shared those same concerns with me. Consolidating industries such as grocery chains, steelmaking and pharmacies is directly responsible for creating less competition in our communities, driving up costs for people and profit for big corporations. I’m not here to make an enemy of Republicans or to shame those who voted for the current administration. I represent over 150,000 people who cast their ballots for Donald Trump, and I promise to fight just as hard for them as I do for everyone in this district. I don’t believe in finger-pointing. I don’t believe in grandstanding. I believe in solving problems. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | = = | = = | = = There isn’t one pathway back to the majority in 2026, it’ll take long, hard conversations with the people we’re working to represent to move forward. I’m hopeful that if Democrats focus on showing up and listening to their communities — regardless of who is speaking — we can once again become the party of working people. And when we do that, we can set ourselves up to win. Thanks for all you do. — Nikki | **= Nikki for Congress PO Box 5171 Springfield, IL 62705 United States | mailto:info@nikkiforcongress.com Paid for by Nikki Budzinski for Congress

Shortly after being sworn in, Donald Trump issued full pardons to the roughly 1575 duly convicted insurrectionists. Now, he's ordered the Department of Justice (DOJ) to remove any mention of the insurrectionists, their names, the charges against them, or their case status from the DOJ website. This isn't just censorship--it's a deliberate effort to shield violent insurrectionists from public scrutiny for their crimes against our country.
**I have promised to do everything in my power as a human rights lawyer to hold the Trump regime accountable.** So yesterday, I submitted a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) request to the DOJ demanding they re-release the names, charges, convictions, and sentences of the 1,575 white supremacist insurrectionists Trump has pardoned. Today, the DOJ responded. And, sadly, there's an even deeper issue here that corporate media is refusing to discuss. **Let 's Address This.**

Thousands of white supremacist insurrectionists, some wearing pro Holocaust and pro Civil War apparel, stormed the U.S. Capitol on January 6, 2021.
## Erasing History and Elevating Racism
Trump's actions send a chilling message: white supremacists who attempt to overthrow democracy will not only be forgiven but protected and praised--even as they injure hundreds of police officers and enable the death of several more. Likewise, corporate media is refusing to address Trump's grotesque racism and hypocrisy. For example, while white supremacist felons are being pardoned and protected, Black Americans and other marginalized groups remain targets of systemic oppression. Black and brown Americans face significantly higher scrutiny from America's carceral system, and face lifelong repercussions for non-violent drug convictions. This includes barriers to housing, employment, and federal financial aid. Meanwhile, white supremacists who attacked democracy, caused deaths, and injured law enforcement officers are absolved of accountability and protected by the President himself.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3a7fdba7-2fb2-4d66-8bbb-60d6253528e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Pro Holocaust and antisemitic fascist Robert Packer participated in the violent January 6, 2021 insurrection. Donald Trump issued him a full and unconditional pardon.
And these pardons are not an isolated act. They are part of a broader agenda to protect white supremacy and erase Black history. While the Trump regime wiped the DOJ website of information about insurrectionists, they simultaneously ordered the Air Force to stop mentions of the Tuskegee Airmen, the legendary Black pilots who heroically fought for democracy during World War II.
When a government protects white supremacists who sought to destroy democracy--especially while censoring the stories of Black heroes who defended it--it ceases to be a government of the people. It becomes a tool of white supremacy. That is the identity Trump is embracing. Sadly, corporate media continues to fail to call out and reject this injustice.
## The DOJ's Response To My FOIA Request
Today the DOJ responded to my FOIA request. While they did not yet fulfill my request, they acknowledged receipt and offered next steps, stating:
> The Criminal Division acknowledges receipt of your Freedom of Information Act request dated January 27, 2025. The Executive Office for United States Attorneys (EOUSA) is the U.S. Department of Justice component responsible for responding to Freedom of Information Act and Privacy Act requests for information maintained by U.S. Attorneys' Offices. Hence, your request has been routed to EOUSA for processing and a direct response to you. You should contact EOUSA directly about the status of your routed request.
In all transparency, given Trump's strategy to absolve himself of all accountability, I expected an outright rejection to my FOIA. However, the DOJ Criminal Division's decision to instead forward my request to the EOUSA, to then fulfill my request, is a step in the right direction.
Fortunately, due to NPR1 and a few other outlets, I have been able to download and preserve a makeshift list of the insurrectionists, their conviction date, the charges against them, and the status of their case. [You can view that list for free here](https://substack.com/redirect/9dde872d-e472-4f06-a5f3-90c0177669ff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Soon I'll be able to upload the photographs of the insurrectionists as well.
It is imperative we continue to exercise our rights and continue to demand government accountability. This is why transparency and accountability matter. My FOIA is lawful and valid. It is about exposing the truth and ensuring that history cannot be rewritten by those in power. It is a fight to hold those who undermine justice accountable, no matter how desperately they attempt to hide their actions. And the Trump regime needs to comply.
Therefore, I am spending this week contacting the EOUSA to ensure they fulfill my FOIA request. Once I hear back from the EOUSA, you'll be the first to know.

## Conclusion
The past few weeks have provided a sobering glimpse into the depths of fascism Donald Trump is willing to embrace to expand his autocratic power. His actions, from pardoning insurrectionists to erasing their records from public view, to banning teaching about heroic Black soldiers, to raiding children in schools with ICE, and more, reveal an administration hellbent on protecting white supremacy at the expense of democracy and justice.
I will continue to do everything in my power to counter these injustices. And as you can no doubt see, I cannot do this alone. I welcome your support. Subscribe below, share this article, and help amplify the call for accountability. Fascism thrives in the darkness, but we have the power to bring it into the light. Together, we can ensure that those who betray democracy face the justice they deserve.

* **TOP NEWS**

"**Texas grid needs transmission for crypto, data centers, oil and gas,** " Houston Chronicle's **Claire Hao** -- "In the midst of a population and economic boom, Texas is outgrowing its aging power grid and needs 3,000 miles of new lines to meet an unprecedented increase in electricity demand, the Electric Reliability Council of Texas, the state's grid operator, concluded in [a new report](https://substack.com/redirect/266dbc9c-d0e2-4794-b0fd-4e315dc4f013?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

That's longer than a cross-country drive, [according to Google Maps](https://substack.com/redirect/bdef6fef-5ac1-41bc-934f-313b7d1dfff2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Similar to adding new roads to accommodate more cars, ERCOT said the new power lines are essential to deliver more electricity.

If implemented, ERCOT's plan would be the largest build-out of transmission since [Texas completed](https://substack.com/redirect/0808b764-490f-4148-a075-6115920dd5ec?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the Competitive Renewable Energy Zone initiative in 2013 with former Gov. **Rick Perry 's** [backing](https://substack.com/redirect/460d5f6f-3f16-47bb-8e11-ba5c132b5d32?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). CREZ, designed to deliver electricity from West Texas wind farms to major population hubs, [was considered](https://substack.com/redirect/479f09e6-c4d0-4f32-8d85-15445c8e2c61?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) one of the largest infrastructure project's in the state's history.

This time around, Texas must build transmission lines**** largely to support electrification within the oil and gas industry and to host more power-intensive cryptocurrency mines and data centers, the latter of which have proliferated as technology companies race to develop artificial intelligence, according to ERCOT's analyses.

"We are one of the few states that are growing in all sectors, whether it's residential, commercial or industrial, so making sure that we have the capacity to move electricity from generation-side to demand-side is really important," said **Mark Bell** , president of the Association of Electric Companies of Texas, an industry trade group.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/db6c23fa-e071-4202-89c5-5cb09a104ef0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Building this much transmission and making necessary upgrades could cost between $30.8 billion and $33 billion, ERCOT estimated in its recent report, fueling concerns within the electric power industry that residential consumers could see significant rate increases for this infrastructure. Lawmakers say they will reform how transmission costs are allocated in the ongoing legislative session.

By 2030, Texas could need nearly 80% more electricity during times of peak usage, [ERCOT revealed](https://substack.com/redirect/3c9c59e0-8048-4863-a777-9a6a04da7dbe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in April. Though [there's doubt](https://substack.com/redirect/367e57b2-c9c8-4b75-9e18-e3ece9acf62c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on whether all the data centers, cryptocurrency mines and hydrogen projects applying to connect to the grid will actually be built, the projection still signaled "unprecedented" growth is coming, ERCOT CEO **Pablo Vegas** said.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $70/yr](https://substack.com/redirect/db6c23fa-e071-4202-89c5-5cb09a104ef0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The lack of transmission capacity could pose a key constraint on ERCOT's ability to meet that demand, Vegas told the grid operator's board in April as he proclaimed "a new era of planning" for the organization. That's because it takes approximately three to six years to build new transmission lines, compared to six to 12 months to add new power demand or supply to the grid, he said.

Lack of adequate transmission lines can create "congestion" of electrons on the grid, similar to traffic clogging up a highway. That makes it more difficult for low-cost electricity to travel to certain regions such as Houston, [adding to electricity costs](https://substack.com/redirect/2af07025-0fd7-4f39-8097-5889ca7a4d10?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

This congestion can also increase the risk of rolling outages, as available lines can become overloaded. Indeed, a recurring [South Texas grid chokepoint](https://substack.com/redirect/9a86eb10-306d-4523-8fb3-83b16bf3edb0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) played a large part in ERCOT [triggering a grid emergency](https://substack.com/redirect/1bb0aaec-aa5f-4a83-abe4-3931032aa073?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in September 2023, the first since the notorious 2021 freeze.

Under the Biden administration, [clean energy advocates](https://substack.com/redirect/688f1658-9faf-42f7-bbeb-fa164ddd223b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) were often the biggest supporters of more transmission lines to unlock the potential for more wind and solar power.

But in Texas, oil and gas producers [have been clamoring](https://substack.com/redirect/dea9c433-e7da-40a7-b9b2-e18beda95ba0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for more transmission lines for years so they can connect to the grid too. That's because they want to [make their operations](https://substack.com/redirect/834a770a-0e93-4bd6-ab72-702e1b41e6ff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) more efficient, reduce fuel costs and cut climate-warming emissions.

By 2038, the Permian Basin alone [could add 26 gigawatts](https://substack.com/redirect/49a611f1-b3e9-413a-959f-28aff6fa2d8d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of electricity demand, nearly a third of the Texas grid's entire summer demand currently, [according to ERCOT](https://substack.com/redirect/38ad5e89-f0fe-4770-9725-f24fb0e6ee7e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Oil and gas electrification accounts for more than 14 gigawatts of that, ERCOT said.

The Texas Legislature [passed a law](https://substack.com/redirect/77cd2ef8-80e8-4bb3-b9da-253ef015bd6a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in 2023 requiring the Public Utility Commission of Texas, the state agency regulating the grid, to direct ERCOT to study transmission needs in the Permian Basin. The grid operator [released its final report](https://substack.com/redirect/6ef5ec01-82d3-420d-925f-99b9a20ca599?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in July, with [the PUC approving](https://substack.com/redirect/2d2e36fc-1754-4549-83d9-7cac9927f41e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) $13 billion to $15 billion in estimated investments in September.

**Lori Cobos** , the former PUC commissioner in charge of the effort, called the approval "a monumental and historic transmission buildout" in [a September statement](https://substack.com/redirect/38ad5e89-f0fe-4770-9725-f24fb0e6ee7e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

"The Permian Basin is the heartbeat of our state and nation's energy dominance and economy. This plan is a roadmap that will ensure electric reliability in the region for decades to come," she said.

The Texas Oil and Gas Association said in [a September statement](https://substack.com/redirect/8da7a9f0-8d12-4974-801c-e742a509b84c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that the plan addressed the industry's concerns that grid infrastructure hasn't kept pace with their growth.

Lawmakers and regulators have been [much more skeptical](https://substack.com/redirect/f8226302-90ab-4ee6-a9d3-44c63365ec08?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of the cryptocurrency mining and data center industries, which also want more transmission lines to connect their operations to the Texas grid.

Data centers and cryptocurrency mines house banks of computers. Data centers store data from online activities and increasingly run calculations necessary for artificial intelligence. Crypto mines solve complex math equations to earn cryptocurrency as a reward.

Both types of facilities use lots of electricity to run these computers and to prevent the equipment from overheating. Some of the larger ones consume as much electricity as a medium-sized power plant, according to [data from the Department of Energy](https://substack.com/redirect/3a9079ab-7078-4ba0-9109-150e8ed51987?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

**Lee Bratcher** , president of the Texas Blockchain Council, an industry trade group, has long maintained that cryptocurrency mining doesn't risk grid stability. That's because companies typically ramp down operations when electricity prices are high and it's uneconomic to mine crypto, which reduces grid strain, he said.

"There's never been an energy consumer that is as price sensitive as a bitcoin miner," Bratcher said.

**Dan Diorio** , senior director of state policy with the Data Center Coalition, another industry trade group, highlighted the national security benefits of hosting American data inside the country. Texas could also reap [billions in investments](https://substack.com/redirect/cc6896b7-5da1-43f0-aae7-5a215193dbad?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) related to the development of artificial intelligence, he said.

"We continue to see emphasis on the United States becoming a leader in digital infrastructure in order to maintain global competitiveness. Texas is on the forefront of that," Diorio said." TOP NEWS "Texas grid needs transmission for crypto, data centers, oil and gas, " Houston Chronicle's Claire Hao -- "In the midst of a population and economic boom, Texas is outgrowing its aging power grid and needs 3,000 miles of new lines to meet an unprecedented increase in electricity demand, the Electric Reliability Council of Texas, the state's grid operator, concluded in . That's longer than a cross-country drive, . Similar to adding new roads to accommodate more cars, ERCOT said the new power lines are essential to deliver more electricity. If implemented, ERCOT's plan would be the largest build-out of transmission since the Competitive Renewable Energy Zone initiative in 2013 with former Gov. Rick Perry 's . CREZ, designed to deliver electricity from West Texas wind farms to major population hubs, one of the largest infrastructure project's in the state's history. This time around, Texas must build transmission lines** largely to support electrification within the oil and gas industry and to host more power-intensive cryptocurrency mines and data centers, the latter of which have proliferated as technology companies race to develop artificial intelligence, according to ERCOT's analyses. "We are one of the few states that are growing in all sectors, whether it's residential, commercial or industrial, so making sure that we have the capacity to move electricity from generation-side to demand-side is really important," said Mark Bell , president of the Association of Electric Companies of Texas, an industry trade group. Building this much transmission and making necessary upgrades could cost between $30.8 billion and $33 billion, ERCOT estimated in its recent report, fueling concerns within the electric power industry that residential consumers could see significant rate increases for this infrastructure. Lawmakers say they will reform how transmission costs are allocated in the ongoing legislative session. By 2030, Texas could need nearly 80% more electricity during times of peak usage, in April. Though on whether all the data centers, cryptocurrency mines and hydrogen projects applying to connect to the grid will actually be built, the projection still signaled "unprecedented" growth is coming, ERCOT CEO Pablo Vegas said. The lack of transmission capacity could pose a key constraint on ERCOT's ability to meet that demand, Vegas told the grid operator's board in April as he proclaimed "a new era of planning" for the organization. That's because it takes approximately three to six years to build new transmission lines, compared to six to 12 months to add new power demand or supply to the grid, he said. Lack of adequate transmission lines can create "congestion" of electrons on the grid, similar to traffic clogging up a highway. That makes it more difficult for low-cost electricity to travel to certain regions such as Houston, . This congestion can also increase the risk of rolling outages, as available lines can become overloaded. Indeed, a recurring played a large part in ERCOT in September 2023, the first since the notorious 2021 freeze. Under the Biden administration, were often the biggest supporters of more transmission lines to unlock the potential for more wind and solar power. But in Texas, oil and gas producers for more transmission lines for years so they can connect to the grid too. That's because they want to more efficient, reduce fuel costs and cut climate-warming emissions. By 2038, the Permian Basin alone of electricity demand, nearly a third of the Texas grid's entire summer demand currently, . Oil and gas electrification accounts for more than 14 gigawatts of that, ERCOT said. The Texas Legislature in 2023 requiring the Public Utility Commission of Texas, the state agency regulating the grid, to direct ERCOT to study transmission needs in the Permian Basin. The grid operator in July, with $13 billion to $15 billion in estimated investments in September. Lori Cobos , the former PUC commissioner in charge of the effort, called the approval "a monumental and historic transmission buildout" in . "The Permian Basin is the heartbeat of our state and nation's energy dominance and economy. This plan is a roadmap that will ensure electric reliability in the region for decades to come," she said. The Texas Oil and Gas Association said in that the plan addressed the industry's concerns that grid infrastructure hasn't kept pace with their growth. Lawmakers and regulators have been of the cryptocurrency mining and data center industries, which also want more transmission lines to connect their operations to the Texas grid. Data centers and cryptocurrency mines house banks of computers. Data centers store data from online activities and increasingly run calculations necessary for artificial intelligence. Crypto mines solve complex math equations to earn cryptocurrency as a reward. Both types of facilities use lots of electricity to run these computers and to prevent the equipment from overheating. Some of the larger ones consume as much electricity as a medium-sized power plant, according to . Lee Bratcher , president of the Texas Blockchain Council, an industry trade group, has long maintained that cryptocurrency mining doesn't risk grid stability. That's because companies typically ramp down operations when electricity prices are high and it's uneconomic to mine crypto, which reduces grid strain, he said. "There's never been an energy consumer that is as price sensitive as a bitcoin miner," Bratcher said. Dan Diorio , senior director of state policy with the Data Center Coalition, another industry trade group, highlighted the national security benefits of hosting American data inside the country. Texas could also reap related to the development of artificial intelligence, he said. "We continue to see emphasis on the United States becoming a leader in digital infrastructure in order to maintain global competitiveness. Texas is on the forefront of that," Diorio said." Become a PAID subscriber for $5/mo or $50/yr . | TOP NEWS “Texas grid needs transmission for crypto, data centers, oil and gas, ” Houston Chronicle's Claire Hao — “In the midst of a population and economic boom, Texas is outgrowing its aging power grid and needs 3,000 miles of new lines to meet an unprecedented increase in electricity demand, the Electric Reliability Council of Texas, the state’s grid operator, concluded in . That’s longer than a cross-country drive, . Similar to adding new roads to accommodate more cars, ERCOT said the new power lines are essential to deliver more electricity. If implemented, ERCOT’s plan would be the largest build-out of transmission since the Competitive Renewable Energy Zone initiative in 2013 with former Gov. Rick Perry’s . CREZ, designed to deliver electricity from West Texas wind farms to major population hubs, one of the largest infrastructure project’s in the state’s history. This time around, Texas must build transmission lines largely to support electrification within the oil and gas industry and to host more power-intensive cryptocurrency mines and data centers, the latter of which have proliferated as technology companies race to develop artificial intelligence, according to ERCOT’s analyses. “We are one of the few states that are growing in all sectors, whether it's residential, commercial or industrial, so making sure that we have the capacity to move electricity from generation-side to demand-side is really important,” said Mark Bell , president of the Association of Electric Companies of Texas, an industry trade group. » Building this much transmission and making necessary upgrades could cost between $30.8 billion and $33 billion, ERCOT estimated in its recent report, fueling concerns within the electric power industry that residential consumers could see significant rate increases for this infrastructure. Lawmakers say they will reform how transmission costs are allocated in the ongoing legislative session. By 2030, Texas could need nearly 80% more electricity during times of peak usage, in April. Though on whether all the data centers, cryptocurrency mines and hydrogen projects applying to connect to the grid will actually be built, the projection still signaled “unprecedented” growth is coming, ERCOT CEO Pablo Vegas said. » The lack of transmission capacity could pose a key constraint on ERCOT’s ability to meet that demand, Vegas told the grid operator’s board in April as he proclaimed “a new era of planning” for the organization. That’s because it takes approximately three to six years to build new transmission lines, compared to six to 12 months to add new power demand or supply to the grid, he said. Lack of adequate transmission lines can create “congestion” of electrons on the grid, similar to traffic clogging up a highway. That makes it more difficult for low-cost electricity to travel to certain regions such as Houston, . This congestion can also increase the risk of rolling outages, as available lines can become overloaded. Indeed, a recurring played a large part in ERCOT in September 2023, the first since the notorious 2021 freeze. Under the Biden administration, were often the biggest supporters of more transmission lines to unlock the potential for more wind and solar power. But in Texas, oil and gas producers for more transmission lines for years so they can connect to the grid too. That’s because they want to more efficient, reduce fuel costs and cut climate-warming emissions. By 2038, the Permian Basin alone of electricity demand, nearly a third of the Texas grid’s entire summer demand currently, . Oil and gas electrification accounts for more than 14 gigawatts of that, ERCOT said. The Texas Legislature in 2023 requiring the Public Utility Commission of Texas, the state agency regulating the grid, to direct ERCOT to study transmission needs in the Permian Basin. The grid operator in July, with $13 billion to $15 billion in estimated investments in September. Lori Cobos , the former PUC commissioner in charge of the effort, called the approval “a monumental and historic transmission buildout” in . “The Permian Basin is the heartbeat of our state and nation’s energy dominance and economy. This plan is a roadmap that will ensure electric reliability in the region for decades to come,” she said. The Texas Oil and Gas Association said in that the plan addressed the industry’s concerns that grid infrastructure hasn’t kept pace with their growth. Lawmakers and regulators have been of the cryptocurrency mining and data center industries, which also want more transmission lines to connect their operations to the Texas grid. Data centers and cryptocurrency mines house banks of computers. Data centers store data from online activities and increasingly run calculations necessary for artificial intelligence. Crypto mines solve complex math equations to earn cryptocurrency as a reward. Both types of facilities use lots of electricity to run these computers and to prevent the equipment from overheating. Some of the larger ones consume as much electricity as a medium-sized power plant, according to . Lee Bratcher , president of the Texas Blockchain Council, an industry trade group, has long maintained that cryptocurrency mining doesn’t risk grid stability. That’s because companies typically ramp down operations when electricity prices are high and it’s uneconomic to mine crypto, which reduces grid strain, he said. “There's never been an energy consumer that is as price sensitive as a bitcoin miner,” Bratcher said. Dan Diorio , senior director of state policy with the Data Center Coalition, another industry trade group, highlighted the national security benefits of hosting American data inside the country. Texas could also reap related to the development of artificial intelligence, he said. “We continue to see emphasis on the United States becoming a leader in digital infrastructure in order to maintain global competitiveness. Texas is on the forefront of that,” Diorio said." ($) | FREE SUBSCRIPTIONS HAVE ENDED : As of July 11, 2022, we have moved to a paywall for free subscribers. body:
The IRS has a long history of mismanagement, inefficiency, overreach, and creating unnecessary burdens for taxpayers.

| | | [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=dd4c8ebdff3e4294bee5d93caf1721ed&_e=-h6BZY6IjD2vpBFaJflmnUbppNXtZjeyL8MnMAG0Ulo7xgJNH8J6DIyUwHzNFeiL1r7dU3k4FyWJGhii1eDlKJwxIhKRlhUzzmoBmVbhYvQIy3HEJMP_thYzxA-UyGKqlyLwdU1tAZtU334OFv_jyGyWr2MTeJX0eeeceTb1yWi17gzzedxTvgn2IQrgkNrXf3E6VBNnwrS6ZRIrY9jyQkFWZVvM6BFIjzfo2birR6MbjzGnSqqSUtrZah_obOQHKBr43sU3Ch89FbJy3pGFhqKcKQ2-tUy-t1ymc27QOUg%3D)
Friend,

President-elect Donald Trump and a Republican-controlled Congress will undoubtedly try to move quickly on preventing the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act (TCJA) expiration and addressing our nation’s dire financial outlook.

However, IRS reform also needs to be a priority.

The IRS has a long history of mismanagement, inefficiency, overreach, and creating unnecessary burdens for taxpayers.

**The National Taxpayers Union (NTU) has a long history too – of reining in the IRS and holding them accountable to American taxpayers.**

I am Pete Sepp, President of the National Taxpayers Union. NTU is the “Voice of America’s Taxpayers.” We fight to ensure that all Americans are able to pursue their dreams without the heavy hand of the government holding them back.

Right now, our research has identified 10 critical reforms for the IRS. But before I share them with you, I must ask for your urgent support. Click below to help us fight against IRS inefficiency:
[Donate](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=dd4c8ebdff3e4294bee5d93caf1721ed&_e=-h6BZY6IjD2vpBFaJflmnUbppNXtZjeyL8MnMAG0Ulo7xgJNH8J6DIyUwHzNFeiL1r7dU3k4FyWJGhii1eDlKJwxIhKRlhUzzmoBmVbhYvQIy3HEJMP_thYzxA-UyGKqlyLwdU1tAZtU334OFv_jyKN7JwZsjFHoQiSlLuyB6uaZB7Csbxnz8n3ik5BES2SdWo6AIt1Tkjw78b1ivqACRU4x7Po0M0BKqI4a4EuG6Gjhw4MlHgNVmvwYQF0VRFseXQrZYtctnOEoG87urciX5T7tIXeVOLRayIhFe7dBeBo%3D)
**Here are 10 IRS reforms and policies that must be at the top of the new administration’s agenda:**

**1.** Produce a regular report to Congress on where tax code administration is overly complex and can be simplified.

**2.** Provide Congress with direct access to IRS technical staff for legislative and rulemaking purposes.

**3.** Create a detailed punch list and implementation plan for technology modernization.

**4.** Make the IRS Independent Office of Appeals truly independent and accessible to taxpayers.

**5.** Permit the National Taxpayer Advocate, an office NTU lobbied for to stand up for taxpayers, to hire her own attorney rather than use IRS lawyers.

[Help NTU keep the IRS from abusing taxpayers. Click here to donate today >>>](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=dd4c8ebdff3e4294bee5d93caf1721ed&_e=-h6BZY6IjD2vpBFaJflmnUbppNXtZjeyL8MnMAG0Ulo7xgJNH8J6DIyUwHzNFeiL1r7dU3k4FyWJGhii1eDlKJwxIhKRlhUzzmoBmVbhYvQIy3HEJMP_thYzxA-UyGKqlyLwdU1tAZtU334OFv_jyG6c3ihl0hPe8G-CAmWpFVYEgAXolOLlGtLSo7dERFt0lNq9vnusb31qTgvFf0lAoME24FhkzZkuaamE0b3ZxFAeQ9FyTRnGdnZh4J5xDYrmng2I5FnTiz3vChwBcC4J-kY05Mp_dQHTiamWMBQFjnE%3D)
**6.** Allow Congress to decide the future of the Direct File program. The IRS far exceeded its authority to stand up this program when there are far bigger modernization priorities.

**7.** Halt counterproductive, aggressive litigation strategies against certain taxpayers utilizing lawful tax savings provisions. This is clogging the courts and delaying settlements, needlessly costing the government and taxpayers.

**8.** Rescind the proposed supervisory signature regulation that lets the IRS heap penalties on taxpayers without accountability, and follow the “no signature, no penalty” intent of current law.

**9.** Rescind unworkable cryptocurrency regulations, including one slated to take effect in 2025.

**10.** Publish a dashboard of regular IRS performance metrics and data to inform decision-making.

These reforms could shift the IRS from being one of the most unliked government agencies by improving its transparency, modernization, and customer service.

name: Representative Darin Harbick
subject: Week 2 of the 2025 session!
body:
Dear Neighbors,
Time flies by so quickly we are already at the start of the second week of the 83rd Legislative Assembly! I’ve been so busy learning more about the specifics about how committees’ function, the special lingo used in the various committees I am on, the rules of the house when floor is in session, and how a to get a bill passed into law. I hope this newsletter will be a helpful way to keep you updated on what I’m working on during session.
Best regards,
**School District Funding Letter**
Recently I signed onto a letter joining 7 other bipartisan legislators urging Speaker Fahey, Senate President Wagner and other legislative leaders to include funding to support wildfire impacted school districts. If additional funding is not set aside for these wildfires affected school districts, then they will have to make significant cuts to their budgets before the end of this school year.
**WELCOME TO THE 83 RD LEGISLATIVE ASSEMBLY**
As we begin the 83rd Legislative Assembly, I invite you to join us in Salem to fight for lower costs for Oregon families. I want government to work for you, not the bureaucracy. Let's work together to make Oregon more affordable, fix our schools, end homelessness, keep our neighborhoods safe, make it easier to build houses, and hold state agencies accountable. This session, we are here to work and fight for YOU.
_2025 Oregon House Republican Caucus_
It's so important that I hear from you and what matters to you and your family. I want to invite you to join me in Salem to fight for a better future for Oregon and tell the supermajority that they work for YOU. Here are ways you can get involved:
* Learn about [how an idea becomes law](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.oregonlegislature.gov%2Fcitizen_engagement%2FPages%2FHow-an-Idea-Becomes-Law.aspx/1/01010194ae314287-781022e5-992d-43b4-89ea-38ca536f1c4b-000000/YN5c-gfjRf5xsoEZFaRHZLRMPeAgrwtyi5COeJzG8WA=389)
* Sign up to testify for a bill
* Call my office or send me an email telling me what is important to you and your family
* Submit written testimony for a bill you support or oppose
* Encourage your friends and family to get involved
* Join me at a townhall or coffee chat in our district

**COMMITTEE ASSIGNMENTS**
I am excited to share that this legislative session I will be serving on Behavioral Health and Healthcare, Higher Education and Workforce Development, and the Education Committees. Follow our work in these important committees on the [Oregon Legislative Information System](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Folis.oregonlegislature.gov%2Fliz%2F2025R1%2F2025-01-13/1/01010194ae314287-781022e5-992d-43b4-89ea-38ca536f1c4b-000000/vPQAevpzo1wFio-d9iAtfgDgqbiPh3GdTx06B1vyM5w=389) website (also known as “OLIS”) [here](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Folis.oregonlegislature.gov%2Fliz%2F2025R1%2F2025-01-13/2/01010194ae314287-781022e5-992d-43b4-89ea-38ca536f1c4b-000000/pZZ26wUrQjbLtnkigwz8cYr3RtlpuUMqEndu0EY2I6o=389). You can find when our meetings are happening, the agenda for our committee meeting, bills and issues up for discussion, and even sign up for alerts!
We are here to work for you, and I invite you to join us at your Capitol in-person or virtually to watch and I want to personally invite you to testify!
**STAY IN TOUCH**
It is my honor to serve you and our community at your State Capitol this session. Please stay in touch and reach out if there are any issues you would like us to work on.
Reach my office!
* Office Phone: 503-986-1412
* Email: Rep.darinharbick@oregonlegislature.gov
* Office Address: 900 Court St. NE, H-376 | Salem, OR 97301

* * *
**SUBSCRIBER SERVICES OPTIONS:**
**•** To **stop** receiving this newsletter, **add** new newsletters, or**delete** your subscription services click [Manage Preferences](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fpublic.govdelivery.com%2Faccounts%2FORLEG%2Fsubscriber%2Fnew%3Fpreferences=true/1/01010194ae314287-781022e5-992d-43b4-89ea-38ca536f1c4b-000000/KVLZCTCT6pVxeJILrhjAaODH7RZ4VZUzMJG5_EIXBMo=389)
**•** For questions about subscriber services, please email [Help](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fsubscriberhelp.govdelivery.com%2F/1/01010194ae314287-781022e5-992d-43b4-89ea-38ca536f1c4b-000000/W3ttfEDXSB0aMfS0wZj9GF70PJVhwpaTXDwwF88HhSw=389) Information provided may not be final and is subject to change.
---
