* **TOP NEWS**

"**Multi-agency operation targeted immigrants in Austin and San Antonio,** " Texas Tribune's **Pooja Salhotra** -- "Agents from multiple federal agencies carried out immigration enforcement operations in Austin and San Antonio on Sunday, federal officials said.

U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement, along with the Drug Enforcement Agency, the FBI and the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives collaborated on "enhanced targeted operations" in both cities, an ICE spokesperson said. A similar operation took place Sunday morning in the Rio Grande Valley, [a local station reported](https://substack.com/redirect/de2b568d-c6de-4ad2-95a3-9a39bf1f7fa5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

The spokesperson said the operations were to "enforce U.S. immigration law and preserve public safety and national security by keeping potentially dangerous criminal aliens out of our communities." The official did not say what kind of offenses the targeted individuals were suspected of committing or whether anyone was detained.

KXAN [first reported](https://substack.com/redirect/4a044b46-eb77-4c55-935f-2217e02049f6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ICE was conducting an operation in the Austin area on Sunday afternoon through a spokesperson for the DEA's Houston division. DEA spokesperson **Sally Sparks** said the agency's Houston office "mobilized every agent in our division," whose jurisdiction spans from Brownsville to Corpus Christi, Del Rio and Waco.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/8b283743-8308-4c07-ae40-a47bac0fe72f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
"We got information that we had to mobilize, so we mobilized," Sparks told The Texas Tribune. "The majority of our agents assisted."

A Houston DEA [post on X](https://substack.com/redirect/6f75a9e3-4515-4027-84b1-3b8b811206eb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Sunday showed photos of law enforcement officers in a residential area escorting a man in handcuffs.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $70/yr](https://substack.com/redirect/8b283743-8308-4c07-ae40-a47bac0fe72f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Neither ICE nor the DEA answered questions about the scale of the operations. Spokespeople for the Travis and Bexar counties' sheriff's offices said they had not been notified of the operations. A spokesperson for U.S. Rep. **Lloyd Doggett** , D-Austin, said Doggett did not receive advance notice that ICE would conduct an operation in Austin.

Sunday's operations came less than one week after President Donald Trump began his second term as president and promised mass deportations across the country. Trump issued more than a dozen immigration-related executive orders last week, including [halting the use of an app](https://substack.com/redirect/4b66a7bd-fc10-4bb0-ab06-b35a23dc66d6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that lets migrants make appointments to request asylum and authorizing immigration officers to raid sensitive locations such as churches, schools and hospitals." TOP NEWS "Multi-agency operation targeted immigrants in Austin and San Antonio, " Texas Tribune's Pooja Salhotra -- "Agents from multiple federal agencies carried out immigration enforcement operations in Austin and San Antonio on Sunday, federal officials said. U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement, along with the Drug Enforcement Agency, the FBI and the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives collaborated on "enhanced targeted operations" in both cities, an ICE spokesperson said. A similar operation took place Sunday morning in the Rio Grande Valley, . The spokesperson said the operations were to "enforce U.S. immigration law and preserve public safety and national security by keeping potentially dangerous criminal aliens out of our communities." The official did not say what kind of offenses the targeted individuals were suspected of committing or whether anyone was detained. KXAN ICE was conducting an operation in the Austin area on Sunday afternoon through a spokesperson for the DEA's Houston division. DEA spokesperson Sally Sparks said the agency's Houston office "mobilized every agent in our division," whose jurisdiction spans from Brownsville to Corpus Christi, Del Rio and Waco. "We got information that we had to mobilize, so we mobilized," Sparks told The Texas Tribune. "The majority of our agents assisted." A Houston DEA on Sunday showed photos of law enforcement officers in a residential area escorting a man in handcuffs. Neither ICE nor the DEA answered questions about the scale of the operations. Spokespeople for the Travis and Bexar counties' sheriff's offices said they had not been notified of the operations. A spokesperson for U.S. Rep. Lloyd Doggett , D-Austin, said Doggett did not receive advance notice that ICE would conduct an operation in Austin. Sunday's operations came less than one week after President Donald Trump began his second term as president and promised mass deportations across the country. Trump issued more than a dozen immigration-related executive orders last week, including that lets migrants make appointments to request asylum and authorizing immigration officers to raid sensitive locations such as churches, schools and hospitals." clean_body: | Hey everyone — it’s Cristina. I’m sure I speak for all of us when I say it’s been a hell of a week. The Trump Administration has proven to be just as extreme and anti-democracy as we feared. The progress we’ve made for our climate, abortion rights, and so much else all feels fragile. We know that Trump and his allies are no friends to the youth movement. They’ve made it clear that their interests don’t lie with us. Instead, they’ve taken aim at the progress we’ve fought long and hard for and vowed to roll it back. But if I know one thing, it’s that we are not powerless. This fight has always been about more than one person taking office. It’s about the future we’re building for the next generation of voters. It’s about all of us standing together and building something bigger than ourselves. I’ve said it before, and I’ll say it again: Young voters are the key to moving our country forward. When the Youth Vote shows up and takes a stand, our rights are protected, our climate is defended, and our democracy is more secure. It’s more important than ever that the Youth Vote has the tools they need to fight back against the MAGA agenda. The work that NextGen does, both in the field and online, helps educate and empower young voters to make a difference. | | | | | | With hope for a brighter future, Tzintzún Ramirez President & Executive Director NextGen PAC | Paid for by NextGen Climate Action Committee; ; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. | = |

Another Senate seat has opened up in Michigan for 2026.

It’s not time to say goodbye yet, but I wanted to send a major THANK YOU to Senator Gary Peters for his lifetime of service to Michigan - from serving in the US Navy Reserve to the halls of Congress. I am grateful for his partnership and look forward to working together for our community over the next two years!

In 2022, our campaign changed the trajectory here in West Michigan–for our state and our country. Strong grassroots support took West Michigan from a 50-year Republican stronghold to sending the first pro-choice woman to Congress. And then, despite the political tides against us, we held the seat. While the nation faced a rightward swing, West Michigan remains a bright blue spot.

I’m so proud of what I’ve been able to accomplish. As a born and raised West Michigander, I know what matters most here. Our community and our country need practical, solution-oriented problem solvers now more than ever. I bring that voice to our community and to Washington every single day.

clean_body: In 2022, our campaign changed the trajectory here in West Michigan–for our state and our country. | = | Wanted to make sure you didn’t miss this, team: = Another Senate seat has opened up in Michigan for 2026. It’s not time to say goodbye yet, but I wanted to send a major THANK YOU to Senator Gary Peters for his lifetime of service to Michigan - from serving in the US Navy Reserve to the halls of Congress. I am grateful for his partnership and look forward to working together for our community over the next two years! In 2022, our campaign changed the trajectory here in West Michigan–for our state and our country. Strong grassroots support took West Michigan from a 50-year Republican stronghold to sending the first pro-choice woman to Congress. And then, despite the political tides against us, we held the seat. While the nation faced a rightward swing, West Michigan remains a bright blue spot. I’m so proud of what I’ve been able to accomplish. As a born and raised West Michigander, I know what matters most here. Our community and our country need practical, solution-oriented problem solvers now more than ever. I bring that voice to our community and to Washington every single day. In 2026, West Michigan will be pivotal in electing a Democratic senator in Michigan, but to lock in another victory for Democrats, we have to start now.= | = | = | = | = | = Grateful, Hillary * | | = Paid for by Scholten for Congress Hillary Scholten for Congress PO Box 6233 Grand Rapids, MI 49510 United States | = If you would like to receive fewer emails, . body:
Polluters are taking over. We have to fight back.

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/101123921/524993952/1328794144?refcode=ea.66089cb5-abdd-ef11-88f8-0022482a9579&ms=ea.66089cb5-abdd-ef11-88f8-0022482a9579&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjY2MDg5Y2I1LWFiZGQtZWYxMS04OGY4LTAwMjI0ODJhOTU3OSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=1sICmw6atVqDidntxdkn1mlhQHLxE0olbh4puHTDJLI=&emci=7e3b1455-e4dc-ef11-88f8-0022482a9579&emdi=66089cb5-abdd-ef11-88f8-0022482a9579&ceid=4823105)
---
Hi — Donald Trump is turning the Environmental Protection Agency into a polluter’s paradise — stacked with chemical industry insiders and corporate lawyers who are more interested in profits than protecting public health. **[If we want to stop Trump from sacrificing our health for corporate profits, we need to act now. Donate today to power our work and elect climate leaders who will protect us.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/101123925/524993957/2105508926?refcode=ea.66089cb5-abdd-ef11-88f8-0022482a9579&ms=ea.66089cb5-abdd-ef11-88f8-0022482a9579&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjY2MDg5Y2I1LWFiZGQtZWYxMS04OGY4LTAwMjI0ODJhOTU3OSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=1sICmw6atVqDidntxdkn1mlhQHLxE0olbh4puHTDJLI=)** Meet **Nancy Beck** and **Lynn Ann Dekleva** — two chemical industry insiders who served in Trump’s first administration and are now returning to senior roles at the EPA to oversee critical regulations. **Beck,** a former executive at the American Chemistry Council, spent her last stint at the EPA rewriting rules to weaken protections against asbestos — a deadly carcinogen — and “forever chemicals” known as PFAS, which are linked to cancer and birth defects. **Dekleva,** who spent more than three decades at DuPont, a chemical giant infamous for its role in PFAS contamination, used her prior EPA role to push employees into approving harmful new chemicals while retaliating against those who raised concerns. Then there’s **David Fotouhi,** Trump’s nominee for deputy EPA administrator. As a lawyer, he represented corporate polluters and fought to overturn bans on asbestos, PFAS regulations, and federal protections for wetlands and streams. If confirmed, he’ll help lead an EPA bent on rolling back Biden-era protections that forced corporations to clean up toxic contamination and protect our drinking water. Let’s be clear: PFAS (aka “forever chemicals”) are some of the most dangerous substances on the planet. They don’t break down in the environment, they leach into our drinking water, and they accumulate in our bodies over time. These toxic substances are found in countless everyday products, including nonstick cookware, stain-resistant fabrics, waterproof clothing, food packaging, and even cosmetics. Exposure to PFAS has been linked to cancer, liver damage, infertility, and developmental harm to children. And the danger doesn’t stop with PFAS. Right now, there are more than 80,000 chemicals on the market — many of them unregulated — and the companies responsible for this pollution are spending millions to avoid accountability. We can’t afford to wait — Trump’s attacks on public health will hit frontline communities the hardest. We have to fight back. | Hi — Donald Trump is turning the Environmental Protection Agency into a polluter’s paradise — stacked with chemical industry insiders and corporate lawyers who are more interested in profits than protecting public health. = Meet Nancy Beck and Lynn Ann Dekleva — two chemical industry insiders who served in Trump’s first administration and are now returning to senior roles at the EPA to oversee critical regulations. Beck, a former executive at the American Chemistry Council, spent her last stint at the EPA rewriting rules to weaken protections against asbestos — a deadly carcinogen — and “forever chemicals” known as PFAS, which are linked to cancer and birth defects. Dekleva, who spent more than three decades at DuPont, a chemical giant infamous for its role in PFAS contamination, used her prior EPA role to push employees into approving harmful new chemicals while retaliating against those who raised concerns. Then there’s David Fotouhi, Trump’s nominee for deputy EPA administrator. As a lawyer, he represented corporate polluters and fought to overturn bans on asbestos, PFAS regulations, and federal protections for wetlands and streams. If confirmed, he’ll help lead an EPA bent on rolling back Biden-era protections that forced corporations to clean up toxic contamination and protect our drinking water. Let’s be clear: PFAS (aka “forever chemicals”) are some of the most dangerous substances on the planet. They don’t break down in the environment, they leach into our drinking water, and they accumulate in our bodies over time. These toxic substances are found in countless everyday products, including nonstick cookware, stain-resistant fabrics, waterproof clothing, food packaging, and even cosmetics. Exposure to PFAS has been linked to cancer, liver damage, infertility, and developmental harm to children. And the danger doesn’t stop with PFAS. Right now, there are more than 80,000 chemicals on the market — many of them unregulated — and the companies responsible for this pollution are spending millions to avoid accountability. subject: Two things
body:
---
We’ll get straight to the point. It’s clear that this moment demands a Democratic Party that can do two things:
1. Mobilize and organize Democrats against Trump and his billionaire allies’ harmful policies.
2. Build the infrastructure we’ll need to elect Democrats at all levels of government — leaders who will check Trump’s power in their cities, districts, and states.

That’s our mission, Derek. It may not be flashy work, but it’s absolutely essential right now. Peter, This is one of the most serious, and most disturbing, threats to Christians in public life . . . yet most Christians in America don't know anything about it! **The last, and strongest, line of legal defense for Christians in the United States may soon be destroyed by ideological activists, with a regulatory change being considered in ALL 50 states.** That could make critical legal victories for Americans of faith--like protection of **personal prayer** without getting fired, protection of **moral conscience** so you can't be forced to dispense abortion-inducing drugs, and even protection of students forming a **Christian student club** --IMPOSSIBLE to pursue . . . . . . and leave Christians and Americans of faith, alongside religious ministries, nonprofits, and schools, without ANY legal defense when they wrongly and unconstitutionally face threats or punishment for their biblical values! **Peter, Christian Legal Society, a fellowship, ministry, and legal defense organization since 1961, is leading the fight to protect Christian attorneys and all Americans of faith, state by state.** _**[_**Against a well-organized, well-funded opposition, we're counting on the support of generous Americans of faith like you to stand with us. Would you consider a gift of $25, $50, $75, $100, $250, or even $500 to help support Christian Legal Society in this critical work?**_](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=d340ada0376e42f1ae6c19587f3f0f1c&_e=8KOlKLEu8K-cdc6jVCTDxgfegBXijB5LBgJoSWyr2hPvG9qApdsaNKgvaUWnkM8rum8FCSFghyTMW9TbQoAC0F99FzT0oT5dXIXfliiw0ZjJu12hriyMDPyw-SFYvOFBS1eh9sP3RBLhWcpWdEKM7DRXRB3rCdjdXzWhtXOnLQqBoBgbf8D-46rl83KvnbkTqTHMCznBS8TriTZ2bOU2jZdOQmE4vlCNtyWMNB9bzOrGHRfG8_0O1fwKfZaIiZyCg3_kneT_xmB2-TOsWm5BbzBRN2SQxAS2Dg4_5tfPCaSFMZu0Geyx6iXUlmS49Lt3)**_

For those who don't work in law offices, the rule change I'm discussing may sound boring or unremarkable: it's known as Model Rule 8.4(g) from the American Bar Association. **But its impact has devastating real-world consequences for Christian attorneys and all Americans of faith, as the silencing and punishment of Christian attorneys --and the faithful Americans they would otherwise defend--seems to be the sole goal of this rule change.** Without any examples of why it's needed . . . without any response to the 400+ comments and letters of concern submitted by all attorneys concerned with free speech, the American Bar Association offered no response to rightful concerns that radical activists could use this to:
* **discourage or punish attorneys** from sharing political, social, or religious viewpoints that are outside the current political orthodoxy (today, that's typically defined as "progressive" or "Woke");

* **stop attorneys from volunteering at their churches,** sitting on church boards, or serving schools they've gone to, if those schools are Christian or otherwise religious;

* **prevent attorneys from serving in Christian ministries** , no matter how much good work those ministries do in their communities; and

* **put an end to Christian attorneys doing pro bono work** **to defend religious freedom** on behalf of Christian ministries, nonprofits, or schools that proudly proclaim their commitment to biblical values!

**Peter, there is still time to stop this rule from taking root in America . . . but it requires a 50-state strategy and a major investment of time, talent, and legal work.** Christian Legal Society has led the charge on this important issue since it was first raised in 2015. But to make sure we WIN this fight--and preserve religious freedom and protection for Christian attorneys and, by extension, all Americans of faith--I'm counting on your support. _**[_**Can I count on your generous gift of $25, $50, $75, $100, $250, or even $500 to help Christian Legal Society save these critical protections for Christian attorneys . . . and every ministry, nonprofit, or believer that those same attorneys would defend?**_](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=d340ada0376e42f1ae6c19587f3f0f1c&_e=8KOlKLEu8K-cdc6jVCTDxgfegBXijB5LBgJoSWyr2hPvG9qApdsaNKgvaUWnkM8rum8FCSFghyTMW9TbQoAC0F99FzT0oT5dXIXfliiw0ZjJu12hriyMDPyw-SFYvOFBS1eh9sP3RBLhWcpWdEKM7DRXRB3rCdjdXzWhtXOnLQo4-vlRFaDTW_hhZGz4UZKwWtipv4qxcqem1IeWeLQ1lldLmN-ke7NIxkDIXC7XIp9nlXelbwSN7NXN65rfP9VDES2fY3wt805QHiYmeSuMPT2_OaI59kCdLzF7LCYzMU7-JQcvcTuxMqldPuxqkONm)**_

And for nearly 50 years, Christian Legal Society's Center for Law & Religious Freedom, which is spearheading the response to this proposed rule change, has defended and advanced all Americans' inalienable rights to religious freedom and life in the public square. **No other organization is leading the charge to defend Christian attorneys and all Americans of faith on this critical issue like Christian Legal Society.** _**[That's why I encourage you--and hope--that you'll make your most generous gift of $25, $50, $75, $100, $250, $500, or more right now to help Christian Legal Society WIN critical victories in the battles still to come.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=d340ada0376e42f1ae6c19587f3f0f1c&_e=8KOlKLEu8K-cdc6jVCTDxgfegBXijB5LBgJoSWyr2hPvG9qApdsaNKgvaUWnkM8rum8FCSFghyTMW9TbQoAC0F99FzT0oT5dXIXfliiw0ZjJu12hriyMDPyw-SFYvOFBS1eh9sP3RBLhWcpWdEKM7DRXRB3rCdjdXzWhtXOnLQpG1rz1xYVpSTXm4N4tjU6isQct5N0NLNkdK-iluXgXX0jY_flsnoUow7Ezh97Sct-STrwe1LNeiMKj1n2Ya8th4-Z0HebpR3fk7fIWjSA7b6RTCWCmucB0Nf0eTu53JLJh167BDllPnArIPTrpNFS0)**_ Thank you for your support and for your prayerful consideration. ## **Text me!**
Text "SPICER" to (833) 455-4513 to join my text list and I'll send updates on all the highlights of Trump's first 100 days.
## Read my latest OpEd on why the EO's on the border are a good start -- but how Congress needs to get involved:
[Executive Orders Are a Good Start, But We Need Lasting Immigration Reform. Here's Where to Start | Opinion](https://substack.com/redirect/99b55993-3428-4c74-a5a0-7f1744dec864?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) -- Via Newsweek
## Stories I'm Reading...
[Here's Everything President Trump Accomplished in Week One](https://substack.com/redirect/7f407fa8-3500-4e45-bbaa-a0e7c42b704e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) -- via Upward News
[Young Republicans at some college campuses are politically obsessed and more vocal than they have been in years --](https://substack.com/redirect/df46959e-a657-44bb-a82f-a322509897a1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) via Wall Street Journal
[AI's political bias](https://substack.com/redirect/687306c7-a7ba-4132-b26e-b73da349e272?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) -- via Patrick Ruffini
[End the Corporation for Public Broadcasting](https://substack.com/redirect/91ea540e-0d5a-4cb7-83ba-e51163f8f6a6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) \- via Daily Signal
[Exclusive: Trump Revives Mexico City Policy, Rescinds Biden Abortion Initiatives ](https://substack.com/redirect/eb059ee7-81dd-4947-a700-948196e71864?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)-- via Real Clear Politics
## **Media Coverage reverts to the old Trump playbook ... **
Am I surprised? No. But here are my big takeaways on how the media immediately reverted to their old playbook on covering the White House.
The leftist in the White House press corps loved to complain about access to Biden, but when President Trump did a presser on his first full day in office to discuss major action, NewsNation, carried it live. As did CSPAN and Fox. But not CNN or MSNBC. ...

clean_body: | | | Peter, Overnight, the Trump administration ordered a halt to "all federal financial assistance," which threatened to take food right out of children’s mouths and immediately cut off aid that countless families rely on every day.1 Already, numerous state agencies across the country are reporting they are not able to access federal funds — including a shutdown of the Medicaid payment system: School lunches, WIC, EBT, SNAP, and Meals on Wheels — which feed tens of millions of people each year — were all put at risk. Medicaid and cancer research programs were put on the chopping block too. As well as programs like Head Start and Section 8 rental assistance. And one week in, it’s just the start of their larger plans. If we don't stop them, Trump and Congressional Republicans are set to cause immense and immediate pain to millions and millions of working people — Republicans and Democrats, in red states and blue alike — all so they can line billionaires’ pockets with more cash. And if we don’t mobilize, working families are going to suffer the consequences. Trump and Republicans WANT working class people to believe that the government simply can't deliver for ordinary people. So their plan is to break it to make sure it can't. It’s no coincidence that, while he tries to gut funding for food stamps, childhood education, and housing assistance for the elderly, he is simultaneously trying to RAISE taxes on families earning less than $360,000 annually.2 We will share more ways to take action as soon as we learn more. Please stay safe in the meantime, and do all that you can to combat this. In solidarity, Team WFP Source: 1\. , Politico, January 27th, 2025 2\. , Institute on Taxation and Economic Policy, December 12th, 2024 Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. # FROM THE DESK OF MONICA CROWLEY
---

One of the things that still deeply concerns me, however, is the state of our press.

Without reliable newspapers fairly calling balls and strikes, anything can happen.

**It 's for this reason that the recent revival of the famed New York Sun is so vital.**

| Friend – Monday, January 27th was the 50th anniversary of the opening of the famous Church Committee hearings exposing the rot and criminal corruption inside the U.S. intelligence community. On behalf of The LaRouche Organization, I have issued a special statement titled ["Is There a Democrat in the Senate with Half the Integrity of Frank Church?"](https://laroucheorganization.nationbuilder.com/r?u=6U-bS5myFB-qaXONaTKygW8Bw5o4M8XoHC3TxaP90HMeGy_uGspnCd41OAzRQnsXpuHFpQ6dOOUdqkKcECLnpWELf-6hF7xGtN4vQ3TBZomRbQ6yB9CGkmBwuUSGvQtzbmVEVbiCkS5rqVtKfJV-0Q&e=8fa7b86c85d8b09f0015ebe544605791&utm_source=laroucheorganization&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20250128_mobilization_email&n=2) to rally the support required to secure the nominations of Tulsi Gabbard (Director of National Intelligence), and Kash Patel (FBI director). **The Gabbard and Patel nominations come up for confirmation hearings before the Senate Intelligence and Judiciary Committees, respectively, this Thursday morning Jan. 30.** President Trump needs a team that shares his commitment to dismantling the rotten apparatus which has made a mockery of our justice system, and lied us into war after war, while suppressing the rights of American citizens, including the outrageous targeting of America’s leading statesman, Lyndon LaRouche.
## What you can do:
* Pour calls and emails into the US Senate demanding the confirmations of Gabbard and Patel.**The switchboard number to reach all offices is 202-224-3121.** Insist, as I do in my statement, that Democratic Senators step up in the image of Democrat Frank Church 50 years ago.

* The LaRouche Organization will will have a substantial delegation on the ground visiting all Senate offices starting tomorrow (Wednesday, Jan. 28.) **Call your Senators and set up meetings with the TLO spokespeople on your behalf** – exercise your constituent rights! Even getting the request in, whether the office responds or not, can increase the chances for meetings on Wednesday. Note that LaRouche Organization representatives will also be closely coordinating on the ground with Team Kennedy activists to secure Robert F. Kennedy's nomination as well.

* Mobilize others, via social media, talk show call-ins, local elected/institutional figures, to do the same.

[](https://laroucheorganization.nationbuilder.com/r?u=6U-bS5myFB-qaXONaTKygW8Bw5o4M8XoHC3TxaP90HMeGy_uGspnCd41OAzRQnsXpuHFpQ6dOOUdqkKcECLnpWELf-6hF7xGtN4vQ3TBZomRbQ6yB9CGkmBwuUSGvQtzbmVEVbiCkS5rqVtKfJV-0Q&e=8fa7b86c85d8b09f0015ebe544605791&utm_source=laroucheorganization&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20250128_mobilization_email&n=3)The LaRouche Organization statement can be downloaded and printed out for distribution (below). On behalf of The LaRouche Organization, I have issued a special statement titled to rally the support required to secure the nominations of Tulsi Gabbard (Director of National Intelligence), and Kash Patel (FBI director). The Gabbard and Patel nominations come up for confirmation hearings before the Senate Intelligence and Judiciary Committees, respectively, this Thursday morning Jan. 30. President Trump needs a team that shares his commitment to dismantling the rotten apparatus which has made a mockery of our justice system, and lied us into war after war, while suppressing the rights of American citizens, including the outrageous targeting of America’s leading statesman, Lyndon LaRouche. What you can do: Pour calls and emails into the US Senate demanding the confirmations of Gabbard and Patel.The switchboard number to reach all offices is 202-224-3121. Insist, as I do in my statement, that Democratic Senators step up in the image of Democrat Frank Church 50 years ago. The LaRouche Organization will will have a substantial delegation on the ground visiting all Senate offices starting tomorrow (Wednesday, Jan. 28.) Call your Senators and set up meetings with the TLO spokespeople on your behalf – exercise your constituent rights! Even getting the request in, whether the office responds or not, can increase the chances for meetings on Wednesday. Note that LaRouche Organization representatives will also be closely coordinating on the ground with Team Kennedy activists to secure Robert F. Kennedy's nomination as well. Mobilize others, via social media, talk show call-ins, local elected/institutional figures, to do the same. LaRouche Organization statement can be downloaded and printed out for distribution (below). | "DOWNLOAD LEAFLET" Finally, please review my recent interview with former U.N. Hi Peter, Session just started, and I’m already writing to you today with our **first Major Threats to a Healthy Oregon this session: House Bill 3119** , that will delay Oregon’s clean truck policies for healthier air. With Trump back in the White House and threats to our climate and environment coming down from the federal level, we need to do _more_ in Oregon to take action on climate, not backtrack. Now is the time for us to put our foot down on this Major Threat, otherwise the rest of session will be riddled with them. There’s no way around this fact: diesel pollution has devastating impacts, and Oregon communities are already suffering. Diesel pollution specifically contains 40 cancer-causing compounds, contributes to 176 premature deaths annually, and costs our state $2 billion in health impacts each year. One of the fastest ways to cut this deadly pollution is by implementing our state’s long-established clean truck rules, yet oil and gas companies have launched their attack on these policies.**Major Threat HB 3119 is a deliberate attack on our promise of healthier air.**[**Tell your lawmakers to oppose this Major Threat now!**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/101130886/525011995/-588111136?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQ3MmJjNTA5LWJiZGQtZWYxMS04OGY4LTAwMjI0ODJhOTU3OSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=2lE835sdzKY-j3kzxt0ZEPHOw5WEKpdbBjvz9J5RNuM=&emci=54aba768-d0dc-ef11-88f8-0022482a9579&emdi=d72bc509-bbdd-ef11-88f8-0022482a9579&ceid=2107230)

| | Delaying the implementation of Oregon’s clean truck rules would deepen the climate, pollution, and health crises and jeopardize our chance for healthier, cleaner air. Here’s why delaying these standards is a Major Threat for a Healthy Oregon:
* **It’s a false crisis.** Many manufacturers already meet these standards based on market demand; only 6% of overall trucks do not already meet these standards. Electric trucks are increasingly cost-competitive, being twice as cheap to refuel as their diesel counterparts. Oregon’s businesses should not be denied the opportunity to adopt cleaner, more affordable technologies.
* **Delays will harm public health.** Every year of delay means more toxic diesel emissions in our air, increasing cancer risks in 19 of Oregon’s 36 counties and disproportionately impacting vulnerable communities. clean_body: Oil and gas companies have launched a new attack against clean air. Tell your lawmakers to oppose Major Threat HB 3119!| | | Hi Peter, Session just started, and I’m already writing to you today with our first Major Threats to a Healthy Oregon this session: House Bill 3119 , that will delay Oregon’s clean truck policies for healthier air. With Trump back in the White House and threats to our climate and environment coming down from the federal level, we need to do more in Oregon to take action on climate, not backtrack. Now is the time for us to put our foot down on this Major Threat, otherwise the rest of session will be riddled with them. There’s no way around this fact: diesel pollution has devastating impacts, and Oregon communities are already suffering. Diesel pollution specifically contains 40 cancer-causing compounds, contributes to 176 premature deaths annually, and costs our state $2 billion in health impacts each year. One of the fastest ways to cut this deadly pollution is by implementing our state’s long-established clean truck rules, yet oil and gas companies have launched their attack on these policies.Major Threat HB 3119 is a deliberate attack on our promise of healthier air. | | Delaying the implementation of Oregon’s clean truck rules would deepen the climate, pollution, and health crises and jeopardize our chance for healthier, cleaner air. Here’s why delaying these standards is a Major Threat for a Healthy Oregon: It’s a false crisis. Many manufacturers already meet these standards based on market demand; only 6% of overall trucks do not already meet these standards. Electric trucks are increasingly cost-competitive, being twice as cheap to refuel as their diesel counterparts. Oregon’s businesses should not be denied the opportunity to adopt cleaner, more affordable technologies. Delays will harm public health. Every year of delay means more toxic diesel emissions in our air, increasing cancer risks in 19 of Oregon’s 36 counties and disproportionately impacting vulnerable communities. It is estimated to lead to and cost billions of dollars in health impacts. It threatens Oregon’s clean tech leadership. Oregon’s Clean Tech Task Force has called out the need to maintain strong policies for a thriving clean tech sector. Delays undermine this progress, risking hundreds of millions in private investments and growth in sustainable jobs. Federal uncertainty makes action critical. With threats to national air quality standards, Oregon cannot count on federal backstops. Protecting our clean truck standards ensures our state continues leading on clean air and climate. We cannot afford to delay Oregon’s clean truck rules when DEQ has already adopted additional compliance and will be engaging in ongoing conversations during the permanent rule making process. Our state leaders must protect our clean air and oppose HB 3119 for your health and the health of the entire state. We have a supermajority - now is not the time to let things slide! There is no time to wait. We need as much support as we can get to defend our state against this Major Threat and stand up for climate action. The health and climate of our state matters more than the profit of oil and gas companies.** Sincerely, Eliza Walton (she/they) OLCV Coalition Director | | | | | ---|---|--- Oregon League of Conservation Voters 1110 SE Alder Suite 220 Portland, OR 97214 United States If you believe you received this message in error or wish to no longer receive email from us, please .

| Dear Hello Thanks to those of you who have written me back with your comments and feedback. I especially appreciate those saying the Honey Badger Report has been an "invaluable resource."
Thank you.
It's encouraging to me that you're reading this publication, and most importantly acting, commenting during public comment in committees and subcommittees.
You're making a difference.
If you missed my interview on The Schilling Show today with Rob Schilling, please click [here](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001UhpjMrFsFKAXAuutun-2l02YNIqZ02-8O9t2p7rMXloJHAmbybfG0_IFQtSu6tCjYG9tFDi3yf6Xg1wG6xiC-Vv6qsFEWY3rYICb3b705hvQIgfIydHax6r6ArUEwA6D636_gdkQKjtMn1W5_q1jT1S10LjhK5miE0reSm7xzlDnNvobORhZeS5kmd_mPOqT&c=4YwYb0Kjf0golh6NXQceZM0094hzIQHojPDNqYLKp2EcUATLDIokzQ==&ch=7Yke2OAOIXfN9rBJ-TzT1wqMHFYCGhkZUUXSuFAVvRJ5mbffb0nbiQ==) to listen as I give an update on what happened today in Richmond and what's coming up tomorrow. It's a 30 minute interview.
Today was an especially busy day as Senators seek to finish all Senate bills prior to legislative crossover, which takes places at midnight next Tuesday. All Senate bills must be dealt with before this Constitutional deadline. After crossover, our focus will be on House bills that passed the full House. So if you have a House Bill that's important to you, stay tuned. We will address House bills after crossover.
That said, the Governor's initiative "no tax on tips," was not heard today.

What was debated on the full Senate floor was[ SB883, also called the "boyfriend loophole" ](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001UhpjMrFsFKAXAuutun-2l02YNIqZ02-8O9t2p7rMXloJHAmbybfG0_IFQtSu6tCjfIOTODd-7y2jU3p8jnHYB1iIvhvDMlI7l7wsf6dHAOtTmfZ2BQbM1XqqVLYBFi5e10ez8S_M37zLcjk2YyvKBa6fgLmqbjKNZ5okkWLHCF01R5GKgr1-wvsYjFRhMfkt&c=4YwYb0Kjf0golh6NXQceZM0094hzIQHojPDNqYLKp2EcUATLDIokzQ==&ch=7Yke2OAOIXfN9rBJ-TzT1wqMHFYCGhkZUUXSuFAVvRJ5mbffb0nbiQ==)introduced by Democrat Senator and attorney Perry. This bill passed the full Democrat controlled Senate as expected. However, what I was not expecting was Republican support by Senator Muchi. The bill passed 21 to 17, with Republican Senator French and Democrat Senator Aird not voting.
[SB886 (Perry)](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001UhpjMrFsFKAXAuutun-2l02YNIqZ02-8O9t2p7rMXloJHAmbybfG0_IFQtSu6tCjoyW_QXjZ3ozDYKZbvTjNKiFfmCfz-yI85CReiBF9tHTh3JL75Wb-aVU7H5vAbMAfOUT06FqVULcCGFiJvdlw920D7lJChZZGo8u-0y4QwImPBKP8_dLBaKqajdnLzKQN&c=4YwYb0Kjf0golh6NXQceZM0094hzIQHojPDNqYLKp2EcUATLDIokzQ==&ch=7Yke2OAOIXfN9rBJ-TzT1wqMHFYCGhkZUUXSuFAVvRJ5mbffb0nbiQ==) Trigger activator, definition, penalty, also passed the full Senate 21 to 18, with Senator French not voting.
[SB1182 (Deeds)](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001UhpjMrFsFKAXAuutun-2l02YNIqZ02-8O9t2p7rMXloJHAmbybfG0_IFQtSu6tCjwrpoPYdLZlY-JXgFk3F1lMgBG5ssuwQM68cbJnUTG100oJfHgxoqe5PUp4zuKv3QL6EyqfokDjwSX3VK3Da4dW6CgA7DmnHsA4U3MXfiY_3FMk-y1eOoiwqYXQH2t4Gr&c=4YwYb0Kjf0golh6NXQceZM0094hzIQHojPDNqYLKp2EcUATLDIokzQ==&ch=7Yke2OAOIXfN9rBJ-TzT1wqMHFYCGhkZUUXSuFAVvRJ5mbffb0nbiQ==) Capitol Square or building owned/leased by the Commonwealth, carrying firearm/explosives, passed the full Senate 21 to 18, with Senator French not voting.
[SB728 (Hashmi, Pekarsky)](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001UhpjMrFsFKAXAuutun-2l02YNIqZ02-8O9t2p7rMXloJHAmbybfG0wpdS8Ksz5gmWEvzxRtdesfZAD9bobWLcaqhB_gMu7jBa_Tnj-SBpjak3o8NL_uet3OWzDlddRdsBiIhIGnrHd2EBF5Cd_ikl6wEyprjV-mv9gpwC7VKfyGUW-FS87YleOUuwlL4Jaia&c=4YwYb0Kjf0golh6NXQceZM0094hzIQHojPDNqYLKp2EcUATLDIokzQ==&ch=7Yke2OAOIXfN9rBJ-TzT1wqMHFYCGhkZUUXSuFAVvRJ5mbffb0nbiQ==) Public elementary and secondary schools; student discipline; student cell phones, passed the full Senate 21 to 18, with Senator French not voting.
Tomorrow is going to be another busy day. Here are the bills that I've highlighted coming up by committee. For more detail, just click on the name of the committee on the schedule above for a complete listing.

Peter — Taken straight out of the Project 2025 playbook, Donald Trump has ordered a pause on congressionally approved federal grants and loans.

Not only is this blatantly unconstitutional, but it will also have devastating effects on communities across Vermont and every other state.

Hundreds of millions of Americans depend on federal assistance for disaster relief, child care, food assistance, farm subsidies, and so on — but Trump’s unprecedented decision to pause congressionally approved funds rips billions of dollars from our communities and leaves folks without the funds they’re counting on.

It means communities hit hard by extreme weather events won’t be able to rebuild. Roads and bridges left incomplete.

It leaves scientists and doctors researching cancer without the funds they need to continue progressing toward a life-saving cure.

And it takes away a child’s access to education during the most formative years of their life by halting funding for preschools.

Peter, Trump continues to show us that his priorities lie in inflating his own unchecked power and lining the pockets of his billionaire friends — not making life easier for working people.

I first joined Congress with one primary goal: To alleviate suffering. That’s why in the wake of this news, I want to reaffirm this commitment to you.

I will never stop fighting back against Trump’s Project 2025 agenda, especially as he continues his unconstitutional power grabs that harm working Americans.

Thank you for sticking by my side.

— Becca

name: Ernest Lineberger
subject: Update from Ernest Lineberger, January 28, 2025
body:
Hi Friends of Lineberger for US Congress!

One-week post-transfer of the U.S. Presidency.

As you know, a lot of Republicans, many MAGA types, won in the last
election. We are dealing with the impact. Some of it is horrible. Some
of it seems just ignorant, like stopping all foreign aid. People like you
and me ask, “Don’t they know why we give foreign aid?” Not only does it
help people, it helps us win friends and allies which we need as a nation.
But the truth is, they don’t care. In my view, in spite of all they say,
the MAGA mission is to gain enough power that they can continue to further
enrich the billionaires. Milk America’s Greatest Assets (MAGA). Their
problem now is that with $35 Trillion in debt and a large annual deficit,
America needs to be squeezed pretty hard to get much more cash out of it.

In my post-loss and pre-next candidacy phase, I’m sharing this message,
working to get my name more widely known as a champion for the people, and
partnering with real positive organizations to support our community. It
seems that our needs are only going to get worse. I don’t see Trump
lowering the cost of living for us. So, more people are going to need our
help.

In my last email in December, I shared a lot of information about Christian
Community Action (CCA). They are awesome and have my full support.

Since then, I have signed up with Meals on Wheels Denton County to sponsor
a senior and their pet. My monthly donation of about $200 is enough to
take a senior off the waiting list and get daily meal and safety check
services, plus food for their pet, from this caring team. These are
necessary, important and efficient services that help our neighbors
continue to live good lives.

I’ve also been very impressed by the United Way of Denton County. They had
a recent fundraiser gala where I sponsored a table with a donation of
$1250, plus that donation was matched by my employer for increased impact.

I’ve visited many different churches in the area and can report that they
are quite busy as well with multiple efforts to support the community and
enrich our spiritual health.

Last night, I attended a meeting of our local League of United Latin
American Citizens (LULAC). We discussed how to best support those
concerned with the presence of ICE personnel, arrests and deportations. We
also discussed plans for future community events, fundraising and
partnerships.

I spoke at a recent school board meeting where cost issues were forcing
hard decisions. A lot of parents went away angry, but I was convinced that
the board did their best for everyone given the funding situation from the
state.

We have many awesome organizations that are doing a lot for our community,
but could use our help and support. We must act as a counter to those who
would bring us down, and seem better organized.

Hopefully, by us being the ones out in our community, visibly helping
others through these tough times, while the MAGA contingent focuses on
unhelpful policies, more eyes may be opened. More minds and hearts may be
swayed. And more votes will come our way in 2026 to do more good.

The good news is that we have time. The FEC has told me that I can still
fundraise to recover debt from the last election. My website and ActBlue
are still up and active. Every donation received to recover 2024 election
debt will help put me in a better place for the 2026 election run. This
congressional district (Texas Congressional District 26 for U.S. House) did
not have a Democratic candidate in 2022. I was the first Democratic
candidate to run for this seat since the new lines were drawn after the
2020 census. By running again in 2026, we can make the best use of all
that was done last year to get my name and message in the community.

Here is the link to my 2024 campaign website with a lot of good information
about me, my history and policies.

https://www.linebergerforuscongress.com

Thank you for taking all of this in. It’s a lot. Just know that I’m
working to help our community and positioning myself to be your Better
Choice in 2026.

Ernest Lineberger

subject: Statement from the Indiana GOP Regarding Executive Order 25-29
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE INDIANA REPUBLICAN STATE COMMITTEE
body:

| | **For Immediate Release:** January 28, 2025

**Contact:** Gage Hoekstra, Press Secretary, **[ghoekstra@indiana.gop](mailto:greid@indiana.gop "greid@indiana.gop")**

**Indiana GOP Commends Governor Braun For Tackling Illegal Immigration** **INDIANAPOLIS (January 28, 2025)** – The Indiana Republican Party released the following statement regarding Governor Braun's Executive Order 25-29 on January 28, 2025.**
****
****Indianapolis** – After four years of former President Joe Biden’s open border policies allowing hundreds of thousands of illegal immigrants into the country, Governor Braun is working with President Trump to tackle the problem with his most recent executive order.

**“Governor Braun has been to our southern border, he stood with President Trump to build the wall, and he fought for the safety of our communities while in the Senate. His executive order ensures that state contractors are not using loopholes to hire illegal immigrants over American citizens, encourages Indiana law enforcement agencies to cooperate with federal immigration efforts to enforce the rule of law, and ensures communication with federal law enforcement authorities to protect our communities,”** said Indiana Republican Party Chairwoman Erin Lucas. **“Governor Braun’s order will keep Hoosiers safe and is a win for Indiana.” **

**BACKGROUND:** **Gov. Mike Braun leads on immigration to protect Hoosiers, rule of law.** “Governor Mike Braun ensured greater safety for Hoosiers with today’s signing of an executive order that protects the public from the threats posed by illegal aliens in our state. Today’s action also assists the Trump administration by offering full cooperation with the federal government. "Gov. Braun’s Executive Order delivers on his promise to place public safety operations at the forefront of collaboration with the Trump administration to manage immigration in Indiana. The Indiana Department of Administration and all agencies exercising contracting authority shall require state vendors, prior to entering any contract with the State, to certify their use of E-Verify to ensure their workforce is lawfully permitted to work in the United States and the State of Indiana. Taxpayer money will not fund the contracts of illegal immigrants. "Law enforcement agencies of the State of Indiana will report to the Indiana Intelligence Fusion Center credible evidence of illegal aliens with a prior criminal history and/or are suspected of committing a felony, suspected of engaging in terror or espionage, or who present a significant threat to national security or public safety. The Indiana National Guard will make available to the federal government the state resources of the Indiana National Guard and cooperate fully with US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE).” ([Press Release](http://links.email.in-gop.com/s/c/PTtLewSyIw8e6YieF6Y1ZeZ7ITwbkE1NuAmEtbKyKXyr_proZWf7T-nsp9Q22_8iKLNTOqZ6y4-LvrZC9atDWNDVqfpDL_bPeHh0Sa9CUimnzVjjoKp78ymEcm-KB7MXokrsWLLb36Wo1JwMTZ_4ev0lXvOAMcgPbJLhs6P07vjAKTLg-UYfQLp0hljWC5JYZ7Y1vc2cHKGT8_5gBiHIwGgR2mAxcZIBuIj2SDee3PfefWyYUkcIWYh_uV-eVYfMe-QxLngKCYsPPCJf8ixxPQVBvhX3AzndWiFw7-uM2nJRjhJgM4PPi81zHuf9DsbS65JAA_U4eHG1To3xdZbNWP6dqaIPKZKHa6EHusLg0FBsB-B7X797HtBiIxq9z01ALulJ8xr1VZU1NoTj1fKmVUAP_-fMJGULdZbq2HXYMGoxwobuXxuF3jlPYqdpVGOCoHHHak3X7NRi/y4gwjeGZBo_c-5pw3gTiyM8YC8m8fxse/5 "https://www.in.gov/gov/newsroom/executive-orders/"), 01/28/25) [Executive Order 25-29](http://links.email.in-gop.com/s/c/sbIY61kFx6rfd2UIqT4B0L-Ljc1ce87_XoXPp97-jh3S1M0EcCE3ZavJ_ColXcNwQrD3rHqmLUjXJrTReb7plPJgNzKkseojnYUjZIOAXGoY5UvSGJXLZOArphnowSOV2b3dbMWacfvH4i4UC0l0P4LjjWHsCv6V81irnT-HeMEsSxDIili4ZDz-emNY0qNTflAxb53f6lblveFI9A8EhRHyzUmhJb1RDTEGxlADFFriJh5m_szY-r_IFtQhwH3Pss9t4QawAmvqDikJpUcOt-xGGpE/B2o57uXDsxecDmLOkAS9bmFR7acpHRLy/5) ###

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: Trump’s chaos is about to hurt millions of people
body:
Rent is due in a few days, and Trump is taking money out of people’s pockets.
#

Peter, I need your attention on this. It’s serious.
Rent is due in a few days, and Trump is taking money out of people’s pockets.
Late last night, the Trump administration put out a memo ordering a pause on “all agency grant, loan and other financial assistance programs” administered by the federal government. The “pause” starts at 5pm today, and we could be talking about up to $3 trillion in government support for people who really need it.
That’s all a lot DC talk though, so let me break it down a bit:
Meals on Wheels for seniors — frozen.
Veteran Suicide Hotline — frozen.
Bulletproof vests for police — frozen.
School lunches for hungry kids — frozen.
Housing and rent assistance — frozen.
Medicaid payments — frozen.
It goes on and on, and we know why he's doing this. Trump's cooking up an absolutely massive tax cut for the richest people on the planet, and they're going to pay for it by taking food out of the mouths of hungry kids, or kicking veterans out of their apartments. It's insane.
And I want to be clear here, because this is important: Congress appropriates the funds. Trump doesn't get to choose what to spend it on, he doesn't get to determine if it's not aligned with “presidential priorities,” doesn't matter. Trump wants to decide on his own — and that is unconstitutional.
So, what do we do?
First off, this is going to court. That’s happening around the country as you read this.
But on our side, and for those immediately impacted, we're working to identify the full scope of this order. We're going to fight this administration tooth and nail to get help to the people who need it. But beyond all that, we have to make some noise about this.
We can't sit back and take it. I need you to speak out.
[**I'm asking you to add your name and join me in denouncing this unconstitutional power grab from the Trump administration, and then I want you to tell everybody you know what's happening right now. Everyone has a role to play, and yours is essential.** [ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/signup/pet_em_250128_OMB/?source=em250128-1-120&akid=3682%2E734936%2EXCSmok) This is important. Thanks for joining me. Ruben

### Referring to our Democratic leaders, one woman asked, "Can they grow a spine?"
| | [Paula Collins](https://substack.com/@paulaforcongress)

I want to address something that I've heard from a few sources in the last 24 hours. It's the idea of working "across the aisle" to find common ground with MAGA Republicans or Donald Trump.
### That worked in prior decades. I was raised to believe this was what we called "statesmanship" - a spirit of compromise that we wanted our elected officials to embrace.
Bipartisan compromise worked before the nation's politics were hijacked by the likes of Donald Trump, and before every single 24 hour period brought more news about unconstitutional firings, or flagrant disposal of key protocols in our institutions.
The plan to work to find common ground with MAGA Republicans is a slippery slope. Just ask some of Trump's former business associates, his accountant, and more than a few of his staffers. Don't kid yourself -- the idea that someone could go along with Trump's plans and then rely upon their individual critical thinking to snap back onto moral high ground is folly.
We cannot plan, in advance, to show deference to Donald Trump.
Let's talk about the border - so important in the North Country of New York State. Remember that we had a bipartisan border policy in the prior administration and I wager that we could have another border policy if Congress would simply take action.
But members of this Republican Congress are just as distracted by the constant stream of orders from the Executive Office as we are. Two weeks into his administration, and Donald Trump has done everything from firing prosecutors to releasing the January 6 insurrectionists. (So much for "Back the Blue" and law and order.) He cut off aid to government programs with no warning, and no clear instructions. As I type this, I'm getting reports of Medicaid, Head Start, and child support programs are frozen, leaving people who are already vulnerable out of luck.
No doubt, Trump has been busy. Nonetheless, he found a way to spend the big bucks on military deportation flights, and time for a rally in Las Vegas.
### Donald Trump and his Congress have not presented a workable immigration bill.
Our soon-to-resign Congresswoman Stefanik spent many a press op screeching into the microphone about the border, blaming it on Joe Biden and Kamala Harris. But while Trump promised to get us a workable immigration policy, he instead jumped right into mass deportations, resulting in trauma to communities and damage to our relationships with allies such as Colombia.
### Donald Trump is not a man who can be worked with.
### Donald Trump has acted and continues to act unconstitutionally.
There are many examples of Trump's new roster of unconstitutional acts. What I want to present to you as a crystal clear example is Trump's threat to our allies, including Greenland and Panama.
These are not policy differences. This is not something that we should shrug and say, "Well, that's Donald Trump." These are international war crimes. These are U.S. crimes. 18 U.S. Code § 960 says that whoever knowingly takes part in any enterprise to be carried out against a people with whom the U.S. is at peace shall be fined or imprisoned or both. Here it is:
> Whoever, within the United States, knowingly begins or sets on foot or provides or prepares a means for or furnishes the money for, or takes part in, any military or naval expedition or enterprise to be carried on from thence against the territory or dominion of any foreign prince or state, or of any colony, district, or people with whom the United States is at peace, shall be fined under this title or imprisoned not more than three years, or both. 18 U.S. Code § 960
And 28 U.S. Code § 2441(a) states the following:
> (a) Offense.-Whoever, whether inside or outside the United States, commits a war crime, in any of the circumstances described in subsection (b), shall be fined under this title or imprisoned for life or any term of years, or both, and if death results to the victim, shall also be subject to the penalty of death.
> (b) Circumstances.-The circumstances referred to in subsection (a) are that the person committing such war crime or the victim of such war crime is a member of the Armed Forces of the United States or a national of the United States (as defined in section 101 of the Immigration and Nationality Act). 28 U.S. Code § 2441(a)
If we're planning to send our troops into Greenland or Panama, we advise those enlisted men and women that they are on very shaky ground.
For that matter, Trump has also threatened aggressive acts (not necessarily military acts) against Colombia, Mexico, and Canada.
These are our laws. Our elected representatives drafted them and approved them. They are not to be discarded on the whim of some oligarch.
### We are not electing someone to go to DC to be neighborly.
I understand that elected representatives come from communities. All of us want to be good neighbors. We all want to be able to go to events at our children's school or other events in town and not be at odds with the other people there, including our neighbors who voted for Trump.
But the people of NY-21 are not sending someone to Congress to be neighborly. We're sending someone to Congress to protect and defend the U.S. Constitution, and to fight for the interests of the people of New York 21.
### You wouldn't want the players at the Superbowl to do anything other than play offense and defense.
I liken it to the Superbowl we have coming up on February 9th. The players of the Kansas City Chiefs and the Philadelphia Eagles are not going to New Orleans on Feb 9th to be friendly, running around giving high-fives up and down the field with the other team. People pay money -- serious money -- to go to see their team spar and to come out ahead. The time for bro-culture, super athlete camaraderie is in the off-season, or some other time. When people see the Superbowl teams on the field, they want to see each team member play offense and defense to get that ball over the goal line and win the game.
The same concept applies in Congress. The stakes are so much higher.
### We are in a new era in American politics.
We need our elected representatives to know that we expect them to play their Congressional Superbowl game of offense and defense so that our Constitution can win. That is a very tall order! We aren't just arguing with Republicans about a few percentage points on the tax rates of real estate partnerships. We are fighting against a party headed up by someone who is a convicted felon and who continues, on a daily basis, to commit more crimes.
### You wouldn't work with criminals in your own neighborhood. Don't send someone to Congress who plans to work alongside criminals in Washington DC.
I'm going to Congress to make sure we don't lose any more quality of life or financial security for our people here in the North Country. We already lost the caps on prescription drug prices that Democrats worked hard to get. Next on the chopping block: Veteran's health care, medicaid, medicare, social security. In fact, Medicaid funding in New York is frozen as of around 2:30pm Eastern Time on January 28.
### "Can they grow a spine?" a supporter asked me when I asked her what she wanted to see Democrats do in Congress.
As I call voters to find out what's on their minds, I hear from a lot of people who want Democratic leaders to stand up to this new regime. "Can they grow a spine?" one woman asked emphatically this morning.
Mark my words. Democrats are organizing and demanding that their representatives work offensively and defensively to stand strong against Trump's destructive orders. Democrats are not looking for representatives who are going to shake hands and compromise, risking financial security and peace of mind for everyday Americans.
### For this session of Congress, we need strong a Democrat who will protect everyday Americans in New York's North Country.
The North Country neighbor you elect to Congress needs to go in with eyes wide open. Save that idea of statesmanship and reaching across the aisle that we all grew up with for some other time, likely some session of Congress other than the 119th. We can resume our traditions of compromise after we have restored our government norms, protected our Constitution, and verified that any legislation we work on is going to help, not hurt, life for everyday Americans right here in the North Country.

clean_body: Referring to our Democratic leaders, one woman asked, "Can they grow a spine?" | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more NY-21 Updates on the Congressional Race * Referring to our Democratic leaders, one woman asked, "Can they grow a spine?" | | | Jan 28 | | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- I want to address something that I've heard from a few sources in the last 24 hours. It's the idea of working "across the aisle" to find common ground with MAGA Republicans or Donald Trump. That worked in prior decades. I was raised to believe this was what we called "statesmanship" - a spirit of compromise that we wanted our elected officials to embrace. Bipartisan compromise worked before the nation's politics were hijacked by the likes of Donald Trump, and before every single 24 hour period brought more news about unconstitutional firings, or flagrant disposal of key protocols in our institutions. The plan to work to find common ground with MAGA Republicans is a slippery slope. Just ask some of Trump's former business associates, his accountant, and more than a few of his staffers. Don't kid yourself -- the idea that someone could go along with Trump's plans and then rely upon their individual critical thinking to snap back onto moral high ground is folly. We cannot plan, in advance, to show deference to Donald Trump. Let's talk about the border - so important in the North Country of New York State. Remember that we had a bipartisan border policy in the prior administration and I wager that we could have another border policy if Congress would simply take action. But members of this Republican Congress are just as distracted by the constant stream of orders from the Executive Office as we are. Two weeks into his administration, and Donald Trump has done everything from firing prosecutors to releasing the January 6 insurrectionists. (So much for "Back the Blue" and law and order.) He cut off aid to government programs with no warning, and no clear instructions. As I type this, I'm getting reports of Medicaid, Head Start, and child support programs are frozen, leaving people who are already vulnerable out of luck. No doubt, Trump has been busy. Nonetheless, he found a way to spend the big bucks on military deportation flights, and time for a rally in Las Vegas. Donald Trump and his Congress have not presented a workable immigration bill. Our soon-to-resign Congresswoman Stefanik spent many a press op screeching into the microphone about the border, blaming it on Joe Biden and Kamala Harris. But while Trump promised to get us a workable immigration policy, he instead jumped right into mass deportations, resulting in trauma to communities and damage to our relationships with allies such as Colombia. Donald Trump is not a man who can be worked with. Donald Trump has acted and continues to act unconstitutionally. There are many examples of Trump's new roster of unconstitutional acts. What I want to present to you as a crystal clear example is Trump's threat to our allies, including Greenland and Panama. These are not policy differences. This is not something that we should shrug and say, "Well, that's Donald Trump." These are international war crimes. These are U.S. crimes. 18 U.S. Code § 960 says that whoever knowingly takes part in any enterprise to be carried out against a people with whom the U.S. is at peace shall be fined or imprisoned or both. Here it is: Whoever, within the United States, knowingly begins or sets on foot or provides or prepares a means for or furnishes the money for, or takes part in, any military or naval expedition or enterprise to be carried on from thence against the territory or dominion of any foreign prince or state, or of any colony, district, or people with whom the United States is at peace, shall be fined under this title or imprisoned not more than three years, or both. 18 U.S. Code § 960 And 28 U.S. Code § 2441(a) states the following: (a) Offense.-Whoever, whether inside or outside the United States, commits a war crime, in any of the circumstances described in subsection (b), shall be fined under this title or imprisoned for life or any term of years, or both, and if death results to the victim, shall also be subject to the penalty of death. (b) Circumstances.-The circumstances referred to in subsection (a) are that the person committing such war crime or the victim of such war crime is a member of the Armed Forces of the United States or a national of the United States (as defined in section 101 of the Immigration and Nationality Act). 28 U.S. Code § 2441(a) If we're planning to send our troops into Greenland or Panama, we advise those enlisted men and women that they are on very shaky ground. For that matter, Trump has also threatened aggressive acts (not necessarily military acts) against Colombia, Mexico, and Canada. These are our laws. Our elected representatives drafted them and approved them. They are not to be discarded on the whim of some oligarch. We are not electing someone to go to DC to be neighborly. I understand that elected representatives come from communities. All of us want to be good neighbors. We all want to be able to go to events at our children's school or other events in town and not be at odds with the other people there, including our neighbors who voted for Trump. But the people of NY-21 are not sending someone to Congress to be neighborly. We're sending someone to Congress to protect and defend the U.S. Constitution, and to fight for the interests of the people of New York 21. You wouldn't want the players at the Superbowl to do anything other than play offense and defense. I liken it to the Superbowl we have coming up on February 9th. The players of the Kansas City Chiefs and the Philadelphia Eagles are not going to New Orleans on Feb 9th to be friendly, running around giving high-fives up and down the field with the other team. People pay money -- serious money -- to go to see their team spar and to come out ahead. The time for bro-culture, super athlete camaraderie is in the off-season, or some other time. When people see the Superbowl teams on the field, they want to see each team member play offense and defense to get that ball over the goal line and win the game. The same concept applies in Congress. The stakes are so much higher. We are in a new era in American politics. We need our elected representatives to know that we expect them to play their Congressional Superbowl game of offense and defense so that our Constitution can win. That is a very tall order! We aren't just arguing with Republicans about a few percentage points on the tax rates of real estate partnerships. We are fighting against a party headed up by someone who is a convicted felon and who continues, on a daily basis, to commit more crimes. You wouldn't work with criminals in your own neighborhood. Don't send someone to Congress who plans to work alongside criminals in Washington DC. I'm going to Congress to make sure we don't lose any more quality of life or financial security for our people here in the North Country. We already lost the caps on prescription drug prices that Democrats worked hard to get. Next on the chopping block: Veteran's health care, medicaid, medicare, social security. In fact, Medicaid funding in New York is frozen as of around 2:30pm Eastern Time on January 28. "Can they grow a spine?" a supporter asked me when I asked her what she wanted to see Democrats do in Congress. As I call voters to find out what's on their minds, I hear from a lot of people who want Democratic leaders to stand up to this new regime. "Can they grow a spine?" one woman asked emphatically this morning. Mark my words. Democrats are organizing and demanding that their representatives work offensively and defensively to stand strong against Trump's destructive orders. Democrats are not looking for representatives who are going to shake hands and compromise, risking financial security and peace of mind for everyday Americans. For this session of Congress, we need strong a Democrat who will protect everyday Americans in New York's North Country. The North Country neighbor you elect to Congress needs to go in with eyes wide open. Save that idea of statesmanship and reaching across the aisle that we all grew up with for some other time, likely some session of Congress other than the 119th. We can resume our traditions of compromise after we have restored our government norms, protected our Constitution, and verified that any legislation we work on is going to help, not hurt, life for everyday Americans right here in the North Country. If we haven 't met yet, I am Paula Collins, the Democrat who ran in New York's 21st Congressional District. I hope to run in the Special Election in 2025. Your comments are invaluable to me. Please let me hear from you. Remember that you can always visit my website at www.paulacollinsforcongress.com or by sending me a text at 315-230-3920. Donations are much appreciated. body:
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=012825_2&amount=25]
Folks,
On his first day in office, President Donald Trump issued an executive order ending birthright citizenship , an order that a Reagan-appointed judge called “ blatantly unconstitutional .” Now, dozens in the House of Representatives are co-sponsoring H.R. 569, which would also deny citizenship to children of non-citizens.
Birthright citizenship has been the law of the land since the Supreme Court ruled in US v. Wong Kim Ark that the Constitution granted citizenship to American-born children without a citizen parent.
Ending automatic citizenship for people born in the United States is the beginning of a slippery slope where citizenship and our rights could be denied to any of us. It's too dangerous to even contemplate further.
We all have to stand up right now and tell Congress: NO to ANY changes in birthright citizenship! >> [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/sign-defend-birthright-citizenship-and-our-constitution-stop-hr-569?source=direct_link&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions%3Frefcode%3Djabirthrightcitizenship]

body:
This new federal rule effectively raises wages for thousands of workers in PA + across the country.
#
Derek, did you catch the news?
John’s been working for over a year to get this finalized, and last week we finally got it done:
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20250128?refcode=em20250128-9839&refcode2=9839_434096_7c_kMA&akid=9839%2E434096%2E7c_kMA)
_— Pennsylvania Capital-Star_
The new rule ends a pay disparity that has existed for decades between hourly and salaried federal employees, **effectively raising wages for thousands of federal workers in PA + across the country.** 💪
John is working every day to get wins for folks in all 67 counties across our commonwealth. But with so much $$$ spent to flip PA red last year, he’s counting on your help to tune out the noise and keep up the work.

On January 20, the United Nations Human Rights Committee held Ecuador and Nicaragua accountable for severe human rights violations against three young survivors of sexual violence who were forced into motherhood because of abortion bans, ordering the countries to reform their laws to ensure access to abortion.

Brought by the Center for Reproductive Rights and our partners in Latin America's _Son Niñas, No Madres (Girls, Not Mothers) Movement_ , this ruling sets a powerful precedent for over **170 countries** under the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights, **protecting the rights of millions of women and girls.**

In the face of rising authoritarianism and new threats to the rights of women, girls, and people around the world, feminist-led movements in Latin America and the Global South are setting powerful global precedents in the fight for bodily freedom and dignity. **_The Son Niñas, No Madres_ victories are proof that, globally, law, policy, and popular opinion are bending toward justice.**

For the second time, President Donald Trump has signed an executive order to initiate the U.S. withdrawal from the World Health Organization (WHO). This decision threatens to unravel critical global health efforts.

WHO plays a vital role in setting global health standards, coordinating emergency responses, and providing technical support to countries worldwide. With the U.S. withdrawal:
* **Global health responses weaken:** WHO's ability to combat crises will be jeopardized.
* **Marginalized communities suffer most:** Low-income countries will face even greater barriers to accessing essential care.
* **Sexual and reproductive health sidelined:** Deprioritizing global health, including maternal health, HIV/STI treatment, and access to sexual and reproductive health care further stigmatizes this essential care.

This decision isolates the U.S. when unity is crucial and will have devastating consequences for the health and well-being of millions of people around the world.

As part of President Donald Trump's first week in office, he reinstated the "Global Gag Rule"—a sweeping policy that will decrease abortion access in countries around the world. This policy defunds health organizations in other countries that provide abortion services or even information, regardless of circumstances, including in cases of sexual assault.

The new executive order reflects Project 2025's agenda to expand the Global Gag Rule even further, targeting an estimated **$51 billion** in foreign assistance, including humanitarian aid. If implemented, this expansion would have catastrophic effects on global health and human rights. Read more about how this move jeopardizes billions in funding for global reproductive rights.

In response, the Center for Reproductive Rights is relaunching its [**Global Gag Rule Pro Bono Clearinghouse**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/101135102/525022914/-788023469?sourceid=1150339&utm_campaign=25emgfl-0101aaa-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=frontlines&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MGE5YTM5OC1jNWRkLWVmMTEtODhmOC0wMDIyNDgyYTk1NzkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uMYPG0K-3SxboHWNytKtCuGbdex3Z27hgGj4WlPi_u0=&emci=da537992-c5dd-ef11-88f8-0022482a9579&emdi=60a9a398-c5dd-ef11-88f8-0022482a9579&ceid=954237). First established during Trump's previous administration, this initiative mobilizes leading global law firms to provide **pro bono legal support** for NGOs impacted by the Global Gag Rule. This vital resource aims to help organizations navigate legal challenges, ensure compliance, and continue their critical work.

clean_body: January Front Lines newsletter | | ---|--- | | | | | At the Center for Reproductive Rights, we're fighting to protect and advance reproductive freedoms worldwide. From confronting restrictive abortion policies to championing equity on the global stage, we are dedicated to creating a future where everyone has access to the health care they deserve. Here's a snapshot of our most recent efforts: | Global | | Photo credit: ©NickyLloyd/iStock Photo | On January 20, the United Nations Human Rights Committee held Ecuador and Nicaragua accountable for severe human rights violations against three young survivors of sexual violence who were forced into motherhood because of abortion bans, ordering the countries to reform their laws to ensure access to abortion. Brought by the Center for Reproductive Rights and our partners in Latin America's Son Niñas, No Madres (Girls, Not Mothers) Movement , this ruling sets a powerful precedent for over 170 countries under the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights, protecting the rights of millions of women and girls. In the face of rising authoritarianism and new threats to the rights of women, girls, and people around the world, feminist-led movements in Latin America and the Global South are setting powerful global precedents in the fight for bodily freedom and dignity. The Son Niñas, No Madres victories are proof that, globally, law, policy, and popular opinion are bending toward justice. 🔗 🔗 | | United States | | Photo credit: ©zimmytws/iStock Photo | For the second time, President Donald Trump has signed an executive order to initiate the U.S. withdrawal from the World Health Organization (WHO). This decision threatens to unravel critical global health efforts. WHO plays a vital role in setting global health standards, coordinating emergency responses, and providing technical support to countries worldwide. With the U.S. withdrawal: Global health responses weaken: WHO's ability to combat crises will be jeopardized. Marginalized communities suffer most: Low-income countries will face even greater barriers to accessing essential care. Sexual and reproductive health sidelined: Deprioritizing global health, including maternal health, HIV/STI treatment, and access to sexual and reproductive health care further stigmatizes this essential care. This decision isolates the U.S. when unity is crucial and will have devastating consequences for the health and well-being of millions of people around the world. 🔗 | | | | As part of President Donald Trump's first week in office, he reinstated the "Global Gag Rule"—a sweeping policy that will decrease abortion access in countries around the world. This policy defunds health organizations in other countries that provide abortion services or even information, regardless of circumstances, including in cases of sexual assault. The new executive order reflects Project 2025's agenda to expand the Global Gag Rule even further, targeting an estimated $51 billion in foreign assistance, including humanitarian aid. If implemented, this expansion would have catastrophic effects on global health and human rights. Read more about how this move jeopardizes billions in funding for global reproductive rights. In response, the Center for Reproductive Rights is relaunching its . First established during Trump's previous administration, this initiative mobilizes leading global law firms to provide pro bono legal support for NGOs impacted by the Global Gag Rule. This vital resource aims to help organizations navigate legal challenges, ensure compliance, and continue their critical work. 🔗 | | | "Women have died—and are continuing to die—as a result of President Trump's actions in his first term. Expecting even more extreme actions in his second term, we are on high alert and prepared to sue at a moment's notice. Our fighting force of lawyers is prepared to block or delay the administration's most harmful actions. We will be in court every day for the next four years, if that's what it takes." —Nancy Northup, president and CEO at the Center for Reproductive Rights Front Lines** is dedicated to keeping you informed about the global fight for reproductive rights. 🌍💬 | | | | | ---|---|---|--- The Center for Reproductive Rights uses the power of law to advance reproductive rights as fundamental human rights around the world. © Center for Reproductive Rights Center for Reproductive Rights 199 Water St. New York, NY 10038 United States
