body:
We are one full week into the Trump administration and they have already caused a massive, nationwide panic around a memo that calls for freezing all government grants, loans, and financial assistance.
#
We are one full week into the Trump administration and they have already caused a massive, nationwide panic around a memo that calls for freezing all federal grants, loans, and financial assistance.
A lot of ink has already been spilled on potential targets of this freeze — which could affect as much as $3 trillion in government assistance and millions of Americans — but at VoteVets, we narrow our scope.
Here’s a list of VA programs that the Trump administration has put on the chopping block:
* Staff Sergeant Parker Gordon Fox Suicide Prevention Grant Program
* VA Homeless Providers Grants and Per Diem Programs
* VA Supportive Services for Veteran Families Program
* Veteran and Spouse Transitional Assistance Grant Program
* Legal Services for Veterans Grant Programs
* State Veterans Home Care
* Payments to States for Programs to Promote the Hiring and Retention of Nurses at State Veterans Homes
* Suicide Mortality Review Cooperative Agreements
* Veterans Cemetery Grants Program

Within that list are programs that provide grants to organizations that work to study and prevent Veteran suicides, provide housing for homeless Veterans, fund health care for Veterans, and maintain cemeteries for Veterans — and that list is not exhaustive.
There’s no DEI here. There’s no communist, marxist conspiracy. These are programs that support the men and women who wore our nation’s uniform, and if their funding dries up these services disappear.
It’s absolute f***ing chaos, and it’s all so Trump can grab more power, subvert the Constitution, destroy our democracy — and cover the cost of a tax cut for his billionaire buddies while he’s at it.
Not on our watch. Lawsuits are rising up all over the country, and Democrats are fighting back in Congress.
Now, we’re asking you to add your voice:
[**Tell the Trump administration: BACK OFF and end this chaos.](https://act.votevets.org/signup/250128_vv_em_freeze?refcode=&akid=34120%2E3013755%2EKpl5rC)**

subject: Can they just toss out 60,000+ legally cast votes?

body:
This saga is a flash point for American democracy.
|
---

Peter,
It’s been almost three months since voters elected Justice Allison Riggs to serve another term on the North Carolina Supreme Court.
But as we write this, her victory still remains in limbo, turning the entire saga into a flash point for democracy in America. Let’s review the facts:
**Justice Riggs won re-election by 734 votes. Two recounts confirmed that victory.** But in December, her opponent filed a challenge to throw out 60,000 ballots — a hail-mary attempt to overturn the results. Keep in mind: There’s nothing wrong with these ballots. The voters who cast them followed all the rules. (Riggs’ opponent just doesn’t like those rules.)
Then, in an unbelievable turn of events, the state supreme court blocked the certification of Justice Riggs’ election while her opponent’s legal challenge proceeds. Just last week, the court refused to fast-track the case, which means we might not have a certified winner for months. Justice Riggs will remain in her seat while this plays out, but **there is still a real threat that her fairly won election may get overturned, and tens of thousands of voters may get disenfranchised.**
Attorney General Holder summed up what’s happening here pretty bluntly:
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/101137021/525028864/358328389?refcode=don_aotl_tier1_email_CheatGFX_email_20250128-AOTL-Tier1-CheatGFX_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20250128-AOTL-Tier1-CheatGFX_&utm_campaign=CheatGFX&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjg0MjUzNDk2LWNiZGQtZWYxMS04OGY4LTAwMjI0ODJhOTU3OSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=q2-AXAaUBWn55YtWbQZ78cFXovJ3iy8KZ6slQPx0iVM=)

North Carolina was already a poster child of how far extreme partisans are willing to go. In 2022, a new conservative majority in the state supreme court reversed the court’s own recent ruling, throwing out a map that had produced a 50-50 partisan balance among their congressional districts. And with new gerrymandered maps passed by the legislature in effect in November, Republicans won 10 of 14 seats in this purple state.
For these extreme legislators, this latest supreme court race is about winning and holding on to power at all costs. And let’s be clear: This isn’t just about North Carolina. You better believe that anti-democratic forces across the country are watching what happens closely. If the courts invalidate legally cast ballots in this race, people are going to run this playbook anywhere and everywhere — looking to throw out votes they don’t like wherever they can.
**The central premise of democracy — every vote counts — is under attack in North Carolina. The way we respond right now matters. All On The Line is moving fast to mobilize grassroots activists in North Carolina and all over the country to fight back with everything we’ve got.**

More soon — for now, thank you for all you do to fight for democracy when it matters most.

subject: A callous and authoritarian decision by the Trump administration that will hurt millions.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ILHAN FOR CONGRESS
body:
Donald Trump pretends he’s a populist, but all he’s ever done in office is make the rich richer
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=1481%2E791427%2EFeX88o)

[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/3083?t=2&akid=1481%2E791427%2EFeX88o)
Friend — Trump has ordered a freeze on all federal aid money, an illegal move that will have devastating consequences for communities in Minnesota’s 5th and across the country.
Many states are already reporting that they cannot access their online Medicaid portals. Housing and food assistance will come to a standstill. Infrastructure projects will be halted. Disaster relief will be pulled out from under affected communities. And the list goes on.
**This is a callous and authoritarian decision by the Trump administration that will hurt millions.** Donald Trump pretends he’s a populist, but all he’s ever done in office is appease far-right conservatives by making the rich richer while stealing more money and resources from the working class of America.
It should be clear now that Trump works only for the billionaire class — not you and me. They want to see federal benefits and public projects slashed so their tax bill can go down. First it will be federal grants and loans, next Medicare and Social Security.
Congress has an obligation to hold Trump accountable for this abuse of power, and we must. If we fail to act, fail to organize, fail to bring more people into the opposition in this moment, it will only embolden Trump and the far-right to push the power of the presidency to even further extremes at the expense of regular Americans.
In solidarity,
Ilhan Omar

**One last moment of your time:**
We are all on edge right now as Donald Trump unleashes chaos with his reckless executive orders. One of the best things we can do is continue to build a progressive movement that will stand against Trump’s agenda. **[Will you make a contribution of $3 or whatever you can afford today to power Ilhan Omar’s campaign and help us fight back?](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/3080?c0=io-em-jan25.UnpAYI&c1=3.ufE5-L&c2=em250128-2-60.Dv9_im&t=3&akid=1481%2E791427%2EFeX88o)**

It should be clear now that Trump works only for the billionaire class — not you and me. They want to see federal benefits and public projects slashed so their tax bill can go down. First it will be federal grants and loans, next Medicare and Social Security. Congress has an obligation to hold Trump accountable for this abuse of power, and we must. If we fail to act, fail to organize, fail to bring more people into the opposition in this moment, it will only embolden Trump and the far-right to push the power of the presidency to even further extremes at the expense of regular Americans. In solidarity, Ilhan Omar One last moment of your time: We are all on edge right now as Donald Trump unleashes chaos with his reckless executive orders. One of the best things we can do is continue to build a progressive movement that will stand against Trump’s agenda. PAID FOR BY ILHAN FOR CONGRESS

| | What happens in one part of the country doesn’t stay in that part of the country. **When anti-democracy extremists come up with a new way to restrict the freedom to vote in one state — like mass voter purges — they don’t keep it to themselves.** And all too often, we’ve seen anti-voter schemes from Georgia used as models across the country. **Nationwide threats require nationwide action. So, as anti-voter extremists take pages out of each others’ playbooks and spread voter intimidation and suppression tactics, we will keep bringing pro-voter champions together to fight back.** We will build on our successes — like helping prevent thousands of voters from being purged from the voting rolls, taking on voter suppression, and exposing the biggest threats to democracy head on. And together, we will defend the freedom to vote from MAGA GOP attacks. Look: anti-voter radicals hope that by attacking our rights all over America, from the halls of Congress to state legislatures to courthouses, they can force us to play whack-a-mole. They hope they can keep pro-voter activists too scattered to fight back against the big picture. But we see through their game. We see the connections between each attack on our fundamental freedoms. As long as they keep mounting an interlocked assault, we’ll lock arms in response. And as we enter this new era — where our democracy is under greater threat than we’ve seen in our lifetimes — we’ll make sure this time period isn’t defined by the attacks we face, but rather by the defenses we build, together. Activists like you make this work possible, and we are deeply grateful. Thank you for everything you do to defend the freedom to vote. subject: Saving the Easter Bunny
body:
| | | Brave Books is spearheading a massive "Prepare the Way" revival campaign to shift the focus of Easter from bunnies and chocolate...
---
| |
---
| | Dear Fellow Believer, It may seem a little early to be talking about Easter, but it's really only about 12 weeks away.And in that short amount of time, my friends at Brave Books are spearheading a massive "Prepare the Way" campaign to shift the focus of Easter from bunnies and chocolate......to Jesus.And this revival mission needs you! My friend, if you've seen me talking about Brave Books on Fox News, you know their mission is to counter the ungodly lies being pushed by the Left in schools, libraries, and Hollywood......by creating high-quality, wholesome, and Godly books and entertainment that instill conservative values and Gospel lessons in our children. And their "Prepare the Way" revival campaign is their biggest effort yet to point parents and children to the empty tomb and God’s redeeming love.Here’s exactly what their strategy is...First... Brave Books knows that families need an easy and impactful way to counter the Left's secularization of Easter and instead, captivate children with its true meaning. So, they created _Saving the Easter Bunny_ , a brand-new children's book that's destined to be a classic.In it, Ronnie the Rabbit learns the hard way what sin is and that our Lord Jesus Christ loves us so much that he took the punishment for that sin.Jesus is represented by a powerful lion named Lord Joshua and the book beautifully portrays his resurrection and God's never-ending redeeming love for us. It's incredible.And let me tell you, parents are hungry for content like this because everywhere they turn godlessness is being pushed by schools, left-wing publishers like Scholastic, and Hollywood. When Brave Books first introduced a God-centered Christmas game called "_Mouse in the House_ ," to counter the secular elf game that has become so popular -- it sold out in THREE HOURS!That's why step one of Brave Books' 12-week "Prepare the Way" revival, is ramping up the printing and distribution of _Saving the Easter Bunny_ big-time. **[And today I'm hoping you'll help them kick it into high gear before orders start pouring in by rushing back your best "Prepare the Way" gift.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=4548941094fd427bbd357c867e3d8dcb&_e=JjFnyy1g4dNOKJTL2-MFD6VGZBvW3swUpUUftXsooD5R5_AgrnIb-exTVNAwJeWjyXaFmiPI15T8iZ3xO8I7hi_F6b1-nT7NrBYBBtVf0frPac7H3aQz60wYdk4bGowyhiQZnBD6cJsIKSTpDRCsJ-dVY-sbmOdFhyi9HGOCCCXN4TwiAocPEFYkK5OuMllFrD5qLTSO-YBlXSxR2y13_SbWEjYZgX6YAO5txfAncbzSbWcKgf3Lj_6LNBFlRpzTBhqrg6vAyouSk6h0AKXzfKlIuOESXwVTwXjlsiCK9TsWNhclGLfVnwy3Vhscr7SOcf-UuKDCiYAXOu-CgS3Tc6P-r8Dng8HTQCOuws6UeVhNwf1DdB1alrk4foV0n2nWhImbsuwHJMcv51nDBU8chQ%3D%3D)** No family should go without this wonderful book because of overwhelming demand. Second... Recognizing that families who want to raise their children with wholesome Christian values often feel alone in their mission...Brave Books is launching a 17-city traveling church tour that starts in Ponta Vedra Beach, Florida and ends in Laurel, Mississippi. I'll be leading the tour in every city as we prepare our hearts and our families for Easter through prayer, worship, music, and just some good old-fashioned conversation about raising Godly children in our godless culture.Our church tour aims to ignite a spirit of revival in thousands of families this Easter season and I can't wait to see what God makes of that! But getting our worship teams, musicians, and all the rest to 17 different cities for thousands of families to enjoy won't be easy and it won't be inexpensive.But I know we can do it.Brave Books is a small Christian company founded by a doctor named Trent Talbot. After having his first child, he saw how the Left was using books and entertainment to turn the hearts and minds of America's children away from God. And so he decided to take action and with the help of believers just like you, look at what they've already done:
---
>>> They've countered the Left's radical and ungodly "Drag Queen Story Hours" and filled children's hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God with their highly-publicized "See You at the Library" campaign. Armed with Brave Books' "See You at the Library" kits, thousands of parents, grandparents, children, and concerned citizens have gathered at over 360 libraries in 49 states to take back our libraries.>>> Created an historic TV show called "Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk" to fight the ungodly lessons coming out of Hollywood. It's our modern day "Mr. Rogers' Neighborhood" funded by everyday Americans who want to return American culture to God. "Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk" uses humor and storytelling to reinforce the traditional biblical values that have made America great.>>> And now you are crucial to the success and failure of our "Prepare the Way" revival campaign which features the printing and distribution of _Saving the Easter Bunny_ and a 17-city church tour.
---
Just look at what parents have already said about S _aving the Easter Bunny_ :
---
"It's not easy to explain the true meaning of Easter to adults never mind to children, but Brave Books does it beautifully."
---
— Lisa A.
---
"My kids love the amazing illustrations and so do I!"
---
– Bob A.
---
"My three granddaughters barely sit still but when I'm reading this book and Lord Joshua dies, you can hear a pin drop. That's quickly replaced by squeals of joy after the resurrection. Thank you for bringing the joy of Easter to their little hearts."
---
– Laurin

You can keep _Saving the Easter Bunny_ for your family, gift it to someone you love, or you can donate it to your favorite charity in the hopes of reaching a family who doesn't have a Christian role model in their life. **[**What's most important is that you rush back your best "Prepare the Way" gift of $35, $50, $100, or more right away.**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=4548941094fd427bbd357c867e3d8dcb&_e=JjFnyy1g4dNOKJTL2-MFD6VGZBvW3swUpUUftXsooD5R5_AgrnIb-exTVNAwJeWjyXaFmiPI15T8iZ3xO8I7hi_F6b1-nT7NrBYBBtVf0frPac7H3aQz60wYdk4bGowyhiQZnBD6cJsIKSTpDRCsJ-dVY-sbmOdFhyi9HGOCCCXN4TwiAocPEFYkK5OuMllFrD5qLTSO-YBlXSxR2y13_SbWEjYZgX6YAO5txfAncbwAc66SYWU3Fw11W_tTUsfbqwbvhHwaJBhZSIC0iD6yOlYPN__eO5XpeZFWSKAIw39RAtS6FuiU7_tumu6vLvcvOed0RzuQQ6oo9ydI4UEp1YJAcpxqsT6HenDQpgQ_WHobDwjzBHkU3hkHR11xbkWu-jkPyrQjeX4fCujkk-QXFQ%3D%3D)** Thank you for bringing the true meaning of Easter to families all across America.

body:
[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/101137398/525030332/693975070?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTExMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMjBjOGZhZi1jZGRkLWVmMTEtODhmOC0wMDIyNDgyYTk1NzkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Kam72uSIlGk-HZNSCLr7zaUVpSWGn7I1ewy-BjpVC0I=&emci=7608a33e-b9dd-ef11-88f8-0022482a9579&emdi=c20c8faf-cddd-ef11-88f8-0022482a9579&ceid=15820338)
---
Peter –

We need to have a serious conversation about Trump’s actions since taking back the Oval Office.

Since January 20, Trump has issued executive order after executive order in an attempt to enact his far-right agenda. And late last night, he ordered a full federal freeze on all assistance programs that benefit the American people. **Words cannot describe how unacceptable – _and illegal_ – these actions are.**

State officials and non-profits are aiming to fight back, and a federal judge has just blocked this freeze from taking effect, but this situation still deserves our full attention. Millions of Americans rely on federal assistance programs for a huge range of reasons – and trillions of dollars will be held in the balance because of Trump. These programs include federal Pell Grants, school meals for low-income students, SNAP and WIC benefits, Medicare enrollment, small business loans, and so much more.

And we still don’t fully know the extent of harm this latest ploy will cause the American people.

clean_body: Peter – We need to have a serious conversation about Trump’s actions since taking back the Oval Office. Since January 20, Trump has issued executive order after executive order in an attempt to enact his far-right agenda. And late last night, he ordered a full federal freeze on all assistance programs that benefit the American people. Words cannot describe how unacceptable – and illegal – these actions are. State officials and non-profits are aiming to fight back, and a federal judge has just blocked this freeze from taking effect, but this situation still deserves our full attention. Millions of Americans rely on federal assistance programs for a huge range of reasons – and trillions of dollars will be held in the balance because of Trump. These programs include federal Pell Grants, school meals for low-income students, SNAP and WIC benefits, Medicare enrollment, small business loans, and so much more. And we still don’t fully know the extent of harm this latest ploy will cause the American people. We knew Trump was always in this for himself, but this latest tactic proves just how low he’s willing to go to get his way. Putting a halt on all federal assistance helps no one - not even his own political base. But we can’t keep saying that what Trump is doing is bad – we need to put our words into action and show him exactly how much we don’t agree with his policies. We need to show our leaders that we are united and we’re not backing down. – Team Schrier Rep. Kim Schrier is a doctor, scientist, and mom, fighting for Washington's 8th District in Congress. subject: Yes, Trump cut ESSENTIAL FEDERALLY FUNDED SERVICES — Make your voice heard and demand that Congress FIGHT BACK
body:
To view this mail in a browser, copy https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTIwNTA0NjIS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjE0MDM5OTEyNwS2&mt=1&rt=0 into your browser.
Peter — It’s only been eight days, and Trump's administration just defied the Constitution to unilaterally freeze every
federally-funded program nationwide. This Executive Order is so broad that ALL programs supported by the federal
government are at risk, immediately harming families and communities. Clean air
and drinking water programs, support for the manufacturing boom happening around
the country, Medicaid and health care for veterans, as well as fundamental
federal assistance programs like SNAP and WIC, low-income home energy program
(LIHEAP), and climate-related disaster aid are all affected. We’re scared, Peter, but we’re also angry. Now is the time to act.Tell Congress to do everything they can to fight back — vital programs that help
people every day in every state are being blocked, and the consequences to their
constituents will be devastating. Here’s how you can reach them: Text FIGHT to 877-877 to call your member of Congress; OREmail your member of Congress by clicking here. https://links.messages.lcv. When our elected members of Congress decide how to use taxpayer money, the job
of the executive branch is to follow through. Period. This dangerously broad overreach by the Trump administration, directed by
Project 2025, is part of Trump’s extreme power grab meant to instill chaos, and
it will cause very real harm to people in every state. This is one of those moments to speak out, Peter. If Trump and his
extremist allies go unchallenged in this fight, they will further consolidate
power and put even more lives at risk. Tell Congress to stop them. Will you fight alongside us? Onward, Gene Karpinski

This Executive Order is so broad that ALL programs supported by the federal government are at risk, immediately harming families and communities. We’re scared, Peter, but we’re also angry. Now is the time to act.Tell Congress to do everything they can to fight back — vital programs that help people every day in every state are being blocked, and the consequences to their constituents will be devastating. Here’s how you can reach them: Text FIGHT to 877-877 to call your member of Congress; OREmail your member of Congress by clicking here. When our elected members of Congress decide how to use taxpayer money, the job of the executive branch is to follow through. Period. This dangerously broad overreach by the Trump administration, directed by Project 2025, is part of Trump’s extreme power grab meant to instill chaos, and it will cause very real harm to people in every state. This is one of those moments to speak out, Peter. If Trump and his extremist allies go unchallenged in this fight, they will further consolidate power and put even more lives at risk. body:
New legislation (long email)

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/101138157/525032745/-1860252395?refcode=-header-&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDMxMTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOGJlMWY2ZWYtY2ZkZC1lZjExLTg4ZjgtMDAyMjQ4MmE5NTc5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=jl7BMTY8HDWdgNE5fhtFOaiHgmnUaA2gNsfbg84nogQ=) | Peter, Wildfires are top of mind for everyone right now in California. As we learn more about the scope of devastation in Southern California, I’ve been busy making sure D.C. doesn’t shirk their responsibilities to help - in the short and long term. First off, disaster relief cannot be used as a political pawn. Our families need relief ASAP, and it is despicable that Donald Trump and Mike Johnson are trying to use it as a bargaining chip. I refuse to let that happen. Second, we need California and DC to actually DO SOMETHING to fix this wildfire crisis. For years I’ve been yelling from the rooftops that this was an issue - firefighter shortages, poor land management, outdated technology. All the signs were there. It shouldn’t have taken the devastation in SoCal for Congress to finally listen, but I’m grateful to share last week we made some real progress. My bill, the Fix Our Forests Act, passed on a bipartisan basis out of the House. The bill is a massive step forward in wildfire prevention - it hires (and retains) more firefighters, upgrades technology so we catch fires sooner, and cuts red tape so we can get moving on these projects asap. Let me also be clear - this one bill isn’t going to completely fix the wildfire crisis. There is a ton more work to do and I promise you this: even as the TV cameras leave our state, I am committed to seeing this fight all the way through. To our friends and neighbors beginning the grueling rebuilding process, please let us know how we can help. No idea is too big or small. This is going to take all of us working together to fix this. In solidarity, \- Josh
---
* * *

Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football 's 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville's time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year's Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP's SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul "Bear" Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

_In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime.
